videos.overview: Sushanth’s scholarship is restored, but only after he agrees to the principal’s condition. As the gang celebrates, Sushanth quietly carries the burden alone.

videos.title: Lights, Camera, Rivalry!
videos.overview: As Sammy joins Suhas and Ali’s short film, tensions with Sid deepen. When Milky disrupts Ali’s project, a rivalry sparks between the groups as they decide to make competing films.

videos.title: The Untold Love
videos.overview: As both teams race to finish their short films, Sid draws inspiration from his friendship with Sammy. The contest reaches its climax as the winner is announced.

videos.title: The Untold Love Wins
videos.overview: Sid’s team wins the short film contest, leaving Sammy deeply moved. Later, the gang uses the prize money to support Sushanth’s dream project.

videos.title: Surprise for Sid
videos.overview: Moved by Sid’s short film, Sammy sees him in a new light. Meanwhile, Goldie surprises Sid by introducing him to her distant relative.

videos.title: At Last! I Love You
videos.overview: Inspired by a heartfelt lesson on love, Goldie finally confesses her feelings to Sid. To her delight, Sid reveals that he feels the same way.

videos.title: Too Late to Say It
videos.overview: Sammy prepares to confess her feelings to Sid, only to be left heartbroken by a revelation. Meanwhile, Harika’s college FM station gets off to an exciting start.

videos.title: Feelings in Disguise
videos.overview: As Sammy struggles with heartbreak, Sid finds himself missing her at every turn. Meanwhile, Suhas uncovers a truth, making a startling revelation.

videos.title: A Plan to Prove the Truth
videos.overview: Plan is on for Milky’s birthday trip. Suhas tries to convince Sammy that Sid loves her. While Nandini dares Milky with a challenge, a daring plan promises to reveal the truth.

videos.title: Relationship(S) Reveal
videos.overview: Milky’s birthday is celebrated at a farmhouse. Sid and Goldie make their relationship official. But Sammy’s surprise announcement leaves everyone stunned.

videos.title: Game of Emotions
videos.overview: As tensions rise over Sammy’s relationship with Suhas, a game of Truth or Dare exposes hidden feelings. Sammy is forced to rethink her plan.

videos.title: Unexpected Neighbours
videos.overview: Sammy decides to continue her plan with Suhas. The midterm exam results are announced, which gives Sushanth a shock. Meanwhile, an unexpected twist brings Goldie and Suhas closer.

videos.title: The Only Candidate
videos.overview: Amidst the row over the college radio, Sammy begins to understand Suhas’ perspective. Meanwhile, Suhas makes a bold move in the college elections.

videos.title: A Worthy Opponent
videos.overview: A live radio interview puts Suhas in the spotlight as tough questions challenge his campaign. The election takes a dramatic turn when Harika enters the race.

videos.title: Lines are Drawn
videos.overview: Sid and Suhas battle for student support with contrasting ideals as the election rivalry intensifies. Meanwhile, Sammy faces a difficult choice of her own.

videos.title: The Election War
videos.overview: The election battle intensifies. While Harika and Sid focus on students’ real concerns, Suhas launches an aggressive campaign and turns his attention to Sid.

videos.title: The Radio Battle
videos.overview: Both sides battle for student support through the radio room as the election campaign escalates. Meanwhile, an unexpected bond begins to form between Suhas and Goldie.

videos.title: The Endgame Begins
videos.overview: Harika considers stepping away from the election, but Sid urges her to keep fighting. Meanwhile, Sammy’s advice helps Suhas gain a powerful new ally.

videos.title: The Deciding Day
videos.overview: When voting begins for the student election, Suhas and Harika battle for every vote. Meanwhile, growing tensions between Sid and Sammy become harder to ignore.

videos.title: Seven Votes Apart
videos.overview: Harika wins the student election by a narrow margin. But her heartfelt speech and public praise for an unexpected person leave the entire campus surprised.

videos.title: Back on Track
videos.overview: As Harika settles into her new role as student leader, old friendships begin to heal. Meanwhile, Milky and Nandini grow closer, and Goldie seeks independence.

videos.title: The Walking Formula
videos.overview: Goldie takes a step towards independence, and Sid and the gang pull off a major guest lecture. Later, a hidden truth leaves Suhas questioning everything.

videos.title: Changing Feelings
videos.overview: Old misunderstandings are resolved, and Sammy begins to see Sid in a new light. Meanwhile, Suhas grows closer to Sammy as feelings quietly begin to change.

videos.title: A Calculated Risk
videos.overview: Suhas helps Goldie secure approval for her food stall, earning her trust and admiration. However, Goldie’s growing admiration for Suhas leaves Sid unsettled.

videos.title: The Distance Between
videos.overview: Goldie struggles with Sid’s sudden distance, but Milky steps in to confront him. Meanwhile, Sammy’s plan nears its turning point as Sid demands answers.

videos.title: Questions of the Heart
videos.overview: Sid finally opens up to Sammy about his lingering doubts and his long-buried feelings begin to surface. Meanwhile, Goldie takes another step towards her dream.

videos.title: Making Peace
videos.overview: Sid tries to make peace with everyone around him, while Sammy grows frustrated by his selflessness. Meanwhile, Goldie takes a major step towards her dream.

videos.title: The Group of Three
videos.overview: Sid attempts to bring Sammy and Suhas back together. His actions leave the two more confused than ever. Meanwhile, an unexpected message leaves Harika shaken.

videos.title: Behind the Handwriting
videos.overview: Disco and Milky hunt for the student behind an offensive message targeting Harika. Meanwhile, Sammy struggles to bring Sid and Suhas together for a crucial meeting.

videos.title: The Complicated Confession
videos.overview: Suhas finally confesses his feelings to Sammy, leaving her more conflicted than ever. Meanwhile, Goldie confronts Sid after uncovering the truth behind his secret meeting.

videos.title: More Than a Game
videos.overview: As Suhas seeks a chance at a real relationship with Sammy, a carrom challenge turns them into rivals. Meanwhile, Disco edges closer to the truth behind the anonymous chits.

videos.title: Through Thick and Thin
videos.overview: Sammy is devastated after her father suffers a heart attack. As Sid and Milky support her through the crisis, Suhas and Goldie uncover the truth and rush to the hospital.

videos.title: The Family Reunion
videos.overview: As Prakash recovers, a heartfelt family reunion brings comfort to everyone. Soon, Saketh delivers shocking news to Sammy about her future leaving her stunned.

videos.title: The End of Us?
videos.overview: Goldie brings her dream of launching a food stall to life, yet her bond with Sid draws to a painful close. Meanwhile, Sammy's sudden disappearance leaves everyone worried.

videos.title: Bridging the Distance
videos.overview: Milky urges Sammy to help mend Sid and Goldie’s broken relationship. Meanwhile, Suhas unexpectedly wins over Sammy’s father during a chance encounter.

videos.title: Second Chances
videos.overview: Sid sets aside his ego to win Goldie back, delivering an emotional apology just before the college break begins. Meanwhile, Nandini's unsettling secret shocks Goldie.

videos.title: The Answers We Await
videos.overview: With the college break around the corner, Suhas presses Sammy for an answer. Elsewhere, Milky confides in Sid and seeks his help for Nandini.

videos.title: New Roads, New Dreams
videos.overview: Sid, Sammy, Milky and Saketh embark on a holiday trip. Suhas is still awaiting Sammy's response while Goldie's canteen is celebrating a successful first week.

videos.title: The Way We Were
videos.overview: As Saketh reunites with Omi, an evening with his family reminds Sid, Sammy and Milky of what truly matters. Childhood memories leave them reflecting on how much they have changed.

videos.title: The Unanswered Wait
videos.overview: Suhas rushes home after an unexpected call from his father, while Sammy waits for him at their meeting point. Indu’s return brings a startling new chapter into Suhas’s life.

videos.title: The Day Everything Changed
videos.overview: Sammy finally gathers courage to answer Suhas, but a devastating phone call changes her life forever. Meanwhile, Sid and Goldie’s relationship falls apart once again.

videos.title: Between Memories and Tomorrows
videos.overview: Sammy tries to cope with her dad’s demise, while she honours his final wish before facing another devastating decision. Meanwhile, her friends stand by her through her dark times.

videos.title: When the Hardest Truths Hurt
videos.overview: Sid's attempt to protect Milky drives a wedge between them and puts their friendship at risk. Sammy finally answers Suhas, but her decision about the future leaves him devastated.

videos.title: Until We Meet Again
videos.overview: Sammy prepares to leave for the US, bidding an emotional farewell to the people she loves, and leaving behind memories. Meanwhile, Suhas, Sid and Milky struggle to let her go.

videos.title: Echoes of Goodbye
videos.overview: As Sammy’s heartfelt farewell letters reach her friends, they reflect on the bond they shared with her. While Sid tries to move on, Milky continues to distance himself from him.

videos.title: Paths Crossed
videos.overview: Sid accepts an internship that offers him a second chance. Suhas reluctantly agrees to help Ali and Disco, and the college finalises its internship team.

videos.title: New Beginnings
videos.overview: Sid and Goldie put their differences behind them. Suhas struggles to move on. Sid, Jaya and Sushanth begin their internship, marking the start of a new chapter in their lives.

videos.title: Roads We Take
videos.overview: Sid settles into his internship. Suhas and the group set off on a road trip. Indu learns about Suhas and Sammy. Struggling to hold himself together, Suhas eventually breaks down.

videos.title: The Voice She Left Behind
videos.overview: Sid struggles to understand whether Sammy’s departure or his distance from Goldie hurts him more. Suhas’ grief takes a disturbing turn when he begins hearing Sammy’s voice.

videos.title: Facing the Past
videos.overview: Suhas tries to confront a place connected to his painful past. Indu challenges Suhas’ perception of Sid, while Sushanth’s delayed thesis creates a rift between him and Jaya.

videos.title: The Road Back Home
videos.overview: Suhas returns to his village after years, confronting painful memories and his family’s resentment. Indu grows concerned about Sid. Jaya wonders about Sushanth’s deal with Naveen

videos.title: Making Peace With the Past
videos.overview: Suhas finds closure with his family and finally makes peace with his past. Sushanth’s financial crisis pushes him into a risky secret. Sid feels happy to help a young neighbour.

videos.title: The Questions We Ask Ourselves
videos.overview: While Sid discovers a new purpose through teaching, Indu challenges him to put more effort into what he values. Suhas helps Goldie confront her doubts about relationships.

videos.title: The Final Goodbye
videos.overview: Goldie ends her relationship with Sid, leaving him shattered. While Indu finds Sid in a devastated state at a tea stall, Suhas spots them together and gets furious.

videos.title: Time to Move On
videos.overview: Sid struggles to cope with Goldie’s decision and lashes out at Indu, while TT uncovers Naveen’s role in proxy work. Meanwhile, Nandini’s growing trust in Milky brings them closer.

videos.title: Facing the Truth
videos.overview: Indu takes Sid to a therapist to help him cope with his heartbreak. While TT catches Sushanth’s secret work arrangement, Disco discovers Nandini’s betrayal.

videos.title: Another Broken Heart
videos.overview: Sid works towards mending his friendship with Suhas, while Goldie reveals her breakup to their friends. Milky’s hopes are shattered when he learns that Nandini doesn’t love him.

videos.title: Happiness Interrupted
videos.overview: Through Disco, Sid helps Milky move on from Nandini. Ali and Harika get a breakthrough for their music video. Sid’s attempt to reconnect with Suhas ends in another confrontation.

videos.title: Walking Away
videos.overview: Sushanth faces pressure over his family’s financial crisis. Indu confronts Suhas about his controlling attitude towards Sid. Suhas decides to walk away from his father’s support.

videos.title: Friends Again
videos.overview: Goldie helps Suhas to run the college canteen. Sid and Milky finally reconcile, but Jaya’s father comes across a video that puts her relationship with Sushanth at risk.

videos.title: Standing on His Own
videos.overview: Suhas takes charge of the canteen with Goldie’s aid, while Ali surprises him with funds. Sushanth seeks Suhas’ help for his problems. Meanwhile, Jaya’s father plots against him.

videos.title: Caught in Trouble
videos.overview: Sid impresses TT with his performance in the internship exam. Sushanth feels that his troubles are finally over, but TT discovers something shocking, putting his future at risk.

videos.title: Under Suspicion
videos.overview: Confronted over the stolen client database, Sushanth struggles to prove his innocence. Meanwhile, Suhas and Goldie prepare to take charge of the college canteen.

videos.title: Standing by Sushanth
videos.overview: Sushanth faces rustication after the cyber cell finds evidence linking him to the data breach. His friends refuse to give up on him and are firm that he is innocent.

videos.title: On the Edge
videos.overview: Despite the principal’s offer, Sushanth refuses to name the person he allegedly sold the data to. Sid and Suhas are stunned as Sushanth leaves them a painful message.

videos.title: The Cost of Doubt
videos.overview: Sushanth’s critical condition leaves his friends devastated. Sid feels that their failure to believe in Sushanth may have pushed him to the edge, and vows to make things right.

videos.title: Until the Truth Is Known
videos.overview: Suhas opens up to Goldie about missing Sammy, while Sid seeks TT’s support to prove Sushanth’s innocence. Sid is forced to make a difficult decision when Sushanth’s father arrives.

videos.title: Together We Stand
videos.overview: Sid uncovers Naveen’s role in framing Sushanth, while Suhas gets rusticated for supporting his friend. Meanwhile, Ali’s bold act forces the principal to rethink his decision.

videos.title: A Clean Slate
videos.overview: Sushanth is cleared of all charges as Naveen’s plot is exposed, while Suhas’s stand forces the college to revoke his rustication. Sushanth finally regains consciousness.

videos.title: Ray of Hope
videos.overview: Sushanth learns that he has been cleared of charges. Suhas helps settle Sushanth’s family’s debt. A chance mention of Sammy leaves Sid wondering if she may return.

videos.title: The Long-Awaited Return
videos.overview: Sammy returns to India. Overwhelmed by fear, Sid hesitates to face her until Milky encourages him. Meanwhile, Suhas admits he has not truly moved on from her.

videos.title: One Last Week?
videos.overview: Sammy reveals to Sid that she plans to sell her family home to repay her late father’s debt. Meanwhile, Sid struggles with the pain of knowing she will leave soon.

videos.title: The Missed Meeting
videos.overview: As Sammy prepares to leave India after settling her father’s debt, Indu urges her to meet Suhas. But Ali makes a painful choice to protect Suhas from another heartbreak.

videos.title: Three Days to Goodbye
videos.overview: Suhas learns of Sammy’s return, but their reunion turns painful when she reveals she is leaving again in three days. However, Sammy finally admits how deeply she loves Suhas.

videos.title: A Difficult Choice
videos.overview: Sammy struggles to leave her family home, while Sid confronts her about abandoning their friendship. Suhas grows dejected after Sammy confirms she will leave India soon.

videos.title: Before She Leaves
videos.overview: Suhas seeks clarity from himself before spending Sammy’s last day with her. Meanwhile, learning a shocking truth, Sid feels shattered.

videos.title: The Home That Remained
videos.overview: Suhas and Sammy spend the day together. Sammy is happy to meet Jaya and Sushanth. A surprise decision saves Sammy’s family home.

videos.title: Batchmates - The Journey We Shared
videos.overview: Five years later, Ali returns to the college as a director, only to learn his friends secretly supported him all along. The reunion brings old memories and a joyful new beginning.

tt0096913.description: A team from the United States is going to compete against Korea in a Tae Kwon Do tournament. The team consists of fighters from all over the country - can they overcome their rivalry and work together to win?
tt0096913.name: Best of the Best

tt31925820.name: Dupahiya
tt31925820.description: Dhadakpur, the Belgium of Bihar, is on the cusp of celebrating 25 years of being crime free. But chaos strikes when a never-seen-before motorbike, that was purchased as a wedding gift gets stolen 7 days before the ceremony! The journey taken by the bride's family and ex-lover to find the Dupahiya forms the heart of this comedy, which explores the hopes and aspirations of simple people.

videos.title: Bambai
videos.overview: Welcome to Dhadakpur, a one-of-a-kind Crime-Free village. Jha family is eager for their daughter, Roshni, to get married. Her choice of groom demands a never-seen- before bike as dowry. In spite of all odds, the Jha family is determined. The bike arrives amisdst celebration in the day but disaster strikes at night! The bike is stolen! Only 8 days left for the wedding!

videos.title: Chor Nahi Chikaar
videos.overview: Banwari discovers the bike has been stolen! Bhugol and Teepu cook up a story casting suspicion on Amavas. The Sarpanch reaches Dhadakpur with good news. Banwari and Roshni question the prime suspect. Sparks fly between the two ex-lovers as they reminisce about their past. Roshni and Banwari return with no leads. Only 7 days left for wedding!

videos.title: Oh Mere Jija Ji
videos.overview: Amavas decides to fulfill his duty of being a good ex-lover. Kuber arrives in Dhadakpur to check out his beloved bike. Banwari enlists Pandit and Bhugol's help to ensure Kuber is left in a tizzy. Madan discovers Jha family's secret. Banwari decides to do the unthinkable. Only 6 days left for the wedding!

videos.title: Kanoon Ke Haath
videos.overview: ASI Mithlesh suspects something is amiss in Dhadakpur. He awakens from his slumber when he discovers it has something to do with his old nemesis Banwari. Amavas puts forth his plan at the village meeting. Madan is nabbed and taken to the police station. Amavas and Bhugol set off on a journey to save Dhadakpur's pride and Roshni's wedding. Only 5 days left for the wedding!

videos.title: Piyo Magar Pyaar Se
videos.overview: Sarpanch questions Pushpalata about the rumours he's heard . Relatives arrive for the wedding festivities. Roshni begins to have doubts. Durlabh instigates Kuber to verify if the bike has truly been bought. Amavas shares his vulnerable side with Bhugol as they gulp down a few drinks and pass out while the second hand bike stands ready to be collected. Only 4 days left for the wedding!

videos.title: Ullu Mat Bolna
videos.overview: Bhugol and Amavas have to perform at a special birthday party to pay for the bike. Roshni confronts Kuber. Madan finally gets his dream job but is in a moral dilemma. Frustrated Banwari reaches the cop station. Pushpalata announces a strict punishment at the village meeting. Teepu helps Nirmal with the cash for her treatment. Only 3 days left for the wedding!

videos.title: Ulta Chor Kotwal Ko Dante
videos.overview: Mithlesh sets out to find the thief with renewed vigor. Amavas and Bhugol escape from Parmanu's clutches. Amavas is not impressed with Kuber. Pushpalata considers resigning. Mithlesh's investigation leads him to a suspect but just then Teepu reveals important evidence. Roshni's dilemma builds. Only 2 day left for the wedding!

videos.title: Bhootpurv Premi
videos.overview: Nirmal is at the cusp of getting her treatment. Banwari struggles with the wedding arrangements because of the boycott. A crucial eye witness confesses to Mithlesh. Amavas confronts Bhugol about Kuber. An action packed scuffle threatens the arrival of the bike. The wedding party is on the way. Few hours before the wedding!

videos.title: Atmanirbhar
videos.overview: The day of reckoning. Nirmal speaks to Pushpalata about the boycott. Kuber arrives with the wedding party at the Jha household but there is no sign of the bike. The wedding is in jeopardy! Mithlesh nabs the thief- but there is a bigger mastermind at play. Dhadakpur learns an important lesson that has a lasting impact. Bhugol manages to finally fulfill his dream!

tt37963237.name: Varavu
tt37963237.description: A family falls victim to the powerful elite in a small town. Time passes, wounds fester. One man's return forces a confrontation that will expose decades of lies and corruption.

tt42262473.name: Modha Rathiri
tt42262473.description: Follows two strangers brought together at an unusual wedding where, in one night, too many surprises unfold and several lies are told, spiraling into chaos that changes everything.

tt41790460.name: Agadha
tt41790460.description: A solitary girl encounters a towering twelve-handed mystical idol in a torch lit shadowy cave, creating an atmosphere of spirituality and dark intrigue.

tt39667834.name: Lust Stories 3
tt39667834.description: Multiple narratives delve into contemporary relationships, portraying desire in its many forms while examining how vulnerability and unspoken tensions influence the ways people connect.

tt37594662.name: Bakaiti
tt37594662.description: Set in old Ghaziabad, this heartwarming series follows the Kataria family grappling with a financial crunch. When Naina is forced to share her room with her younger brother Bharat, sibling tensions rise.

videos.title: Paani Ki Tanki Bhar Gayi Hai
videos.overview: Sanjay Kataria announces to his family that they will be renting out a room in their ancestral house. While his father scolds him for the decision, the Kataria children devise plans to earn money.

videos.title: Tervi Mein Teekhi Baat
videos.overview: Dadaji’s death brings the family together at Ajay’s house. As the family deals with issues, Naina and Bharat plot to chase potential tenants away. Sanjay discovers their plans and gives an ultimatum.

videos.title: Naya Mehmaan
videos.overview: A neighbour’s visit inspires the Kataria siblings to start a new business from their home, but their plans fail. A very charming Chirag enters the house as the tenant, and Naina is love-struck.

videos.title: Result Kahaan Hai
videos.overview: Naina and Bharat staying together in a room brings in more chaos in the Kataria house. Naina has a cute moment with Chirag. Sanjay visits Ajay's furniture store to settle the dispute about the house.

videos.title: Rakhi Ya Friendship
videos.overview: Raksha Bandhan for Katarias ends on a sour note as Ajay and his family leave after a fight. Naina attempts to befriend Chirag. Bharat learns a harsh truth as he hears his parents fight.

videos.title: Dil Ka Kamra
videos.overview: Bharat is over the moon about his cricket trials. Naina deals with anxiety about her future and heartbreak. On her birthday eve, a heartbroken Naina writes a letter.

videos.title: Birthday aur Bakaiti
videos.overview: It’s Naina’s birthday, but she is nowhere to be found. While Ajay and his family arrive to wish Naina, a fight sparks tension between the older Kataria siblings. Bharat realises where Naina could be.

videos.title: Lo Ho Gayi Bakaiti Shuru
videos.overview: Bakaiti begins anew as Sanjay, Ajay and the Katarias face mounting challenges.

videos.title: Sach ya Samjhauta
videos.overview: Naina returns home to find the Katarias caught between pride, pressure and compromise.

videos.title: Happy Birthday Papa
videos.overview: As the family plans a surprise for Sanjay, Naina receives one of her own.

videos.title: Kerala ke Banana Chips
videos.overview: Kevin's arrival stirs chaos as Bunty takes a desperate step that shocks the Katarias.

videos.title: Purane Zakhm
videos.overview: Sanjay and Ajay's long-simmering rivalry pushes the Kataria family to the edge.

videos.title: Bunty ka Sach
videos.overview: A painful truth unites the Katarias, but Tyagi's arrival shatters their fragile peace.

videos.title: Ghar Ek Mandir
videos.overview: The Katarias unite against Tyagi, but a final threat puts Kataria Kutir in danger.

tt38286171.name: Unmadham
tt38286171.description: Follows a police constable who reopens a long-forgotten case and experiences an unsettling world where he must determine if the events he's chasing are truly supernatural or something else.

tt37563829.name: Magudam
tt37563829.description: Peaceful medical representative and shipping harbor worker Linga's life changes because of betrayal and conflict in a coastal community.

tt39108319.name: Irumudi
tt39108319.description: Follows an alcohol-addicted father with a violent past who lives peacefully with his daughter beside a waterfall and decides to take Ayyappa Deeksha at her request.

tt44934375.name: Hunkkaar: The Roar
tt44934375.description: When a teenager accuses a revered cult leader of sexual assault, it sparks a national conflict. As the truth unravels, the line between faith and justice blurs.

videos.title: Aarambh
videos.overview: Seventeen-year-old Meenu Rawat accuses spiritual leader Baapji of sexual assault. Newly appointed ACP Jasleen Singh Soin takes charge of the case, and her uphill battle begins.

videos.title: Aastha
videos.overview: Despite resistance and rising violence, Jasleen arrests Baapji. Advocate Bhalerao steps in to represent Meenu. But before the bail hearing, Meenu's father lands in trouble.

videos.title: Shakti
videos.overview: At the bail hearings, the defence attacks Meenu's credibility, claiming she's a habitual liar. Outside, tensions rise as Baapji's son Kashyap gains control.

videos.title: Arth
videos.overview: While exposing the disappearance of a child devotee, Amitabh's career is jeopardised. Jasleen uncovers proof of a ritual, which is in fact an industrial-scale abuse.

videos.title: Yudh
videos.overview: Kashyap mysteriously dies in custody, and Baapji takes advantage of it. Outraged by the orchestrated media narrative, Amitabh helms a movement, appealing to the survivors.

videos.title: Nyaya
videos.overview: The defence presents one last witness to exonerate Baapji, which shocks Meenu. Finally, she takes the stand for the last time, recounting her assault with unflinching courage.

tt33083436.name: Ananthan Kaadu
tt33083436.description: In a turbulent era of intense political unrest, four musical mercenaries rule over dangerous slums, whereupon they navigate complex power dynamics to survive a transformative period in history.

tt41757212.name: Comedy Cooks
tt41757212.description: What happens when comedy meets cooking? Find out as Bhavana and Chef Nalan kick off a fun-filled contest with your favourite stars.

videos.title: The Great Comedy Cook-Off Begins
videos.overview: The stage is set as judges Bhavana and Chef Nalan are welcomed. Chaos erupts as pookies enter to select their cooks, sparking a clash of flavours, entertainment, and kitchen drama!

videos.title: Cook Against the Hindrance Clock
videos.overview: The culinary battle begins where hindrances disrupt cooks and pookies as they struggle to cook, turning the kitchen into chaos, fun and hilarious fights unfold.

videos.title: Chaos, Comedy and a Grand Win
videos.overview: Twinkle kicks off a fun-filled episode as teams form through carrom and dive into chaotic tasks. Amid laughter and struggles, Suchitra and Gandharvan emerge victorious.

videos.title: Battle for Cook of the Week
videos.overview: Cooks face constant challenges as they battle chaos to create authentic Kerala dishes and impress the judges. Excitement peaks as the first Cook of the Week is announced.

videos.title: Advantage Task  Spectacle
videos.overview: Twinkle kicks off the exciting episode by welcoming the Cooks and Pookies on stage. Watch as contestants compete fiercely in the advantage task and celebrate the winners.

videos.title: Mega Cooking Round Fiesta
videos.overview: The Cooks and Pookies take part in the cooking challenge during the Mega Cooking round. Don't miss the excitement, challenges, and chaos as they battle it out in this episode.

videos.title: Ultimate Elimination Kickoff
videos.overview: Twinkle kicks off the episode, igniting the stage with a fiery elimination round start. Don't miss the Cooks and Pookies locking horns in a fun-filled, exciting advantage task.

videos.title: Heat in the Comedy Kitchen
videos.overview: The Pookies ignite the stage as they back the cooks in a fiery elimination round. Cook of the week gets crowned while someone faces elimination in the rising heat.

videos.title: Family Fun Battle
videos.overview: Cooks and their family members face a fun-filled challenge with laughter, chaos, emotional moments, and unexpected twists as the best team wins.

videos.title: Family Cook-Off Challenge
videos.overview: Cooks compete with their loved ones, presenting cherished family dishes. The kitchens turn intense as judges taste and score, blending emotion, tradition, and rivalry.

videos.title: Hilarious Advantage Round
videos.overview: In a chaotic advantage task, pookies struggle to eat falooda while cooks try to feed them, leading to hilarious chaos, foul play, and laughter. Watch to see who wins the advantage.

videos.title: Flavours of Arabian Challenge
videos.overview: The Pookies and the Cooks light up the stage in the Arabian Dishes Round despite a hindrance challenge. Stay tuned to discover who takes the title of Cook of the Week.

videos.title: Acing the Cake Decors!
videos.overview: Pookies showcase their cake decorating skills under the cooks' guidance, sparking fun and fierce competition. Excitement peaks as Twinkle welcomes surprise guests at the end.

videos.title: World Flavours in One Kitchen
videos.overview: Cooks, Pookies and Grandmas take part in the International Fusion Round with fun challenges and kitchen chaos. Their innovative dishes earn praise from the judges.

videos.title: A Star-Studded Kitchen Battle
videos.overview: Serial artists join hands with the Cooks and Pookies, sparking fun and chaos as the advantage task heats up. Also, don't miss Chef Nalan's stunning dance performance.

videos.title: Stakes in the Street Food Round
videos.overview: The guest actors, Cooks, and Pookies work hard in the Street Food round, preparing dishes. Judges Nalan and Bhavana make an unexpected declaration of winners and eliminations.

videos.title: The Ultimate Egg Hunt
videos.overview: The competition takes an exciting turn as the contestants race to collect Golden Eggs. The excitement reaches new heights as Chef Pillai joins the show as the special guest.

videos.title: Exotic Chicken Culinary Challenge
videos.overview: A thrilling cooking challenge unfolds with exotic chicken dishes, fun obstacles and teamwork. Creative flavours and smart execution earn praise from the judges.

videos.title: Wildcard Reveal Sparks Excitement
videos.overview: Twinkle starts the show with a thrilling wildcard entry reveal, leaving contestants excited. Cooks and Pookies compete by grinding rice using traditional stone grinding methods.

videos.title: Rustic Recipes and Tough Decisions
videos.overview: Ramya and Bhavana light up the kitchen with their fun-filled partnership in the Village Cooking Round. Emotions soar as a shocking elimination leaves everyone heartbroken.

videos.title: Ultimate Kids Fun Extravaganza
videos.overview: The judges reveal the new face of the game, splitting the Cooks into Blue and Yellow teams. Don't miss out on the fun advantage task in this kids' special episode.

videos.title: A Healthy Feast for the Little Ones
videos.overview: The kitchen buzzes as Cooks and Pookies whip up healthy treats for little guests. Don't miss this fun-filled episode packed with laughter and cute moments.

videos.title: The Advantage Challenge
videos.overview: Twinkle welcomes the shining stars of Asianet as the fun begins. Watch the teams compete in the cow-milking advantage task and see who gains the upper hand.

videos.title: The Ultimate Dairy Face-Off
videos.overview: The competition heats up with the Dairy Product Round and unexpected hurdles. Stay tuned to see who rises above the competition and is crowned Chef of the Week.

videos.title: Cousins Step into the Arena
videos.overview: Twinkle welcomes the stars of the Cousins and Kalyanams web series to light up the stage. Later, the teams lock horns in a thrilling battle for the advantage task.

videos.title: The Recipe Swap Challenge
videos.overview: The cooks face a surprise recipe swap and challenging hindrance tasks in a thrilling cooking battle. Don't miss the emotional elimination that brings the week to a close.

videos.title: Semi-Finale Week Showdown Begins
videos.overview: Twinkle launches the Semi-Finale Week with a shocking twist, and Asianet stars bring extra energy to the stage. Witness the fun-filled Advantage Task and a big winner reveal.

videos.title: The Great Jackfruit Battle
videos.overview: The semi-final heats up as the contestants showcase their culinary skills in the Jackfruit Festival Challenge. Enjoy the laughter, heartfelt moments, and quick recipes.

videos.title: Semi-Final Extravaganza
videos.overview: Twinkle kicks off the semi-final episode with an electrifying welcome. Don't miss the thrilling game-changing Advantage Task and the special Eastern Sambar Challenge!

videos.title: The Penultimate Kitchen Battle
videos.overview: Semi-Finale 2 heats up with the Common Ingredient Task as contestants battle for glory. The journey takes an emotional turn as the judges announce the elimination.

videos.title: A Spectacular Finale Dhamaka
videos.overview: Twinkle welcomes everyone to the much-awaited grand finale. Asianet Stars set the stage on fire with a spectacular performance. Get ready for an unforgettable fun extravaganza.

videos.title: Crowning the Kitchen Champion
videos.overview: The grand finale of Comedy Cooks brings a thrilling flavour battle with actress Urvashi and Chef Damu. The finalists compete for glory as the winner's trophy awaits its champion.

tt35836025.name: Vishwanath and Sons
tt35836025.description: Sanjay Vishwanath has devoted decades to excellence as an international shooter. When age, family duties, and an unexpected romance collide with his ambitions, he must confront what truly makes a life worth living.

tt32474264.name: Korean Kanakaraju
tt32474264.description: Possessed by a Korean spirit, Kanakaraju must navigate his new supernatural identity to protect his family and solve the spirit's murder.

tt35929525.name: Shaque: Trust No One
tt35929525.description: A mother receives yearly photos of her missing child. After nine years of searching, she discovers the truth about the abduction lies not far away, but hidden among her closest circle.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: After their newborn disappears from the hospital, Anvita and Alok receive disturbing birthday packages each year that keep the search alive.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: A potential lead forces Anvita to question her search for her missing daughter. Meanwhile, Madhu escalates her efforts to halt the investigation.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Anvita's suspicions grow as she examines an old photo for clues, while her visions intensify. A mysterious death raises flags for Inspector Khurana.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: An unexpected confession adds a new layer to the case. Apeksha's birthday party is thrown into turmoil when Anvita makes a shocking accusation.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: A threatening message deepens the rift between Anvita and Alok while she seeks crucial evidence. The police track down a woman tied to Rhea's birth.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: As the mystery behind Anvita's hallucinations unravels, Madhu finds herself cornered. A tragic incident disrupts the investigation.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Shreya's revelation begins to connect the pieces of Apeksha's disappearance as the truth finally comes to light.

tt39300072.name: Anbe Diana
tt39300072.description: Set in Perambur, a local Telugu youth falls for an Anglo-Indian girl, sparking a chaotic and humorous clash of cultures between their families.

tt39818587.name: Newton's 3rd Law
tt39818587.description: Follows an investigation into a double murder in 1999, with unexpected characters roped into the case as they search for justice amid intrigue and secrets.

tt27548557.name: Dhamaal 4
tt27548557.description: A century-old hidden treasure drives greedy individuals to risk everything, landing them in dangerous situations that test their resolve and relationships.

tt43511957.name: India Ke Top 1%
tt43511957.description: 1-2 ka 4, ya 4-2 ka 1? Hosted by Anil Kapoor, this top-tier quiz show is all about logic and reasoning, where 100 contestants vie to enter the elite 1% club!

videos.title: India's Biggest Game Show Begins
videos.overview: Meet the 100 extraordinary contestants from every walk of life, all chasing a chance to take home up to ₹1 crore. Watch a contestant make history tonight!

tt36580813.name: Pluto
tt36580813.description: Vicky, down on his luck after multiple failed businesses, accidentally befriends an alien named Pluto. Both considered losers, they navigate life together while a gang of thugs attempts to capture the alien.

tt37161651.name: Chennai Love Story
tt37161651.description: Two young people navigate their first experience of love, dealing with its powerful emotions and obstacles while discovering the delicate nature of newfound romance.

tt33354945.name: Gandhari
tt33354945.description: Follows a mother's relentless pursuit to find and rescue her kidnapped daughter, exploring themes of revenge and redemption amidst her harrowing journey.

tt46182660.name: Family Full House with Rohit Sharma
tt46182660.description: Family Full House with Rohit Sharma features Indian cricketer Rohit Sharma making his television hosting debut on Sony TV. The family-focused game show brings competing families together for fun, survey-based trivia infused with Rohit's signature laid-back wit and humor.

videos.title: Mumbai Punters vs Team Vibe
videos.overview: The show kicks off as Shreyas Iyer leads the Mumbai Punters against Kunal Khemu and his Team Vibe in a trivia and banter-filled clash.

videos.title: Bollywood Stars Take Over Family Full House
videos.overview: Sidharth Malhotra and Tamannaah Bhatia bring their respective teams for an entertaining showdown packed with games and lighthearted roasts.

videos.title: Dhawan & Paul Bring The House Down
videos.overview: Shikhar Dhawan and host-actor Maniesh Paul face off alongside their friends and family for an energetic comedy and quiz round.

videos.title: Suniel & Neha Turn Up The Fun
videos.overview: Suniel Shetty and Neha Dhupia bring their teams for a lively showdown with Rohit Sharma, packed with fun, laughter, and thrills.

videos.title: Vlogger Family vs Dhurandhar Family
videos.overview: Archana Puran Singh's "Vlogger Family" competes against Rakesh Bedi's "Dhurandhar Family" in a battle of survey trivia and stage antics.

videos.title: Bharti and Harssh Join The Fun
videos.overview: Bharti Singh and Harssh Limbachiyaa join Rohit Sharma with their teams, sparking an entertaining showdown packed with laughter and unexpected twists.

videos.title: Krushna And Ankita's Battle Of Fun
videos.overview: Krushna Abhishek and Ankita Lokhande join Rohit Sharma with their teams for a lively showdown packed with humor, fun, and nonstop entertainment.

videos.title: Jamnadas Majethia and Aatish Kapadia Join Rohit Sharma
videos.overview: Jamnadas Majethia and Aatish Kapadia join Rohit Sharma with their teams for a lively showdown packed with humor, fun, and nonstop entertainment.

videos.title: Mika And Shehnaaz Bring The Fun
videos.overview: Mika Singh and Shehnaaz Gill join Rohit Sharma with their teams for a lively showdown packed with laughter, fun and entertaining moments.

videos.title: Neha Kakkar And Abhijeet Sawant Take The Spotlight
videos.overview: Neha Kakkar and Abhijeet Sawant join Rohit Sharma for a vibrant evening filled with soulful music, fun interactions and nonstop entertainment.

videos.title: Team Lolo vs Team Aakhri Pasta
videos.overview: Team Lolo and Team Aakhri Pasta face off in a fun-filled showdown, bringing laughter, teamwork and plenty of playful competition.

videos.title: Remo D'Souza & Friends Join The Narayan Family
videos.overview: Remo D'Souza and friends join the Narayan family for a fun-filled get-together. With Rohit Sharma leading the way, laughter and surprises await.

tt39260895.name: Pyaar Prema Kalyanam
tt39260895.description: When a bride refuses to leave her family home after marriage, her husband must find out if he can adjust to life under his in-laws' roof.

tt37537340.name: Srinivasa Mangapuram
tt37537340.description: Vasu Babu and Manga are living in their own blissful world, until a ruthless threat targets their romance. As powerful enemies move to separate them, Vasu must fight for his woman.

tt40600219.name: Pochamma
tt40600219.description: An old mansion has a history. Something terrible happens when people mess with a statue. This causes a shock. People get scared. They start finding out hidden secrets and lies. When they finally know the truth, will it make things better or make things worse forever?

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: At the foothills of Andhra, an old mansion carries a past tied to the goddess Pochamma. When a businessperson desecrates a sacred idol, things begin to go wrong, leading to a shocking tragedy. But is it truly divine wrath or something else hiding beneath it all?

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: As the investigation deepens, tensions inside the mansion start to surface.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: As interrogations intensify, strange things begin to happen inside the mansion. With tensions rising, is something supernatural truly at work?

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: The truth takes a dark turn. But how far it will go?

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: The truth finally comes out. In the end, the mansion falls silent once more, holding its secrets.

tt11378946.name: Michael
tt11378946.description: The early life of musician Michael Jackson, from the discovery of his talent as the lead of the Jackson Five to the artist whose creative ambition fueled a pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world.

tt33539520.name: Neagley
tt33539520.description: Neagley, drawing from her experience with Jack Reacher and the 110 Special Investigators, embarks on a perilous mission to expose a sinister threat, risking her life to unravel the mystery.

videos.name: L Train
videos.overview: When Neagley's childhood friend, Tommy, dies after walking into an oncoming train, the police are ready to label this as an apparent accident. But after receiving a mysterious message from the deceased, Neagley knows something is amiss.
videos.description: When Neagley's childhood friend, Tommy, dies after walking into an oncoming train, the police are ready to label this as an apparent accident. But after receiving a mysterious message from the deceased, Neagley knows something is amiss.

videos.name: Team Building Exercises
videos.overview: With Neagley's investigation into the suspicious death of her childhood friend, Tommy Crane, hitting countless roadblocks, a long-buried secret from Neagley's past threatens to upend everything she once knew of her childhood.
videos.description: With Neagley's investigation into the suspicious death of her childhood friend, Tommy Crane, hitting countless roadblocks, a long-buried secret from Neagley's past threatens to upend everything she once knew of her childhood.

videos.overview: Amrita worries about how Vasudha would react, but the mother surprises her daughter. Problems brew around Neeraj's dream project and with Vasudha's health.

videos.title: Maiyya ki Odhaniya
videos.overview: Vasudha's death shatters the family. Being the eldest, everyone expects Amrita to step up, but she feels lost.

videos.title: Yeh Din Bhi Dhal Jaayenge
videos.overview: Amrita loses herself in added responsibilities, but Aditya tries to cheer her up. Meanwhile, Neeraj's problems at work spill over onto his home life, alarming Amrita.

videos.title: We Need You, Papa
videos.overview: Amrita confronts her father again, but he still struggles by himself. Finally, Aditya and Amrita convince Neeraj to go for therapy.

videos.title: Beti Hokar...
videos.overview: Amrita's memories of her father are tainted by his death. Neeraj's last words to the world make her feel hurt and betrayed.

videos.title: Reham
videos.overview: Amrita tries to hide the tragic news of their father's death from her siblings. But what happens when Abhinav and Preeti go missing from school?

videos.title: Maan-Swabhimaan
videos.overview: Amrita's uncle Naveen is arrested for a cheque bounce case. When she tries to free him, she discovers the overwhelming debt of the company. Finally, Aditya provides a solution.

videos.title: Seekh Jaaungi!
videos.overview: Amrita decides to fight her battle alone. In a meeting with the lenders, she declares that she would take over her dad's business and gets seven days to submit the project report.

videos.title: Jahan Kheli Gudiya Khilaune
videos.overview: Aditya inspires a worried Amrita through a bike ride. Shock awaits Amrita as court orders her to vacate the house in two days, and the relatives decide to separate the siblings.

videos.title: Uss Raah Par Badhte Jana Hai
videos.overview: Fearing separation, the siblings flee to Adi's house. Amrita learns Abhinav is job hunting, and moved by his resolve, she decides to seek work from Makrand Aagrwal herself.

videos.title: Kaise Nibhau (Piya) Pyaar Tera
videos.overview: Amrita gets a job and finds a house for rent. After relatives scorn her relationship with Aditya, Amrita asks him to stay away. Later, she and her siblings vacate their house.

videos.title: Yeh Raah Nahi Asaan
videos.overview: Amrita, with her siblings, shifts to Raja ki Mandi. But, the kids are unable to adjust to the surroundings. Shock awaits Amrita when Aditya goes missing.

videos.title: Shaadi Kar Lete Hain
videos.overview: After Amrita finds Aditya, he proposes marriage to her. Amrita gets late on her first day at work. She is shocked when Aditya’s mother shares an alternate arrangement with her.

videos.title: Adjustment Ya Compromise
videos.overview: Nisha convinces Amrita to accept the marriage arrangement. Aditya helps Amrita solve her office issue. Later, Amrita accepts Aditya’s wedding proposal.

videos.title: Ek Vichitra Shaadi
videos.overview: Adi dreams of a future with Amrita, while Nirmala fears society will label her son a live-in son-in-law. Elsewhere, Amrita struggles to balance work and time with Adi's family.

videos.title: Kashmakash
videos.overview: Amrita misses the family dinner due to work-life balance struggles. Nirmala is upset, but Adi patiently waits for her to return so they can eat together.

videos.title: Laate Ho Pyaar Kahan Se
videos.overview: Upset with Aditya, Nirmala distances herself from the wedding preparations. Amrita realises that she is the reason for the growing rift between Aditya and his family.

videos.title: Azaad Kar Diya...!
videos.overview: Aditya feels guilty to see his mother upset. Amrita is shattered when, after business meeting, the lenders decide to sell her dad's company. Amrita’s call leaves Nirmala in shock

videos.title: Shart
videos.overview: When Amrita's loan is denied, she deliberately ends her marriage with Adi. Despite his efforts to mend things, she insults his mother, pushing Adi to lose his temper and walk away.

videos.title: Consultation Fees
videos.overview: Upon discovering that Adi covered for Abhinav at the health camp, Amrita compensates him, turning payment into an insult. Later, Neeta brings a proposal for Adi, which he accepts.

videos.title: Shuruat
videos.overview: Amrita and Aditya try to move on in life. At work, Amrita impresses Makrand. Amrita coincidentally bumps into Shraddha and learns that she is meeting Aditya for a future alliance.

videos.title: Tu Door Nazar Aaye
videos.overview: Aditya confesses his love for Amrita to Shraddha. Nisha wants Amrita to wish Aditya on his birthday. But, when Amrita sees Aditya with Shraddha, she decides to step back.

videos.title: Happy Birthday
videos.overview: Aditya is hurt that Amrita didn’t wish him on his birthday. He challenges her to attend his birthday dinner with Shraddha. Later, Shraddha is convinced that Amrita has moved on.

videos.title: Chot
videos.overview: Aditya’s family is happy as Shraddha says yes. Makrand suggests Amrita wear a gold ring for luck. Seeing Aditya’s concern for Amrita, Shraddha releases that he has not moved on.

videos.title: Bharat Ki Beti
videos.overview: Shraddha confronts Adi and Amrita while Adi promises to forget Amrita and move on. Makrand supports Amrita, and she gains approval to restart her late father’s project.

videos.title: Khoya-Paya
videos.overview: Amrita begins the project with a ritual, unaware of the site manager and union leader's sinister plan. Meanwhile, Adi apologises to Shraddha for being distracted all the time.

videos.title: Akeli Hoon, Kamzor Nahi
videos.overview: Amrita cleverly outwits the union leader by distributing individual cheques. He attempts to assault Amrita, resulting in Adi getting hurt while trying to save her from the attack.

videos.title: Kasak
videos.overview: Shraddha's father learns of Adi's past in the hospital and wants to cancel the wedding. Adi insists the engagement proceeds, and Amrita accidentally reaches the engagement venue.

videos.title: Faisla
videos.overview: Amrita's attendance at her cousin's engagement ends in humiliation. Shraddha confronts Adi just before their engagement when his injury flares up.

videos.title: Woh Wali Train
videos.overview: Amrita deliberately pushes Adi away. A disheartened Adi lands up on a train where a miracle happens.

videos.title: Harzana
videos.overview: Shraddha's father demands compensation, which leads to a conflict within the Dixit family. However, Nirmala puts her foot down.

videos.title: Yaar Hai Uska
videos.overview: Adi offers to tutor Amrita's siblings. At work, Amrita feels something is amiss in Makrand's life. Prashant enters Amrita's life.

videos.title: Friend ya Boyfriend
videos.overview: Amrita meets investors for a possible joint venture. Although Prashant helps her, he starts instigating Abhinav against Adi.

videos.title: Jaanane Laga Hoon
videos.overview: Adi and Amrita's closeness infuriates Prashant. Amrita tries to buy a mobile phone but stops herself because it's expensive. However, the next day, someone delivers it to her.

videos.title: Tohfa
videos.overview: Amrita shares her suspicions with Adi about Prashant, who approaches her for a job in her company. After failing to find the anonymous gift-giver, Adi finally gets a break.

videos.title: Shaq aur Jhooth
videos.overview: Adi tells Amrita about the mobile bill, and she goes to confront Prashant. Amrita finds out about Makrand's secret life. Meanwhile, at work, Amrita's absence infuriates Prashant.

videos.title: Saazish
videos.overview: Furious after hearing Adi tell Amrita to fire him, Prashant tampers with his bike. While the police suspect Adi’s accident was planned, Prashant makes another attempt to kill him.

videos.title: Aap Beeti
videos.overview: Amrita gets Prashant arrested for causing Adi's accident. She approaches Makrand, who assigns his best lawyers to help her. Madhu creates chaos as her brother is taken to custody.

videos.title: Main Maiyya Hoon Teri
videos.overview: Madhu accidentally uncovers Prashant's hidden truth. While she stands by Amrita in court, she credits Nirmala for showing her the reality. Later, Amrita finds a mother in Nirmala.

videos.title: Legal Notice
videos.overview: Adi and Amrita long for each other when Nirmala invites her to her place. Amrita scolds Makrand on discovering his hidden lifestyle. Adi’s sister sends him legal notice.

videos.title: Dooriyan
videos.overview: Amrita tries to bridge the rift between Adi and his sisters, but Smriti refuses to accept her. Amrita gets a letter from Singhals and becomes the boss of Adi's brothers-in-law.

videos.title: Madam Ji
videos.overview: Sanjay and Ashish refuse to take the audit report deadline seriously. Realising that personal and professional lives should be kept separate, Amrita turns a task master.

videos.title: Happy Rakhi
videos.overview: Amrita saves the situation when Sanjay and Ashish face the ire of the management for their shoddy work. While Smriti and Neeta apologise to her, Abhinav runs away from home.

videos.title: Daayra
videos.overview: Adi and Amrita find Abhinav at the station, where Adi finds out Abhinav's concerns about their relationship. Meanwhile, Amrita faces trouble for standing by her ethics.

videos.title: Be Practical
videos.overview: Adi makes Amrita understand Abhinav's problem. With Abhinav’s help, she brings an ailing Makrand to her house. Later, Makrand learns about the condition put forth by the Singhals.

videos.title: Intezaar Nibhayenge Hum
videos.overview: As Ammu and Adi grow closer, a promise keeps them apart. Years later, their bond endures and hope for a new beginning grows until an unexpected crisis threatens everything.

tt38267486.name: Nooru Sami
tt38267486.description: Selvi, a widowed mother, devotes her life to raising her two sons in a conservative village. Years later, unfulfilled life comes back into focus, challenging deep-rooted traditions. As family and society strongly oppose change, Selvi must choose between societal expectations and her own happiness.

tt40617568.name: Waiting Hai
tt40617568.description: Sugam joins the RPF and investigates a Tatkal scam. Hamza and Mama turn booking software into a business, facing rivalry and betrayal. Sugam arrests the agents and tracks Hamza, ending the scam before his escape to Dubai.

videos.title: Kitty Tere Pyaar Mein
videos.overview: Naive young man Sugam moves to Patna with his newly wed wife Princy to join the RPF. His first day doesn't go as planned as his senior officer belittles and bullies him, saying he got the job because of his slain father. In another part of the city, impoverished young guy Hamza fails to impress his love of life, but hacks the railway website and gets her a confirmed train ticket.

videos.title: Scam Ho Gaya Bihar Mein
videos.overview: Sugam and Princy struggle to keep their new marriage afloat with Amma's constant presence. At work, Sugam is given duty as dog handler for local super star Sajjan Kumar's visit, but things go haywire when the dog, a senior ranking cop than Sugam, runs away. Hamza expresses his love, but the girl complains to the principal. Mama learns he hacked the railway website and decides to monetise it.

videos.title: Yatrigan Kripya Dhyaan Dein
videos.overview: Sugam's Amma decides to go back to their village. Excited to start a fresh romantic life with Princy, Sugam tries to book tickets but finds none available in Tatkal. Hamza and Mama spread their software to local agents and get a percentage share. They later realize Bhoora is keeping the bigger chunk. When they confront him, he beats them up.

videos.title: Ek Bihaari Sau Pe Bhaari
videos.overview: Sugam is given the duty of a runner by his senior as revenge for acting smart and flouting orders. But Sugam uses this opportunity to investigate into the Tatkal case. He befriends local tout Bauwa and, with the help of GRP, arrests 200 plus agents, making him a local star. Meanwhile, Hamza and Mama hack into Bhoora's operations, leading to his arrest.

videos.title: Sawaari Samaan Ki Khud Zimmedaar
videos.overview: Sugam gets appreciation from the DRM for the arrests. The DRM announces a new rule - only 4 tickets can be booked from an account in one day to curb illegal booking. Hamza figures the flaw - there is no curb on Tickets per IP address. With the help of local trans-women, he realizes a network can be formed and the business can grow pan India. Dada dies, but not before telling him to be successful.

videos.title: Gale Laga Le Koi
videos.overview: Sugam finally gets to go for his honeymoon. When he returns to Patna, he realizes the ticket issue persists. Hamza and Mama travel across the country with the DRM taking a 50 percent cut, but they are kidnapped by a don who demands their 50 percent. Sugam is disheartened. Hamza falls in love again. Mama indulges in alcohol and sex workers.

videos.title: Relampel
videos.overview: Hamza decides to leave everything and go to Dubai with his new girlfriend. Sugam, with the help of cyber cell and smart police work, tracks down Mama and stumbles upon the work done by trans-women to spread the ticketing software. Mama rats out information on Hamza. After a high-octane chase, Hamza is caught from Patna railway station.

tt35254624.name: Balan: The Boy
tt35254624.description: Follows a teenage boy searching for his missing mother following a turbulent childhood and her subsequent disappearance, exploring his search for closure and the truth about his past.

tt39182439.name: Con City
tt39182439.description: Saravana, Mithra, Jacky, and Janaki, are skilled con artists hiding out as an ordinary family in Mulki, Karnataka. Their quiet life shatters when a young boy in their care is kidnapped, forcing them to use their old hustles one last time.

tt35076988.name: Chinna Chinna Aasai
tt35076988.description: On the enchanting shores of Varanasi, two souls meet by chance. Somewhere within this unfolding chaos, an unspoken bond begins to form, slowly slipping beyond friendship.

tt43202886.name: Ego Raman
tt43202886.description: Follows the toxic relationship between a prospective civil servant and a conceited school principal, which intensifies when a Yamaha motorbike enters the narrative.

tt31862809.name: Heart Beat
tt31862809.description: RK Multispeciality Hospital is a beacon of hope and healing. Its doctors are resilient even when they have to deal with medical and personal challenges.

videos.title: First Day, First Impressions
videos.overview: Five new doctors join RK Hospitals. On the very first day, things go from bad to worse for Reena, making a poor impression on chief doctor Radhi.

videos.title: Doctor Drama
videos.overview: Reena and Rocky are tasked to work with Dr Ramanadhan, aka Cinema Doctor. The doctors are in a tizzy when a child ends up with breathing issues that they can't diagnose.

videos.title: Tug Of War
videos.overview: When a surgery becomes problematic, Dr. Ravi freezes during the procedure. Sid leaves a drawing for Radhi inside her laptop, but the busy doctor fails to notice it until Reena helps.

videos.title: Notes To Night
videos.overview: It's not all work for our doctors as senior doctors Ravi and Anitha throw a celebratory party. Amidst drinks and merriment, Arjun and Reena reconnect.

videos.title: Heartbeats and Hangovers
videos.overview: The doctors experience the aftereffects of the party. A bad fall lands RK in the hospital. He meets the new doctors and learns about Arjun's 'love' interest.

videos.title: Doubt and Denial in the Shadows
videos.overview: Radhi gets furious when Reena voices her doubts about RK's medical condition. A concerned RK confides in Radhi. Dejected, Reena chastises Arjun.

videos.title: Repaired Connections
videos.overview: Reena feels disheartened as her colleagues shun her. Rocky apologises to her for RK's case. As she reconciles with Arjun, in the hospital, RK receives alarming news from Radhi.

videos.title: Mistake
videos.overview: Radhi gets furious with Reena for treating her son during a medical emergency. Realising her mistake, she tries to make amends with Reena. But a shocking news leaves her shattered.

videos.title: Facing Reality
videos.overview: Reena likes a flat and decides to move in immediately. Arjun learns about his father's condition. Reena sticks to her ground, unnerving Radhi.

videos.title: Home Transition
videos.overview: Ravi feels troubled during a surgery. Reena shifts to her new house. But what happens when she learns about another doctor in the neighbourhood?

videos.title: Unforgiving Heart
videos.overview: The past refuses to let Arjun forgive RK despite his health condition. Radhi tries to meet Reena but in vain. Rocky 'falls' for Reena, but is she interested?

videos.title: Emotional Roller-coaster
videos.overview: A criminal who is recuperating tries to escape from the hospital. As the situation gets tense, Reena steps in to handle the offender.

videos.title: Fulfilling Wishes, Finding Love
videos.overview: Reena breaks down after an exhaustive day at work. Ravi fulfils Jagan's last wish. An impressed Anitha kisses Ravi, leaving him confused.

videos.title: Doubts in Diagnosis
videos.overview: Ravi's confrontation leaves Anitha upset. Teju wins an opportunity to assist Radhi in a complicated surgery. However, was Radhi right in her diagnosis?

videos.title: Unmasking the Threat
videos.overview: Reena's first surgery is a success. She reprimands Arjun after discovering the truth about him. Radhi learns about the unknown enemy, a threat to her hospital.

videos.title: House Party
videos.overview: The doctors gather at Reena's house for a party. Some uninvited guests join in to multiply the fun. Rocky tries to woo Reena. But is she interested?

videos.title: Healthcare Urgency
videos.overview: Radhi decides to investigate more about MNM Hospital. Arjun tries to help during an emergency case at the hospital.

videos.title: Looming Danger
videos.overview: Teju learns about the looming threat to the hospital. Reena has to reflect on her abandoned childhood to help a teenager take the right step.

videos.title: Stealth Mission
videos.overview: Radhi has to relive her past trauma as she convinces Vinusha's father to forgive his daughter. The interns help Arjun to do the unthinkable.

videos.title: Battlefront Courage
videos.overview: The unknown enemy has shown his face. But can he win against the spirit of the doctors at RK Hospital?

videos.title: New Alliance
videos.overview: Madan has a new ally while Arjun starts getting involved in hospital management. Arjun has a squabble with Reena over their relationship.

videos.title: Alzheimer's Mystery
videos.overview: Teju begins her game as she gives a piece of advice to Arjun. Reena drops an Alzheimer’s patient home and is surprised to learn his identity.

videos.title: Hopeful Hearts
videos.overview: Anitha is shocked when Ravi reveals a secret. When Arjun seeks RK's permission to get involved in the hospital's activities, he feels hopeful about their relationship.

videos.title: Heartbreaks and Favours
videos.overview: Anitha has a heartbreak. RK seeks a favour from Radhi. Both Radhi and Arjun aim to protect the hospital but are they on the same team?

videos.title: CEO's Rise
videos.overview: Amidst internal doubts and external threats, RK Hospital faces a pivotal decision. Will Radhi thwart Arjun's rise to CEO, or will RK's plan secure the hospital's future?

videos.title: Paths to Leadership
videos.overview: Dev gets caught between defending his children and facing a harsh reality. Amidst personal and professional challenges, Radhi attempts to mentor Arjun as RK Hospital's potential CEO.

videos.title: Preparing for Destiny
videos.overview: As Radhi prepares Arjun for a pivotal task, personal and professional worlds collide as secrets unravel at the hospital, friendships are tested, and unexpected connections emerge.

videos.title: Comedy and Chaos
videos.overview: A furious Anitha seeks revenge. As Radhi juggles Teju's interference, Arjun's revelation leads to a game-changing conference at RK Hospital. Meanwhile, love is in the air.

videos.title: Rekindled Connections
videos.overview: Arjun rekindles the relationship with his father as they go on a fun outing. Reena's childhood friend pays a surprise visit to the hospital.

videos.title: Unexpected Insights
videos.overview: Radhi feels defeated as Arjun's pitch gets approved by the board. Dev helps a frustrated Radhi comprehend the situation. Rocky becomes a guest in his dinner plan with Reena.

videos.title: Complimented Impact
videos.overview: Radhi acknowledges Arjun's work. Anitha sets clear boundaries for Ravi. As RK opens his heart out to Reena, his compliment shocks her.

videos.title: Breaking Barriers
videos.overview: Reena confronts RK about his compliment. Arjun gets closure as he gathers the courage to talk to RK about Pallavi. The well-guarded secret of Radhi and Reena starts to crack.

videos.title: Protecting the Past
videos.overview: Sarada, the landlady, gets restless and tries to learn about Reena's past. Naveen makes a blunder that would put his career at risk, but Teju takes a drastic step to protect him.

videos.title: Heartbeat Moments
videos.overview: Ravi asks Guna and Rocky for a favour. Sarada invites Dev's family for dinner. While Rocky struggles to convince a patient's family for surgery, things get tense between Guna and Naveen.

videos.title: Hope In Recovery
videos.overview: Rocky manages to convince the tribals for surgery, but they have a condition. RK uses his experience to save Naveen's patient. Will Naveen get a second chance?

videos.title: The Perfect Plan
videos.overview: Sarada executes her plan to perfection, making both Radhi and Reena restless. A confused Reena tries to get out of the complex situation.

videos.title: Midnight Mischief
videos.overview: Radhi and Reena feel overwhelmed when the latter joins Radhi and her family for dinner. Sid and Divi make Reena part of their midnight mischief.

videos.title: Heart-to-Heart Conversations
videos.overview: Arjun proposes a celebration for the hospital's 20th anniversary. Anitha decides to talk to Ravi after her chat with Bharathi. Reena gets cornered by the interns about her night out.

videos.title: Ethnic Elegance
videos.overview: The hospital wears a festive look on the day of its anniversary. The doctors turn up in ethnic wear. However, the happiness is short-lived as tragedy strikes RK Hospital.

videos.title: Memories of a Mentor
videos.overview: The hospital mourns the demise of RK. Everybody reminisces their pleasant memories with him. Anitha feels flustered when Ravi opens up about his marriage.

videos.title: Clear Waters, Clear Words
videos.overview: Radhi takes care of Reena when she falls ill. Reena learns about Sarada's lie and confronts her. As Ravi and Anitha are back to being best friends, Bharathi encounters Anitha.

videos.title: Emotional Tokens
videos.overview: Anitha is irked as Ravi steals her thunder. Radhi orders Naveen to assist Aruna who obliges. As Reena bids goodbye to Radhi's family, Sid's gift makes them emotional.

videos.title: Journey of Healing
videos.overview: Reena compels Arjun to go out with her to help get him out of mourning. Anitha's frustration grows as Ravi gets credit for her hard work.

videos.title: The Art of Persuasion
videos.overview: Arjun comes back to the hospital and announces his arrival with a speech. The power dynamic gets interesting as Radhi approves Ramanathan's request despite Arjun rejecting it.

videos.title: Power Play
videos.overview: Sid and Divi ask Reena for a favour. Laya bids goodbye to Rocky. When Arjun confronts Radhi for overruling him, she firmly states that he is not the CEO of the hospital.

videos.title: Unexpected Revelations
videos.overview: The team is shocked to learn about Guna's father. Arjun gets irked when Reena tries to defend Radhi. Ravi confronts Anitha and she informs him about Bharathi's feelings.

videos.title: Clash of Egos
videos.overview: Ravi scolds Bharathi, but Anitha decides to move on. Arjun tries to prove a point, and Radhi puts him down with facts. Things turn ugly between Ravi and Anitha.

videos.title: Corporate Twist
videos.overview: Reena helps Sid get into the football team. The race for the post of the CEO takes an interesting turn when Madan makes a grand entry into the hospital.

videos.title: Team Dynamics
videos.overview: Radhi announces that two interns will become resident doctors by the end of the year and explains how they will be evaluated. She makes it clear to Madan that she is not his ally.

videos.title: Mentor Rivalry
videos.overview: Ravi and Anitha get competitive as they mentor the interns. Guna is unhappy when a celebrity dancer is admitted to the hospital. Dev grows curious as the kids lie about Reena.

videos.title: Privacy Breach
videos.overview: Teju reckons that Reena and Guna's diagnosis might be wrong. Jennifer tries to spend time with Guna. Bharathi confronts Anitha for revealing her secret to Ravi.

videos.title: Rivalry Victorious
videos.overview: Dev confronts Reena about her visit to the kid's school. As Teju cracks the case and takes it over from Reena and Guna, Ravi feels victorious.

videos.title: Strife and Solidarity
videos.overview: Reena argues with Radhi regarding a case. Charu seeks Rocky's help to plan a party. While Madan fails to manipulate Arjun, the group reunites as Guna and Naveen bury the hatchet.

videos.title: Emotional Breakdown
videos.overview: Dev runs into Ganesh and realises that Reena lied to him. In the hospital, Reena breaks down as she fails to save the baby. Radhi consoles her and gives her some advice.

videos.title: Social Tensions
videos.overview: The interns manage to get Radhi's permission to attend the party. Ravi rants to Arjun as things get tense with Anitha and Bharathi. As everyone is having fun, Naveen ends up in a spot.

videos.title: Babysitting Chaos
videos.overview: Dev tells Radhi about the lies of Reena and the kids. Reena and Arjun babysit Divi and her friends. As Radhi and Dev look for Divi, the situation goes out of hand in the pool.

videos.title: Tensions Rise
videos.overview: Radhi gives an ultimatum to the kids. When Ganesh learns of the incident, he confronts Radhi. While Madan and Teju team up again, Ravi apologises to Bharathi.

videos.title: Walk Together
videos.overview: Upset, Reena opens up to Arjun. While Rocky and Guna fight for a patient, Ravi attends to an ex-military officer. Arjun takes Reena for a walk and tries to comfort her.

videos.title: Cop Encounter
videos.overview: Guna and Rocky go out of their way to impress Kevin, but land in trouble with the cops. Babloo and Divi make a plan to apologise to Reena.

videos.title: Sneak Attempt
videos.overview: Radhi and Reena blame each other for what happened. Rocky seeks Reena's help to fulfil Kevin's wish. However, chaos ensues at the girl's hostel, landing them in trouble.

videos.title: Hospital Shock
videos.overview: Reena falls head over heels for Arjun as he takes her on a surprise date. While Teju is looking for an opportunity, a patient's unexpected death shakes the hospital.

videos.title: Chaos Advantage
videos.overview: Arjun and Anitha console Bharathi as the police take Ravi for questioning. Madan takes advantage of the entire situation. Divi and the kids outsmart Dev to apologise to Reena.

videos.title: Hospital Whispers
videos.overview: Jennifer opens up to Guna when he confronts her. Ravi feels low as everyone gossips about him. While Radhi advises Ravi not to handle critical cases, Bharathi gets a lead.

videos.title: Desperate Measures
videos.overview: Bharathi gets anxious to spot Anitha comforting Ravi. Madan resolves to dismiss Ravi, leaving Radhi feeling helpless. As Arjun is frantic to stop the arrest, Bharathi cracks the case.

videos.title: Hospital Politics
videos.overview: Ravi ploys to get close to Bharathi. Guna happily bonds with his mother. While Arjun and Madan agree on the need for a CEO in the hospital, a high-profile patient creates an uproar.

videos.title: Diagnostic Debate
videos.overview: Aruna motivates Naveen when Radhi challenges the interns to find a solution for Meera's case. Naveen comes up with a better course of treatment. What will be Radhi's decision?

videos.title: Past Actions, Present Consequences
videos.overview: The board seeks nominations for the CEO's role, and Arjun and Madan are shocked to see Radhi in the race. Anitha mocks Ravi for his past actions as she gets credit for a tough surgery.

videos.title: Tension in the Ranks
videos.overview: Irked with Ravi, Bharathi plays a prank on him. Arjun gets anxious as he learns about Madan's plans. Ravi mocks Rocky as he gets into an awkward situation with Laya and Charu.

videos.title: A Surprising Request
videos.overview: Reena seeks Rocky's help in her plan to propose to Arjun. While Asha throws tantrums about Jennifer being in Guna's hospital, Naveen gets shocked by Meera's request.

videos.title: Unwanted Attention
videos.overview: Arjun feels awkward as his past love stories become the central topic during the team's campus visit. Wary about risking his career again, Naveen refuses to comply with Meera's plea

videos.title: Failed Attempts
videos.overview: Ravi is shocked as Bharathi gets her visa. Arjun tries to make peace with Radhi but in vain. Naveen manages to confide in Radhi about Meera's case, but how will she react to him?

videos.title: Picture Mystery
videos.overview: Dev asks Radhi about a kid's photo in the closet. Teju figures out why Madan is in a hurry to take over the hospital. As Reena decides to propose to Arjun, he learns a shocking truth.

videos.title: Shattered Hopes
videos.overview: Arjun breaks up with Reena, leaving her shattered. Naveen thanks Radhi for trusting him and apologises for his mistake. Reena opens up about her past to Rocky.

videos.title: Misinterpreted Feelings
videos.overview: The entire hospital gathers to honour Yazhini. Ravi confesses his feelings to Bharathi but she gets irked. Guna admits the truth when Asha confronts him about Jennifer.

videos.title: Unexpected Encounters
videos.overview: Kishore overhears a shocking revelation. Radhi gets anxious after a complaint gets lodged with the medical board. As the interns discuss the leak, Madan has a surprise visitor.

videos.overview: Naveen confronts Madan for misusing the data he provided. Jennifer asks Reena about her family. The medical board acts in favour of the hospital, but Radhi is curious about the leak.19

videos.overview: The hospital enters a crisis mode as all the patients start showing side effects. As the doctors finally figure out the issue, Arjun blames Radhi for the fiasco.

videos.overview: Radhi stands her ground when Arjun calls out her hypocrisy. Sonia and Rocky's plan to reunite Arjun and Reena fails. Ravi feels dejected by Bharathi's decision to leave for the US.

videos.overview: Ravi seeks Anitha and Arjun's help to plan the wedding, while Guna makes Reena volunteer from Bharathi's side. Reena confronts Arjun and makes a startling disclosure.

videos.overview: Naveen gets tense as Teju doubts him. Arjun surprises Reena. Naveen fails in Nidhun's surgery, and lashes at the interns. Ravi and Anitha take their relationship to the next level.

videos.title: Tracing the Leak
videos.overview: Teju gets curious as Radhi seeks Arjun's help to trace the leak. Naveen bids an emotional goodbye to his friends but Radhi has a surprise for him.

videos.title: A Web of Lies
videos.overview: The interns decide not to help each other in the competition. Radhi confronts Reena if Rocky knows about them. Reena ends up in a tussle with Dev.

videos.title: Party Under Pressure
videos.overview: The competition gets intense as the interns go all out to win. Teju begins to suspect Madan and Naveen. Arjun gets nervous as the group meets up for Ravi's bachelor party.

videos.title: Joy and Jeopardy
videos.overview: Anitha calms a nervous Bharathi. The friends cheer as Ravi and Bharathi get married again. One of the intern's family members is admitted to the hospital in a critical condition.

videos.title: A Father's Struggle
videos.overview: Teju breaks down on seeing her father's critical condition. Ravi bids goodbye to Bharathi as she leaves for the US. The board members announce the date for the election of the CEO.

videos.title: The Competition Countdown
videos.overview: Radhi, Madan and Arjun analyse their chances of winning the CEO election. Radhi tells the interns that the winner of their competition will be announced in two days.

videos.title: Cracking the Case
videos.overview: Teju finds a solution to the alcoholic boy's case. Naveen warns Madan when he tries to get help from Teju. Radhi is shocked as Arjun makes a startling revelation.

videos.title: Unveiling the Mole
videos.overview: Radhi gets anxious as she tries to find out who the mole is. She announces the winner of the competition, but things get tense as she confronts the interns about Arjun's revelation.

videos.title: The Final Showdown
videos.overview: The D-Day finally arrives. All three CEO contenders present their action plan for the hospital. As things heat up, the big secret gets out in the open.

videos.title: Deadlock Drama
videos.overview: The board members announce the results, and it's a tie. They suggest a unique solution. Arjun's revelation spreads throughout the hospital, and Reena lashes out at him.

videos.title: Lines Drawn
videos.overview: Radhi is anxious but doesn't have the courage to open up to Dev. Reena makes her stance clear to Arjun when he tries to explain.

videos.title: The Truth Strikes
videos.overview: Dev confronts Radhi and creates a scene at Reena's house. Arjun tells Teju about the board's decision regarding her. When she tells Naveen, he makes a startling revelation.

videos.title: The Final Encounter
videos.overview: Radhi breaks down in front of Reena and begs her to leave. At the railway station, Reena finally meets the person she has been searching for years and makes a decision.

videos.title: New Beginnings, Old Wounds
videos.overview: Resigned from her job, Radhi tries to find solace at home. Reena, now a senior resident, has a tiff with Arjun, the new CEO. Everyone gears up to welcome a fresh batch of interns.

videos.title: A Second Chance
videos.overview: Teju, now working in a modest clinic, is firm about not forgiving Naveen. While Radhi struggles to adapt to a new life, a dejected Madan considers suicide.

videos.title: Acts of Repair
videos.overview: Preetham assigns a high-profile case to Reena with an ulterior motive. Radhi meets Teju when she tries to save a man's life. Divi and Sid plan to reunite their estranged parents.

videos.title: Breaking Point
videos.overview: Anitha feels slighted when Reena gets control of her patient's case. A long-awaited family outing turns disastrous when Dev publicly lashes out at Radhi.

videos.title: Chain Reaction
videos.overview: Radhi begins visiting Teju's clinic for an unusual reason. Preetham gets upset with Reena when Arjun confronts him about the unjust work allotment for the nurses.
