Just as the gang scrambles for a champion amongst themselves, the kidnapper from previous episode returns, setting the stage for a chaotic showdown as multiple gangs converge on their office, all focused to destroy them.

videos.title: Aan Paavam
videos.overview: A 40-year-old woman shocks the gang by requesting an ad in their newspaper putting herself up for adoption after being abandoned by her children. A new interested party pressures them to sell their newspaper, sparking a rift between Veera and Azhagu.

videos.title: Iruvar
videos.overview: After an intense fight, Azhagu quits Namma Seidhi, leaving the gang in shock. While dealing with the fallout, a vlogger drags the newspaper into an expose, accusing it of promoting low-quality restaurants and calling it a scam. Will Veera and Azhagu bury the hatchet to save the paper, or is this the end of Namma Seidhi?

videos.title: Nizhal Nijamaagiradhu
videos.overview: An anonymous source approaches the gang with news before it happens. Initially wary, they decide to publish his stories, and after missing the first-which proves true-the second one boosts their PR. As trust in the source grows, could this partnership save their sinking newspaper, or his good deeds too good to be true?

videos.title: Naalaya Seidhi
videos.overview: After a major story from the new source backfires, nearly driving away all their advertisers, the gang discovers the identity of the puppet master behind the chaos. He has a clear agenda: to buy Namma Seidhi as cheaply as possible by playing as dirty as possible.

videos.title: Makkal Aatchi
videos.overview: The gang makes the biggest blunder in the history of Newsprint -printing empty pages that reach the community. But a stroke of luck turns the mistake into a symbol of protest. Will they survive the fallout, or is this truly the end of Namma Seidhi?

tt42316559.name: Ramani Kalyanam
tt42316559.description: Follows a visually impaired girl and a boy who cannot walk as their lives intersect through a matchmaking arrangement.

tt33334267.name: Bharat Bhhagya Viddhaata
tt33334267.description: Inside Cama Hospital, one of the sites targeted during the 2008 Mumbai terror attacks, nurses, ward boys, cleaners, lift operators, security personnel, and administrative workers keep 400 people alive while armed assailants struck the city around them.

tt38195069.name: Tumm Se Tumm Tak
tt38195069.description: Anu, a kind 20-year-old, and Aryavardhan, a resolute 45-year-old businessman, defy societal norms and family resistance, overcoming struggles to demonstrate that love transcends age or boundaries.

videos.title: Aryavardhan and Anu's First Meet
videos.overview: Raised in a middle-class family, Anu lives with her parents, Gopal and Pushpa. Aryavardhan, a noted businessman known for being extremely punctual, meets Anu for the first time on his way to an event.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Boosts Anu’S Confidence In College
videos.overview: College students mock Anu, who comes on stage to give a speech, but Aryavardhan encourages her. At the suggestion of some students, Aryavardhan gives Anu a blank cheque, showing his trust in her.

videos.title: The Blank Cheque Fuels Pushpa’S Greed
videos.overview: Anu tells Gopal and Pushpa about the blank cheque, sparking greed in Pushpa. The next morning, Anu visits Aryavardhan’s office to return it, only to be shocked by an empty envelope.

videos.title: Can Anu Stop Pushpa From Depositing The Cheque?
videos.overview: Meera ousts Anu from the office. Aryavardhan learns of it and makes Meera apologise. Anu, worried about the lost cheque, rushes to the bank with Gopal after learning that Pushpa went to deposit it.

videos.title: Anu Returns The Cheque To Aryavardhan
videos.overview: Meera gives Anu a written apology. Anu returns Aryavardhan’s cheque, prompting him to set a condition in exchange. She calms an infuriated Pushpa, but the neighbourhood women mock Pushpa.

videos.title: Anu’S Family Arrives At Aryavardhan’S Party
videos.overview: Anu, Pushpa and Gopal face humiliation at Aryavardhan’s party entrance until he arrives and takes them in. During the event, Aryavardhan asks Anu to launch the new product herself.

videos.title: Meera Insults Gopal At The Party
videos.overview: At the party, Meera gets Gopal drunk and has him humiliated. Aryavardhan scolds Meera for her behaviour and apologises to Gopal. Later, he makes a promise to Anu.

videos.title: A Special Party For Aryavardhan
videos.overview: Anu collects money to host a party for Aryavardhan. Meanwhile, he cancels a meeting to spend time with her, upsetting Meera. Jhende keeps an eye on them but soon loses track.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Experiences A Simple Life With Anu
videos.overview: Aryavardhan experiences a simple life with Anu. Later, he saves her from an accident, but Raghu, the father of a suitor coming to see Anu, sees them on the street.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Gives Anu A Job
videos.overview: Raghu visits Anu’s house and refuses to get his son Vipin married to her. Aryavardhan arrives, scolds Raghu, and offers Anu a job. The next day, Raghu returns to her house with a secret motive.

videos.title: Anu’S First Day At Work
videos.overview: Raghu explains to Rajni the motive behind marrying Vipin to Anu. Meanwhile, Aryavardhan promotes Meera and makes Anu her assistant. However, Anu makes a mistake on her first day.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Changes The Office Rule For Anu
videos.overview: Aryavardhan surprises Meera and others by changing an office rule for Anu. She tries to put Anu down during introductions, but Aryavardhan defends her by revealing her strengths.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Lashes Out At Anu
videos.overview: Anu pays off Gopal's debt and protects him from humiliation. While Meera plots to get Anu fired, Aryavardhan lashes out at Anu for bringing champa flowers in the office.

videos.title: Meera Fails To Get Anu Fired
videos.overview: Meera believes that her plan to get Anu fired will succeed. However, Anu exposes worker exploitation at Aryavardhan’s factory, prompting him to assign her a new responsibility, leaving Meera stunned.

videos.title: Has Aryavardhan Fallen In Love With Anu?
videos.overview: Aryavardhan is shocked to learn that Anu is engaged to Vipin. Jhende makes him realise that he’s fallen for Anu, but also discourages him from pursuing the relationship.

videos.title: Meera Grows Jealous Of Anu's Relationship With Aryavardhan
videos.overview: Gopal opposes Anu’s marriage to Vipin and returns Raghupati’s gifted fridge. Meanwhile, Jhende shares news with Aryavardhan. Meera grows jealous seeing Aryavardhan dine with Anu.

videos.title: Harshvardhan Fires Anu From Her Job
videos.overview: Aryavardhan's brother Harshvardhan comes to the office, but Anu stops him from meeting Aryavardhan. In anger, Harshvardhan orders Anu to be fired and informs Aryavardhan about it.

videos.title: Anu Keeps Her Job Loss A Secret At Home
videos.overview: Relying on Anu’s job, Pushpa buys an expensive saree for her on installments. Anu hides the fact that she has lost her job. The next day, she calls Aryavardhan, but Meera disconnects the call.

videos.title: Anu Realises She Is Falling For Aryavardhan
videos.overview: Anu realises she is falling for Aryavardhan and prays to the Goddess for clarity. Soon, Aryavardhan arrives at the temple, finds Anu, and asks her to come to the office the next day.

videos.title: Anu Is Reinstated At Work
videos.overview: Bholi’s husband gifts her a scooter, but Pushpa accidentally damages it. Meanwhile, Aryavardhan convinces Harshvardhan to rehire Anu, who invites him to a religious gathering.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Visits Anu For 'Mata Ki Chowki'
videos.overview: Anu decorates a doll resembling Aryavardhan for 'Mata ki Chowki'. When he visits her home, he invites his foreign delegates to join him. Seeing the doll, Aryavardhan questions Anu’s feelings for him.

videos.title: Meera Fumes At Aryavardhan's Praise For Anu
videos.overview: Aryavardhan praises Anu for her saree, sparking Meera’s jealousy. Determined to win his attention, Meera sets a plan in motion. Meanwhile, Raghupati schemes to marry Anu off to Vipin.

videos.title: Anu Shares Her Feelings With Simran
videos.overview: Gopal refuses to take help from Raghupati. Anu tells Simran that she has fallen in love with Aryavardhan. Meanwhile, Pushpa plans Anu’s marriage with Bipin and then visits Aryavardhan’s office.

videos.title: Pushpa Invites Aryavadhan For Dinner
videos.overview: At Pushpa's invitation, Aryavardhan visits Anu's house for dinner. Pushpa sends Anu and Gopal out of the house on some pretext and talks to Aryavardhan about Anu's marriage.

videos.title: Siddhi Mata Predicts Anu's Marriage
videos.overview: Pushpa requests Aryavardhan to persuade Anu to marry Bipin. The fortune-teller Siddhi Mata predicts Anu's marriage, and later, Anu decides to find out Aryavardhan's marital status.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Asks Anu Her View On Marriage
videos.overview: Meera scolds Anu for trying to find out about Aryavardhan’s personal life. Aryavardhan asks Anu for her opinion about marriage. Later, FM, a peon, tells Anu something, which shatters her.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Comes Home For A Puja
videos.overview: Anu prays for a way to resolve her dilemma, and Siddhi Mata comes to her doorstep. Aryavardhan's mother organises a puja, and he arrives at home to attend it. Simran asks Anu to look into Mrs Vardhan.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Finds Out About Anu
videos.overview: Aryavardhan gives a gift to his mother. Pushpa calls Aryavardhan to talk about Anu's marriage, and Aryavardhan's mother misunderstands the situation. Later, she asks Jhende about Anu.

videos.title: Anu Is Shocked To Hear Aryavardhan's Words
videos.overview: Aryavardhan calls Anu to meet him, but when Gopal learns that it’s part of Pushpa’s plan, he gets angry. In her dreams, Anu confesses love to Aryavardhan, but in reality, she is shocked by his words.

videos.title: Gopal Makes A Promise To Anu
videos.overview: Pushpa adds to Anu's pain by flaunting the wedding preparations. Meanwhile, Aryavardhan's mother urges him to understand what's in Anu's heart. Gopal makes a promise to Anu upon learning her decision.

videos.title: Raghupati Gives Pushpa Some Time
videos.overview: Raghupati gives Pushpa eight days to convince Gopal for Anu and Bipin's marriage. When the gas cylinder runs out at home, Anu goes to the office hungry. Meanwhile, Gopal is fired from his job.

videos.title: Pushpa Keeps A Secret From Anu
videos.overview: Aryavardhan sends food for Anu, but she declines, asking him not to worry about her. Gopal conceals his loss of job from the family, while Pushpa hides a secret from Anu, who eventually uncovers it.

videos.title: Gopal In Search Of A Job
videos.overview: Aryavardhan convinces Anu to let go of her feelings and marry Bipin. Meanwhile, Gopal wanders in search of a job. Anu leaves important office work and sets out with Pushpa to find Gopal.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Is Pained By Anu’S Decision
videos.overview: Anu agrees to marry Bipin in front of Aryavardhan, leaving him pained. Later, a distressed Gopal faints after losing his shop, and Anu and Pushpa rush to his aid.

videos.title: Aryavardhan’S Lonely Journey
videos.overview: Mrs Vardhan advises Aryavardhan to help him overcome his loneliness. Gopal reluctantly talks to Raghupati about Anu and Bipin’s alliance, while Anu approaches Meera for help.

videos.title: Anu Accepts Meera's Condition
videos.overview: Meera offers Anu financial help on a condition, which Anu accepts. As Aryavardhan longs for Anu, he unexpectedly shows up at the family gathering where her wedding date is being set.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Arrives To Help With Anu’S Wedding
videos.overview: Aryavardhan visits Raghupati’s house as Anu and Bipin’s wedding date is set. He later asks Anu’s family to let him assist with the preparations and opens up about his past.

videos.title: Anu Allows Aryavardhan To Stay At Her Home
videos.overview: Aryavardhan requests to stay at Anu’s home until her wedding, but she agrees with a condition. When the moment is right, Anu questions him, and Aryavardhan discovers Raghupati’s ploy.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Decides To Stop Anu's Wedding
videos.overview: Pushpa avenges Gopal's insult by confronting Subhash. Aryavardhan discovers Raghupati's real motive and decides to stop Anu and Bipin's wedding. The next morning, he takes everyone jogging.

videos.title: Harshvardhan Refuses To Grant Leave To Anu
videos.overview: Mansi complains to Aryavardhan's mother about his absence from the office for the past three days. At Meera's behest, Anu arrives at the office to apply for leave but Harshvardhan refuses to grant it.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Helps Anu Choose A Mangalsutra
videos.overview: Aryavardhan comes along with Pushpa and Gopal to the jewellery store, while Anu convinces Harshvardhan to grant her leave. She arrives at the store, where Aryavardhan helps her choose a mangalsutra.

videos.title: The Neighbours Speak Ill About Anu
videos.overview: While Aryavardhan returns from shopping with Anu's family, a beggar recognises him, and he assigns a task to Jhende. Seeing Aryavardhan with Anu, the neighbours start gossiping about them.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Defends Gopal
videos.overview: The neighbours falsely accuse Gopal. Aryavardhan teaches them a lesson, and everyone celebrates Independence Day. Preparations begin for Janmashtami at Aryavardhan’s home, and he tells a lie to Meera.

videos.title: Meera Visits Anu’S House
videos.overview: Anu decides to care for her parents even after her marriage, while Aryavardhan overhears Raghupati sharing a plan with Rajni. When Meera visits Anu’s home to learn about Aryavardhan, Anu grows uneasy.

videos.title: Raghupati's Truth Is Exposed To Anu's Family
videos.overview: Aryavardhan alters one of his company's policies, leading Raghupati to break Anu and Bipin’s alliance. Pushpa pleads with him, but after discovering his true motive, she lashes out.

videos.title: Thoughts About Anu Trouble Aryavardhan
videos.overview: Pushpa breaks Anu and Bipin’s alliance, earning Gopal’s praise, and everybody then celebrates Janmashtami. Later, Anu writes her feelings in a diary, while thoughts about her trouble Aryavardhan.

videos.title: Subhash Gives Gopal His Job Back
videos.overview: Anu’s family decides to throw a party to thank Aryavardhan. Out of fear of Aryavardhan, Subhash gives Gopal his job back. Later, Anu tries to give Aryavardhan a love letter.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Fails To Meet Anu’S Family
videos.overview: Anu, Gopal and Pushpa wait for Aryavardhan at the restaurant, but Jhende keeps him from going there. Soon after, the manager insults them and throws them out.

videos.title: Anu’S Wait Ends In Heartbreak
videos.overview: Anu gets sad as Aryavardhan doesn't show up at the restaurant. Meanwhile, he locks himself in a room, and Manasi vows to uncover the secret of that room. Meera stirs up trouble for Anu at the office.

videos.title: Anu's Proposal For The Investors
videos.overview: Pushpa and Rajni get into an argument. Meanwhile, Anu seeks Gopal's help for a presentation at office and puts forth a proposal for increasing sales for Rajnandini Sarees before the investors.

videos.title: Siddhi Mata Predicts Aryavardhan’S Future
videos.overview: Siddhi Mata tells Mrs. Vardhan about Aryavardhan’s future. Hearing Aryavardhan praise Anu, Mrs. Vardhan expresses a desire to meet her. Later, Aryavardhan finds a way to pacify Anu’s anger.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Is Saddened To See Anu With Bipin
videos.overview: At office, Aryavardhan praises Anu and then asks her to type an apology letter to the Sharma family on his behalf. Later, he sees Anu with Bipin and feels disheartened.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Fumes At Anu
videos.overview: Aryavardhan yells at Anu at the office. When she asks him to take his medicine, he gets furious. But after Anu gets hurt, he gently bandages her wound. Later, he regrets his behaviour.

videos.title: Anu Arrives At Gopal's Shop For A Survey
videos.overview: Anu visits Gopal’s shop with the investors for a survey. Gopal surprises Pushpa with a thoughtful gift. Aryavardhan tracks Anu’s location and meets her there, while Raghupati sees them together.

videos.title: Pushpa's Suspicion About Anu And Aryavardhan
videos.overview: Pushpa and Gopal see Anu with Aryavardhan, and Pushpa gets suspicious. The investors praise Anu, leaving Meera annoyed. While returning home, an FM program reminds Aryavardhan of Anu.

videos.title: Ravi Complains To Meera About Anu
videos.overview: Raghupati shows Rajni a video of Aryavardhan and Anu, revealing his plan. Meanwhile, Anu firmly responds to investor Ravi for speaking against Meera. Upset, Ravi calls Meera to complain about Anu.

videos.title: Meera Scolds Ravi After Learning The Truth
videos.overview: Meera complains to Aryavardhan about Anu, and he authorises her to fire her. But after learning the truth, Meera scolds Ravi instead. Meanwhile, Mansi lashes out at Harshvardhan and insults him.

videos.title: Siddhi Mata Gives Pushpa A Solution
videos.overview: Jhende urges Aryavardhan to stay away from Anu and make a decision. Meanwhile, Siddhi Mata offers Pushpa a remedy for Anu’s marriage worries.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Tells Anu To Join Another Branch
videos.overview: Aryavardhan promotes Anu and asks her to join another branch, but she gets upset and leaves the matter to Goddess Durga. Siddhi Mata then urges both Anu and Mrs Vardhan to visit a temple.

videos.title: Anu’S Family Decides To Visit The Temple
videos.overview: Worried about Harshvardhan, Mrs Vardhan urges Aryavardhan to accompany her to the ancestral temple. Anu’s family decides to go there too. Bipin tells Simran a plan to reunite Anu and Aryavardhan.

videos.title: Anu’S Family Sets Out For The Jivdani Temple
videos.overview: Simran and Bipin’s plan to unite Anu and Aryavardhan gets foiled. Anu’s family leaves for the Jivdani temple, while Aryavardhan’s hope of meeting her begins to fade.

videos.title: Bheem Kaka Advises Aryavardhan
videos.overview: Mansi stops Aryavardhan from going to the temple with Mrs Vardhan. Meanwhile, Anu’s family arrives there. Hoping for a miracle in a bid to meet Anu, Aryavardhan receives advice from Bheem Kaka.

videos.title: Will Anu's Wish Be Fulfilled?
videos.overview: Anu’s family performs a puja at the temple, where Mansi clashes with Pushpa. Mrs Vardhan feels a sense of connection with Anu. Just as Anu makes a heartfelt wish to the Goddess, Aryavardhan arrives.

videos.title: The Goddess Unites Anu And Aryavardhan
videos.overview: Aryavardhan hides his face upon seeing Anu at the temple, but Anu senses his presence. Later, he seeks answers to his dilemma from Mrs Vardhan, while Anu prepares to leave for Jaipur.

videos.title: Aryavardhan’S Betrayal Hurts Anu
videos.overview: Pushpa and Gopal plan to stop Anu’s transfer. Hurt by Aryavardhan’s betrayal, Anu arrives at the office, where Meera surprises her. Anu recalls her first meeting with Aryavardhan and his advice.

videos.title: Anu Leaves For Jaipur After A Promise To Gopal
videos.overview: Jhende advises Aryavardhan to forget Anu. Meanwhile, Anu reveals Aryavardhan's betrayal to Simran. She makes a promise to Gopal and leaves for Jaipur after bidding everyone adieu.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Tries To Stop Anu From Going To Jaipur
videos.overview: Aryavardhan chases Anu’s bus to stop her from going to Jaipur, but Anu stands firm and questions him. Meanwhile, Jhende uncovers something troubling and grows anxious.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Rescues Anu From Trouble
videos.overview: Upset with Aryavardhan, Anu gets off the bus midway and lands in trouble, but Aryavardhan rescues her. Later that night, they stay at a hotel, where Anu gives him a gift.

videos.title: Anu Learns About Aryavardhan's Feelings
videos.overview: Aryavardhan pours his heart out before a sleeping Anu, who is delighted to hear his words. Jhende finally tracks them down and sends Anu home. However, Gopal gets furious on seeing her.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Slaps Jhende
videos.overview: Meera pours her heart out to Jhende. Gopal suspects Aryavardhan’s intentions. Jhende and Aryavardhan argue over Anu. In a fit of anger, Aryavardhan slaps Jhende, and the latter makes a firm decision.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Tries To Placate An Upset Jhende
videos.overview: Aryavardhan tries to appease Jhende, stressing on Jhende's importance in his life. Meanwhile, Gopal asks Pushpa to stop Anu from working, but Anu convinces him to let her keep the job.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Announces A Casual Day At The Office
videos.overview: Mrs Vardhan mentions a girl, and Aryavardhan assumes it’s Anu. He announces a casual day at the office and waits for Anu. Later, Mansi’s relative Neel joins the office.

videos.title: A Conspiracy Against Anu
videos.overview: Aryavardhan welcomes Anu at the office. In her neighbourhood, gossip about their relationship angers Gopal. Later, Anu is shocked to find her presentation data missing.

videos.title: Meera Gives Anu A Deadline To Find The Data
videos.overview: Meera gives Anu 24 hours to recover the data, but with one condition. Anu tries to recover it with Neel’s help. Meanwhile, Jhende grows suspicious of Meera and confronts her.

videos.title: Neel Tries To Befriend Anu
videos.overview: Mrs Vardhan urges Aryavardhan to marry. Neel tries to befriend Anu, while Meera sees her plan working. Later, Anu and Aryavardhan fondly recall each other while having kadhi chawal.

videos.title: Anu’S Presentation Inspires Aryavardhan
videos.overview: Anu impresses investors with her presentation and earns Aryavardhan’s praise. Later, she delightedly thanks him for wearing the tie she gave him.

videos.title: Meera's Ploy To Separate Aryavardhan From Anu
videos.overview: Anu misses lunch with Aryavardhan, upsetting him. Jhende grows suspicious of Neel and warns him. Meanwhile, Meera plots to poison Aryavardhan's mind against Anu.

videos.title: Pushpa Invites Neel Over For Tea
videos.overview: Neel helps Pushpa tackle an insolent municipality officer, and she invites him over for tea. Jhende confronts Meera about her scheme to unite Neel and Anu. That night, Aryavardhan pays Anu a visit.

videos.title: Mrs Vardhan Becomes Suspicious Of Mansi
videos.overview: Gopal overhears women maligning Anu over Aryavardhan's visit. Mansi’s praise of Neel rouses Mrs Vardhan’s doubts over her intentions. Later, Mrs Vardhan insists on meeting Anu at Aryavardhan's office.

videos.title: Aryavardhan's Demand Shocks Meera
videos.overview: Meera lies to Mrs Vardhan to keep her from meeting Anu. Aryavardhan shocks Meera by insisting Anu join him in London for a conference. He then makes an announcement, and Anu reveals a secret to Neel.

videos.title: Gopal Forbids Aryavardhan From Taking Anu To London
videos.overview: Jhende visits Anu’s house to collect her passport documents. Learning of the London conference, Gopal confronts Aryavardhan and forbids him from taking her along. Anu then runs into Siddhi Mata.

videos.title: Neel Secretly Informs Mansi And Meera
videos.overview: Raghupati and Rajni push Pushpa into protesting and plot to stop the municipal workers from clearing the garbage. Meanwhile, Anu visits Aryavardhan, and Neel quietly tips off Mansi and Meera.

videos.title: Meera Sends Neel With Anu For Pushpa's Bail
videos.overview: Framed by Raghupati and Rajni, Pushpa is arrested for protesting against a municipal officer. Meera informs Anu and sends Neel to help Pushpa. Meanwhile, Mrs Vardhan offers advice to Aryavardhan.

videos.title: A Nightmare Grips Anu And Aryavardhan
videos.overview: Aryavardhan learns of Pushpa’s arrest and scrambles to the prison. Neel is put behind bars, while Mansi justifies her actions to Mrs Vardhan. Later that night, a nightmare grips Aryavardhan and Anu.

videos.title: An Old Foe Plans An Attack On Aryavardhan
videos.overview: Aryavardhan and Anu perform Kanjak Puja at their homes. An old foe vows to kill Aryavardhan. Later, Siddhi Mata gives Anu an amulet and asks her to tie it on Aryavardhan’s wrist.

videos.title: Jhende Confronts A Dark Realisation
videos.overview: Meera prevents Anu from visiting the office on Dussehra, leaving her crushed. Jhende is shaken by a dark realisation, and a bad omen ensues. Meanwhile, Aryavardhan’s foe walks free from prison.

videos.title: Jhende Sneakily Films Anu And Neel
videos.overview: Meera sends Anu to a godown, but Neel comes to Anu’s aid. Anu follows Aryavardhan's car yet fails to meet him. Jhende then films her with Neel. Soon, an unexpected visitor arrives to meet Anu.

videos.title: A Threat To Aryavardhan’S Life
videos.overview: Aryavardhan tells Anu that he wants her to share the office duties with Harshvardhan. Later, Jhende tells Aryavardhan about Jalandar’s plan to take his life and stops him from going to London.

videos.title: Jalandar Threatens Jhende
videos.overview: Jhende forces Aryavardhan to make him comply with his demand. He also confiscates Aryavardhan’s phone to save him from Jalandar. Later, Jalandar threatens Jhende.

videos.title: Aryavardhan’S Mistake Gives Jalandhar An Edge
videos.overview: Jhende is stunned when Meera says that Aryavardhan isn’t in London. Neel swaps phones with Anu to trace him, and Aryavardhan’s slip-up unexpectedly helps Jalandhar.

videos.title: Jalandhar Visits The Vardhan Residence
videos.overview: Jhende discards Aryavardhan’s SIM card and warns him of Jalandhar tracking him. Neel visits the Sharmas as Jalandhar heads to the Vardhan residence. Jhende then alerts Aryavardhan about this.

videos.title: Anu Learns About Aryavardhan's Whereabouts
videos.overview: Jhende keeps Aryavardhan confined while Anu learns he is still in Delhi and pleads to meet him. Meanwhile, Mansi argues with Meera over Harshvardhan, and Jalandhar’s aide watches Anu closely.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Plans To Meet Anu
videos.overview: Gopal and Pushpa appreciate each other’s efforts after swapping roles. Aryavardhan learns of Anu’s Karvachauth fast and agrees to meet her, unaware that Jalandhar’s aide is snooping on her.

videos.title: Anu Seeks Simran's Help To Hide Her Fast
videos.overview: Anu picks a gift for Aryavardhan and seeks Simran’s help to hide her fast from Gopal. Rajni finds an unexpected friend while, Aryavardhan plans to disguise himself as a delivery boy to meet Anu.

videos.title: A Sniper Aims His Gun At Aryavardhan
videos.overview: As the moon rises, Anu suspects that Aryavardhan might not arrive to meet her. However, Aryavardhan shows up, and they both end their fast. Meanwhile, a sniper aims his gun at Aryavardhan.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Challenges Jalandhar
videos.overview: Jhende learns of Aryavardhan’s escape as Anu ties Siddhi Mata's amulet on his wrist. The sniper's shot at Aryavardhan is interrupted. Soon, Aryavardhan boldly challenges Jalandhar in defiance.

videos.title: Jalandhar Poses As An Autorickshaw Driver To Trick Anu
videos.overview: Jalandhar, disguised as an autorickshaw driver, takes Anu to her exam. Aryavardhan arrives at the college to wish her luck and learns of Jalandhar’s misadventure. Elsewhere, Raghupati badmouths Anu.

videos.title: A Disguised Jalandhar Visits The Sharmas
videos.overview: Aryavardhan lies to Pushpa about the guards and hires a bodyguard for Anu. Disguised as a hermit, Jalandhar visits the Sharmas later that day and urges them to get Anu married.

videos.title: The Sharmas Plan To Get Anu Married To Neel
videos.overview: Jalandhar, posing as a hermit, hints at Neel while discussing an alliance for Anu. The Sharmas then shock Neel with their proposal. Anu then visits a temple with Aryavardhan and runs into Siddhi Mata.

videos.title: Siddhi Mata Cautions The Sharmas
videos.overview: Siddhi Mata meets the Sharmas and cautions them about Anu’s prospective groom. Neel backs out of the marriage and upsets Jalandhar. Later, a deranged old man delivers a chilling warning to Anu.

videos.title: Meera Ruins Aryavardhan’S Dream To Marry Anu
videos.overview: Aryavardhan buys a ring to profess his love to Anu, but his hopes are crushed when he overhears Gopal and Meera discussing Anu’s upcoming marriage to Neel, who’s being forced into it by Meera.

videos.title: Jhende Deceives Aryavardhan
videos.overview: Gopal informs Aryavardhan about Anu and Neel’s impending wedding. Jhende deceives Aryavardhan with a video, urging him to suppress his feelings, and later issues a warning to Anu.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Feels Hurt To See Anu With Neel
videos.overview: Mrs Vardhan visits Anu’s locality, but Jhende misleads her into thinking Anu doesn’t live there, and Simran sees it all. Later, Aryavardhan arrives but leaves after spotting Anu with Neel.

videos.title: Anu’S Disclosure Shocks Aryavardhan
videos.overview: While Gopal and Pushpa are caught up in Diwali prep, Anu arrives at the office to resign. Aryavardhan is stunned when she mentions her talk with Jalandhar and poses a pointed question before leaving.

videos.title: Neel Reveals Jalandhar's Plan To Aryavardhan
videos.overview: Aryavardhan rejects Anu's resignation and sends everyone home except Neel. Tricked by Aryavardhan and Jhende, Neel reveals Jalandhar's plan to give Anu a file about Aryavardhan's past.

videos.title: Jalandhar’S Plan Fails As Aryavardhan Acts Swiftly
videos.overview: Anu’s Diwali rituals stop as Aryavardhan rushes to stop Jalandhar from exposing his past. A smoke bomb helps Jalandhar flee, but Neel’s link stuns everyone, and Aryavardhan makes Anu a promise.

videos.title: Aryavardhan’S Diwali Promise
videos.overview: As Anu knits a sweater for Aryavardhan, he prepares to fulfil his promise to her. Amid Diwali prep everywhere, Meera gets a hint of Aryavardhan and Jhende’s plan to use Neel against Jalandhar.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Confronts Jalandhar On Diwali
videos.overview: On Diwali, Anu hides a surprise for Aryavardhan, who skips his family puja to attend Anu's. Earlier, he confronts Jalandhar with Neel's help, but Jhende's unexpected move changes everything.

videos.title: Gopal Gives A Responsibility To Aryavardhan
videos.overview: Pushpa and Gopal give a gift meant for Anu’s future-husband to Aryavardhan. Later, Aryavardhan is disheartened when Gopal asks him to find a match for Anu.

videos.title: Aryavardhan And Anu Wear Matching Outfits
videos.overview: Aryavardhan wishes Harshvardhan and Mansi on their anniversary and wears clothes that match Anu’s outfit. He then invites Anu to the party in front of Meera. Later, Anu collapses on seeing a file.

videos.title: Truths Unfold As Anu Battles For Life
videos.overview: Aryavardhan rushes Anu to the hospital in his arms, shocking all. At home, Mansi creates a scene to uncover his room’s secret. Meanwhile, Jhende and Aryavardhan stumble upon shocking truths.

videos.title: Anu Sleepwalks Out Of The Hospital
videos.overview: Jhende tells Aryavardhan that Anu saw the file revealing his past. After regaining consciousness, Anu begins sleepwalking, while Aryavardhan misses her during Mansi and Harshvardhan’s party.

videos.title: Anu Faces Danger Over Aryavardhan’S Secret
videos.overview: Anu sleepwalks to Vardhan Mansion, while Mansi demands the key to Aryavardhan’s secret room. A man warns Anu he’ll cheat her and threatens to kill her when she refuses to believe him.

videos.title: Aryavardhan’S Search For Hidden Secrets
videos.overview: Aryavardhan hands over his business to Mansi but scolds her for sending Anu home. Before meeting Anu, he goes to check the file that made her faint. Jhende assures him it’s safely hidden.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Uncovers The Shawl's Secret
videos.overview: Aryavardhan visits Anu to return her shawl, but Anu imagines him proposing her. A CCTV footage later reveals the shawl’s true owner, shocking him, while the eerie events outside his room scare Mansi.

videos.title: Harshvardhan Faints Near The Secret Room
videos.overview: Mansi forces Harshvardhan to open Aryavardhan’s secret room, causing him to faint. Jhende talks to Aryavardhan about Meera’s feelings, while she thinks of plotting to make him break ties with Anu.

videos.title: Gopal's Saree Store Catches Fire
videos.overview: Aryavardhan scolds Mansi for making Harshvardhan open his secret room. She regrets it and returns the key. Simran explains Meera’s coldness to Anu. Gopal is stunned as his saree store catches fire.

videos.title: Gopal Is Tricked Into Signing An Agreement
videos.overview: Subhash fails to get Gopal arrested for negligence, so he tricks him into signing an INR 5 lakh repayment deal. Aryavardhan calls Anu, but Gopal stops her and Pushpa from seeking his help.

videos.title: Anu Plans To Ask Meera For A Loan
videos.overview: Aryavardhan calls Anu but senses she’s hiding something. Anu plans to borrow money from Meera to help Gopal repay Subhash. Meanwhile, Gopal’s neighbours suspect foul play in the fire at his store.

videos.title: Anu Stands Tall As Pushpa Faces Humiliation
videos.overview: Bipin tries to warn Simran about Raghupati’s misdeeds. Later, Anu sees Pushpa being humiliated and takes a bold stand. At home, Mansi’s outburst forces Gayatri to call Aryavardhan.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Is Torn Between His Family And Anu
videos.overview: Tired of Mansi’s constant demands, Aryavardhan asks Harshvardhan to take charge, but he refuses. Later, Aryavardhan tells Gayatri about Gopal’s store and wonders why Anu kept it from him.

videos.title: Meera’S Shocking Claim Puts Anu At Risk
videos.overview: Aryavardhan goes to console Gopal, while Harshvardhan and Mansi take charge at the office. Meera stuns everyone, blaming Anu for a lost tender. Bipin uncovers Raghupati’s secret and alerts Anu.

videos.title: Anu Confronts Raghupati For Setting The Fire
videos.overview: Anu confronts Raghupati for setting Gopal’s shop on fire and resolves to find proof against him. Later, Meera alleges that Anu had leaked the company’s bid and begins an enquiry into the matter.

videos.title: Anu Resigns After Being Accused Of Fraud
videos.overview: Two employees from the office find a bag of money at Anu's house and accuse her of defrauding the company. Hurt by Aryavardhan’s silence, Anu resigns and leaves him deeply saddened.

videos.title: Gopal Learns About Anu’S Dismissal
videos.overview: Meera is shaken when Aryavardhan scolds her and Harshvardhan, vowing to expose whoever framed Anu. After Raghupati reveals Anu’s dismissal, Gopal locks himself in, alarming Pushpa and others.

videos.title: Mansi’S Party Plan And Meera’S Bold Challenge
videos.overview: Mansi throws a party to mark her first day at work. Meanwhile, Kalyani takes Anu to an event management firm for a job interview. Aryavardhan confronts Meera, who demands proof that she framed Anu.

videos.title: Siddhi Mata’S Prophecy For Gayatri
videos.overview: Anu visits Jagdish’s firm with Kalyani, but a surprise event call changes everything. As Gopal mourns his burnt store, Gayatri collapses after meeting Siddhi Mata and urges Aryavardhan to marry.

videos.title: Anu’S Discovery Sparks A Storm
videos.overview: Anu learns Subhash moved sarees before the fire and confronts him with Gopal and Pushpa. Subhash alerts Raghupati, hinting at the mastermind. Meanwhile, Mansi asks Meera to follow up with Jagdish.

videos.title: Anu’S Big Break And Meera’S Silent Move
videos.overview: Anu and Simran face a catering crisis until neighbours rally to help. Meera secretly alters the menu to sabotage Anu. Unaware of this ploy, Aryavardhan steps in, offering Anu hope to succeed.

videos.title: Raghupati’S Goons Outnumber Gopal And Pushpa
videos.overview: During the catering arrangements, Anu’s hostility towards Aryavardhan softens. Meanwhile, Bipin alerts Gopal and Pushpa, who confront Raghupati over stolen sarees. However, his goons outnumber them.

videos.title: Pushpa’S Fierce Battle To Save Gopal
videos.overview: Pushpa battles Raghupati and his goons to save Gopal, while Bipin rushes for help. As police close in on Raghupati, Rajni fears for her family. Aryavardhan plans to skip his party to support Anu.

videos.title: Jhende Alerts Aryavardhan About Anu’S Order
videos.overview: Jhende tells Aryavardhan Anu’s catering is for Mansi’s party, with Meera in charge. Meera shares a key detail with Mansi, while Simran spots Anu with Aryavardhan and fears being seen.

videos.title: Secrets And Chaos Before Mansi’S Big Day
videos.overview: Ganga helps Pushpa prepare for Mansi’s party and notices Anu and Aryavardhan’s bond. Aryavardhan’s revelation and a setback in delivery turn the day into a rollercoaster of emotions.

videos.title: Anu And Aryavardhan Against Mansi’S Rage
videos.overview: Mansi fumes at Gopal, Pushpa and Anu, demanding a public apology for the wrong food. Aryavardhan defends them, and Gayatri realises Anu must be special for him to help despite being an industrialist.

videos.title: Meera Faces Accusations And Fear
videos.overview: Mansi shocks Harshvardhan with claims of Aryavardhan and Anu’s affair. Jhende blames Meera for the party chaos, leaving her shaken. Later, she steps into Aryavardhan’s cabin, dreading confrontation.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Exposes Meera
videos.overview: Aryavardhan exposes Meera’s scheme to frame Anu with bribery and leaks. Meanwhile, Gopal rejoices as Anu and Pushpa confront Subhash, compelling him to accept terms that restore his store.

videos.title: Gopal’S Decision Saddens Aryavardhan
videos.overview: Aryavardhan exposes Meera’s ploy to frame Anu but conceals her name. Gopal’s decision leaves him saddened, while Siddhi Mata urges Gayatri and Pushpa to visit Appe Pashan Murthy for Bhoota Kola.

videos.title: Anu Calls Aryavardhan To Meet Her
videos.overview: At Simran and Bipin’s urging, Anu calls Aryavardhan to meet her while he prepares to profess his love. Meanwhile, Appe Pashan Murthy signals to their parents that they are destined to marry.

videos.title: Aryavardhan’S Confession Halted
videos.overview: Anu’s words halt Aryavardhan’s love confession. She scolds Simran and Bipin for arranging the meet. The next day, ignoring Meera’s resignation news, Aryavardhan visits Anu preparing for an interview.

videos.title: Appe’S Words Change Gopal’S Decision
videos.overview: Gopal rejects Aryavardhan’s offer to Anu as Business Head at Rajnandini Sarees, but Appe’s words sway him. Rajni’s joy fades with Raghupati’s return, and Anu is hurt when Aryavardhan calls her Meera.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Visits Meera's House
videos.overview: Anu waits to sign an agreement in front of Aryavardhan, but Jhende pressures her through Harshvardhan. While Raghupati warns Gopal and Pushpa, Aryavardhan sees something unexpected at Meera’s house.

videos.title: Gayatri Comes To Gopal And Pushpa's Rescue
videos.overview: The corporation seizes Gopal and Pushpa’s goods for unlicensed street trading, but Gayatri intervenes. Later, Aryavardhan shares Meera’s troubles with Anu, while Jhende asks Meera to reform her ways.

videos.title: Meera Tells Bholi To Spy On Anu
videos.overview: Bholi helps Anu get the idea of running an online saree shop. Later, Bholi visits Meera for a job, and Meera tells her to spy on Anu. Elsewhere, Mansi suspects Aryavardhan’s feelings for Anu.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Promotes Anu
videos.overview: Aryavardhan organises a welcome party for someone, and Meera assumes that it is for her. However, Aryavardhan declares that the party is for Rajnandini Sarees’ new business head, Anu.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Hosts A Welcome Party
videos.overview: Jhende tells Meera that Aryavardhan’s has planned a welcome party for her. Simran enlists Bipin's help to boost Gopal’s sales. Aryavardhan makes an announcement at the party that leaves Meera stunned.

videos.title: Gayatri Asks Aryavardhan About Anu
videos.overview: Gayatri questions Aryavardhan about his fallout with Anu while Mansi eavesdrops. Anu tells Simran about Meera confessing her love to Aryavardhan and later asks him about his feelings.

videos.title: Gayatri’S Bold Decision Shocks Mansi
videos.overview: Anu questions Aryavardhan’s love for Meera, and his reply leads to a tender moment. Pushpa and Gopal get a surprise offer, while Gayatri shocks Mansi with her bold decision!

videos.title: Jhende Discovers Meera’S Plot Against Anu
videos.overview: Aryavardhan assigns Anu to host Gayatri’s birthday and office anniversary before flying to London. Meanwhile, Jhende discovers Meera’s plot and warns her to retreat to avoid fresh trouble.

videos.title: Anu’S Call Triggers Mysterious Disturbance
videos.overview: At Aryavardhan’s urging, Anu calls Gayatri for the first time, triggering strange sounds in his secret room. Jhende tells Meera how Anu impressed Aryavardhan’s family with Gayatri’s birthday plans.

videos.title: Meera Plots To Ruin Anu's Gift For Gayatri
videos.overview: After Bholi’s update, Meera drives Raghupati to ruin Anu’s hand‑painted saree for Gayatri. Yet, destiny delivers it to Gayatri, while an unaware Anu anxiously searches, troubled by its loss.

videos.title: Meera Plots To Stop Anu From Meeting Gayatri
videos.overview: Mansi steals from Anu’s home to convince Gayatri of her affair with Aryavardhan. Meera ropes in Raghupati for a ploy to stop Anu from meeting Gayatri, while Aryavardhan plans a surprise for Anu.

videos.title: Anu Faces Meera’S Wrath
videos.overview: Mansi brings Aryavardhan’s sweater as proof of his affair. An emotionally hurt Pushpa leaves with money, worrying Gopal. Later, Anu faces Meera and Raghupati’s wrath on her way to Gayatri’s house.

videos.title: Anu Faces A Tough Question
videos.overview: Gopal is shocked to hear Bholi say that Anu was brought home unconscious. Pushpa arrives just then. Anu hides her pain from Gayatri and confides in Aryavardhan before facing a tough question.

videos.title: Anu's Attire Upsets Aryavardhan
videos.overview: Pushpa asks Anu to wear a specific outfit, and Anu confides in Meera, who fumes at the praise Anu receives. At the party, Gayatri meets Anu, and Aryavardhan is upset that she ignored his gift.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Dances With Anu
videos.overview: Aryavardhan remains aloof from Anu during Gayatri’s birthday celebration. Meanwhile, Meera plots to dance with Aryavardhan during a game, but he ends up dancing with Anu.

videos.title: Anu Saves Aryavardhan From Meera’S Attack
videos.overview: Aryavardhan inadvertently becomes the target of Meera’s attack at the party, but Anu saves him. Gayatri praises Anu in front of everyone, while Jhende instigates Aryavardhan against her.

videos.title: Meera Plots A Scandal To Humiliate Anu
videos.overview: Meera plots a photo scandal to humiliate Anu, but Pushpa defends her. Aryavardhan struggles with his feelings for Anu. Later, Meera lures Anu to her house and shocks her with a display of photos.

videos.title: Meera Plants A Doubt In Anu’S Mind
videos.overview: Meera plants a doubt about her and Aryavardhan’s relationship in Anu’s mind. Tearful, Anu spills out her dilemma before Aryavardhan. Gayatri decides to visit Anu’s home after a chat with Siddhi Mata.

videos.title: Gayatri Meets With An Accident
videos.overview: Aryavardhan confronts Meera for switching Anu’s dress. Later, Meera learns about Gayatri’s plan to visit Anu’s house and gives Raghupati the task to stop her. Gayatri meets with an accident.

videos.title: Anu Offers To Donate Blood To Gayatri
videos.overview: Anu takes Gayatri to the hospital. Raghupati tells Meera that he had inadvertently caused Gayatri’s accident. Though Mansi blames Anu for the accident, Anu decides to donate blood to Gayatri.

videos.title: Anu’S Sacrifice And Meera’S Dark Secret
videos.overview: Anu bravely risks her life and donates blood to save Gayatri, while Meera secretly pays Raghupati for the accident. Later, Anu’s stern words shock Aryavardhan, leaving him speechless.

videos.title: Siddhi Mata Warns Anu Of Pushpa’S Trouble
videos.overview: Gopal grows wary of Pushpa’s behaviour after the car damage, while Meera and Raghupati dread exposure. The next day, Siddhi Mata warns Anu that Pushpa may soon face serious trouble.

videos.title: Pushpa’S Car Is Linked To Gayatri’S Accident
videos.overview: Gopal panics as Jhende’s men reveal that Pushpa’s car was involved in Gayatri’s accident. Mansi turns Harshvardhan against Anu, while Aryavardhan’s words at the office leave Anu conflicted.

videos.title: Gopal’S Surrender Sparks Chaos
videos.overview: Gopal suspects Pushpa ran over Gayatri and surrenders at the police station. Meera uses Mansi to provoke Harshvardhan, but Jhende steps in to save Gopal.

videos.title: Mansi’S Cutting Question Silences Aryavardhan
videos.overview: Harshvardhan cancels Gopal’s bail as Mansi humiliates Anu’s family. Aryavardhan arrives to help, but Mansi’s question silences him, while Raghupati and Meera savour the triumph of their ploy.

videos.title: Aryavardhan’S Anguish, Meera’S Deception
videos.overview: Aryavardhan feels torn after lashing out at Harshvardhan while defending Gopal’s innocence. Meanwhile, Anu’s family discovers a crucial clue, as Meera and Raghupati plot their next cunning move.

videos.title: Aryavardhan’S Apology And Bold Revelation
videos.overview: Aryavardhan makes peace with Harshvardhan, revealing his vow to clear Gopal’s name. As society and the press torment Anu’s family, he stuns everyone with a bold statement that silences their attacks.

videos.title: Anu’S Truth Sparks Shock, Fear And Rage
videos.overview: Meera reels in shock, Raghupati trembles as Anu clears Gopal and Pushpa before the press and police. Later, Mansi fumes when Harshvardhan tells Aryavardhan that his doubts about Anu’s family are gone!

videos.title: Aryavardhan And Jhende Confront Meera
videos.overview: Shattered after losing his job due to a tarnished image, Gopal confides in Pushpa and Anu. Bipin reveals a shocking secret to Anu on the way. Later, Aryavardhan and Jhende confront Meera.

videos.title: Anu And Raghupati's Clash Of Fate
videos.overview: Anu exposes Raghupati, leading to his arrest, but Aryavardhan’s old enemy frees him with a trick. Later, Mansi grows upset as Harshavardhan plans to visit Anu’s home to apologise to her family.

videos.title: Aryavardhan’s Secret Santa Gift to Anu
videos.overview: Anu is delighted with Aryavardhan’s gift during a game of Secret Santa. Later, Anu falls unconscious, stressing about her exam result. Aryavardhan scolds Meera for Anu’s state.

videos.title: Meera Tampers With Anu’s Exam Result
videos.overview: Harshvardhan apologises to Anu’s parents. Anu is devastated upon failing in her exam. Aryavardhan exposes Meera and Mr Mishra’s plot, and Anu’s real pass result is reinstated.

videos.title: Anu’s Result Sparks Tension Between Aryavardhan and Meera
videos.overview: Aryavardhan surprises Anu over her graduation, but she feigns failure at home before delighting Pushpa with the truth. Later, Aryavardhan confronts Meera for conspiring with Anu’s faculty.

videos.title: Anu Comes Across a Familiar Name
videos.overview: The madman warns Anu again about her future with Aryavardhan. Gayatri unsettles Aryavardhan with strange claims, while Anu and Simran receive a surprise. At work, Anu comes across a familiar name.

videos.title: Anu Uncovers Rajnandini’s Hidden Truths
videos.overview: Anu questions Mr Bharadwaj about Rajnandini, but Jhende insists she’s hallucinating. Later, she finds Rajnandini Women’s Shelter while seeking the answer to why Aryavardhan hides his love for her.

videos.title: Jhende Foils Anu’s Quest For Rajnandini
videos.overview: Jhende blocks Anu’s search for Rajnandini at the women’s shelter. Meanwhile, Meera deceives Gopal into seeking Anu’s help to halt her transfer, leaving Pushpa doubtful of Meera’s sudden change.

videos.title: Anu Confronts Aryavardhan Over Rajnandini
videos.overview: Anu reaches Aryavardhan’s old mansion with Simran, seeking truths about Rajnandini, but Jhende foils her plan again. The next day, Anu makes an accusation against Aryavardhan and demands answers.

videos.title: Anu’s Suspicion and Aryavardhan’s Silence
videos.overview: Anu takes Jhende to Aryavardhan’s old mansion, but her suspicion rises when a photo frame vanishes. Later, Aryavardhan is left stunned as Anu’s family unite on New Year’s Eve to halt her transfer.

videos.title: Anu’s Love Confession On New Year’s Eve
videos.overview: At the New Year party, Aryavardhan helps Anu win Tambola, but she reveals his sacrifice. Later, Raghupati spikes her drink, and a semi-conscious Anu goes on stage to profess her love for Aryavardhan.

videos.title: Aryavardhan’s Struggle and Anu’s Misunderstanding
videos.overview: Gayatri reveals Raghupati’s plot against Anu, leading Gopal to punish him. The next day, Aryavardhan, troubled and distant, resolves to confess the truth, while Anu blames herself for his silence.

videos.title: Anu’s Guilt After Aryavardhan’s Big Revelation
videos.overview: Aryavardhan shocks Anu by revealing that Rajnandini is not just his saree brand, but also his wife's name. As Anu faints, he takes her home. The next day, guilt consumes Anu as she confides in Simran.

videos.title: Anu’s Coldness Towards Aryavardhan
videos.overview: Anu plans to apologise to Rajnandini for falling for Aryavardhan, while Pushpa grows tense with a diabetes diagnosis. Later, Anu’s cold behaviour towards Aryavardhan prompts Meera to question her.

videos.title: Anu Plans to Ask Gayatri About Rajnandini
videos.overview: Jhende visits Aryavardhan to get Anu’s transfer application signed, but Gayatri vows to stop her. At home, Anu learns Pushpa has diabetes and later plans to talk to Gayatri about Rajnandini.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Helps Anu Enter His Mansion
videos.overview: Pushpa prays for strength against her sweet cravings. Anu faints at Gayatri’s Mata Ki Chowki, but Aryavardhan helps her into the mansion, where she grows uneasy over Rajnandini’s strange absence.

videos.title: Anu Learns About Rajnandini’s Death
videos.overview: During the Mata Ki Chowki, Anu faints after following a shadowy figure and getting eerie flashbacks. Aryavardhan rescues her and shocks her by revealing that Rajnandini is no more.

videos.title: Meera’s Schemes Threaten Anu’s True Love
videos.overview: Anu embraces Aryavardhan after his revelation, but a jealous Meera records them to drive a wedge. As Aryavardhan prepares to profess his love, Meera plots to shatter the moment.

videos.title: Meera’s Video Plot Against Anu and Aryavardhan
videos.overview: Mansi calls Meera to ask if Aryavardhan and Anu are having an affair. Later, Aryavardhan tells Jhende his plan to profess his love, but a jealous Meera schemes to release a video to ruin their moment.

videos.title: Meera Exposes a Hidden Love Affair
videos.overview: Aryavardhan asks Jhende to make some arrangements near India Gate for his love confession to Anu. Meanwhile, Meera reveals the truth to Gopal, who clutches his chest in pain and faints in shock.

videos.title: Gopal’s Condition Halts Aryavardhan’s Love Confession
videos.overview: Pushpa finds Gopal unconscious and neighbours rush him to hospital. Meera lies to Jhende at work about her absence. Anu hurries to the hospital, while Aryavardhan fears she left because of his past.

videos.title: Dr Mohit Declares Gopal’s Surgery Urgent
videos.overview: Dr Mohit tells Anu a minor heart surgery is needed for Gopal. As Anu calls Meera for mediclaim, Harshvardhan asks Aryavardhan if he loves Anu. Later, Aryavardhan is shocked by Gopal’s condition!

videos.title: Aryavardhan Saves Gopal, Unaware Of a Danger
videos.overview: Anu visits Meera’s house for insurance approval, but Meera shuts her out in distress. Later, Aryavardhan helps Anu with Gopal’s angioplasty expenses, unaware that a sniper has him in sight.

videos.title: Gopal Ignores Anu At The Hospital
videos.overview: Meera fears that her video caused Gopal’s heart attack. At the hospital, Gopal ignores Anu. Later, Anu and Pushpa thank Aryavardhan, while Gopal stresses over Aryavardhan paying for his treatment.

videos.title: Gopal Asks Anu to Stay Away From Aryavardhan
videos.overview: At Dr Mohit’s suggestion, Anu talks to Gopal about his stress. Gopal asks her to stay away from Aryavardhan, leaving her shaken. Later, Gopal’s behaviour around Gayatri worries Pushpa.

videos.title: Pushpa Stumbles Upon a Shocking Video
videos.overview: Gopal is upset on learning of Aryavardhan’s role in his treatment. Meera’s behaviour makes Mansi’s suspicious and Gayatri shares her concerns with Jhende. Later, Pushpa stumbles upon a shocking video.

videos.title: Gopal’s Hostility Shakes Aryavardhan’s Family
videos.overview: Pushpa scolds Simran for supporting Anu and Aryavardhan’s affair. Meera deflects the blame and provokes Gopal once more, while Gayatri, Jhende and Aryavardhan grow uneasy about his sudden hostility.

videos.title: Meera Trembles As Jhende Exposes Her Ploy
videos.overview: Gopal returns home with Anu and Pushpa but remains upset with Anu. Jhende exposes Meera’s plot after Gayatri’s call. Later, Anu opens Aryavardhan’s gift, bringing them brief relief.

videos.title: Anu’s Marriage Plans and Aryavardhan’s Abduction
videos.overview: Dr Mohit’s visit prompts Gopal and Pushpa to plan Anu’s marriage to him. Aryavardhan’s attempt to meet Anu ends in his abduction to Kashmir, leaving Anu torn and his family anxious over his absence.

videos.title: Aryavardhan’s Abduction News Shocks The Nation
videos.overview: Aryavardhan’s video exposes his abduction by terrorists in Kashmir. As he defies their plot against the nation, Anu vows to track him down using the device he once gifted her.

videos.title: Meera Slaps Anu
videos.overview: Meera slaps Anu when she expresses her desire to join the rescue mission for Aryavardhan. Later, the kidnappers make their demands in exchange for Aryavardhan’s release.

videos.title: Anu’s Plea to Join Jhende’s Risky Mission
videos.overview: Jhende visits Anu for her bracelet to rescue Aryavardhan, while terrorists find the other one with him. As Gayatri and Mansi look after Harshvardhan, Anu seeks her parents' consent to join Jhende.

videos.title: Anu’s Search and Aryavardhan’s Struggle
videos.overview: Anu, Meera and Jhende head to Kashmir with a search party to rescue Aryavardhan. Meanwhile, Aryavardhan is thrashed while escaping the terrorists as both families grow anxious for Anu and Aryavardhan.

videos.title: Anu Reaches Aryavardhan
videos.overview: Anu’s bracelet guides her to a little Amal. At her request, Amal and her father take her to Aryavardhan, but terrorists hold them captive. Meanwhile, Gayatri visits Gopal and Pushpa.

videos.title: Anu’s Efforts Help Jhende Rescue Aryavardhan
videos.overview: Jhende and the search party rescue Anu and Aryavardhan from the terrorists. Once safe, Anu insists on returning to Delhi, recalling her promise to Gopal and Pushpa to stay away from Aryavardhan.

videos.title: Aryavardhan’s Heartfelt Confession to Anu
videos.overview: Aryavardhan feels strange when Anu remains distant and insists on leaving for Delhi, while Jhende consoles a jealous Meera. Yet love prevails as Aryavardhan unexpectedly professes his feelings to Anu.

videos.title: Anu Chooses Family Honour Over Love
videos.overview: Anu confesses her love to Aryavardhan, who silences her doubts. Meera grows curious about their trip to Kashmir. Later, Anu confides in Gopal about the proposal, choosing family honour over love.

videos.title: Anu’s Closure Shatters Aryavardhan’s Hopes
videos.overview: Gopal trusts Anu when she says she is going to the office to seek closure with Aryavardhan. Dr Mohit’s arrival sparks new possibilities, while Aryavardhan is left shattered as Anu ends their ties.

videos.title: Is It Over Between Anu and Aryavardhan?
videos.overview: Heartbroken after parting from Aryavardhan, Anu puts on a brave face for Gopal and Pushpa. Meanwhile, Aryavardhan breaks down in front of Jhende.

videos.title: Dr Mohit Expresses His Interest In Anu
videos.overview: Anu’s concern for Gopal impresses Dr Mohit, who expresses his interest in her. Jhende angrily confronts Anu about pressuring Aryavardhan into proposing to her in front of the Sharmas.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Meets Dr Mohit Near Anu's House
videos.overview: Gopal and Pushpa cheer Anu, while Siddhi Mata urges Gayatri to visit her to find out what is bothering Aryavardhan. Later, Aryavardhan arrives there and finds Dr Mohit there with his mother.

videos.title: Dr Mohit's Mother Chooses Anu For Him
videos.overview: Anu is stunned by Aryavardhan’s visit, though her parents welcome him inside. Jhende warns Meera never to hurt Aryavardhan again, while Dr Mohit’s mother shocks all by choosing Anu as her son’s bride.

videos.title: Aryavardhan’s Injury and Anu’s Destiny
videos.overview: Aryavardhan injures himself at work and tells Jhende that Anu will marry Dr Mohit. Siddhi Mata’s words unsettle Gopal and Pushpa, yet they agree to visit Dr Mohit’s home at his mother’s request.

videos.title: Anu’s Nightmare Troubles Gopal and Pushpa
videos.overview: Mansi spots Gayatri outside Aryavardhan's secret room and questions Harshvardhan about Rajnandini. Gopal and Pushpa are pleased by Anu's call with Dr Mohit, until her nightmare leaves them worried.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Tasks Jhende With a Probe
videos.overview: Aryavardhan explains Anu’s decision to Jhende and asks him to trace who showed the video to Gopal. Despite learning about Anu’s nightmares, Dr Mohit’s parents plan his marriage with Anu within a week.

videos.title: Anu and Aryavardhan At Crossroads
videos.overview: Anu reaches office late due to her wedding talks and faces Meera’s taunts. Gopal confronts Aryavardhan, who apologises and vows to stay away. As roka plans begin, Pushpa collapses, leaving Gopal torn.

videos.title: Jhende and Aryavardhan Secretly Help Gopal
videos.overview: Subhash humiliates Gopal when he asks for a loan, but Jhende secretly steps in with police support for Aryavardhan’s sake. The next day, Aryavardhan is shattered to learn of Anu and Dr Mohit’s roka.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Turns to Alcohol to Forget Anu
videos.overview: Unable to stay away, Aryavardhan goes to Anu’s locality and she senses his presence during her roka with Dr Mohit. At night, he returns home drunk, murmuring of lost love, leaving his family shaken.

videos.title: Anu Expresses Her True Feelings to Aryavardhan
videos.overview: Anu opens up to Simran but their talk turns into a clash. The next day, Jhende urges Aryavardhan to pull himself together. At work, Anu apologises to Aryavardhan and shares her feelings and struggles.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Faces a Shocking Moment
videos.overview: Dr Mohit visits Aryavardhan’s office, urging him to attend his marriage with Anu. Gayatri meets Gopal and Pushpa to discuss Anu and Aryavardhan’s bond, while Aryavardhan faces a shocking moment.

videos.title: Aryavardhan’s Darkest Hour
videos.overview: After seeing Anu with Dr Mohit, Aryavardhan spirals into despair, drinking until Meera's car hits him. Meanwhile, Anu hides her turmoil after Dr Mohit’s family comes home to try the mangalsutra.

videos.title: Jhende’s Plan to Reunite Aryavardhan and Anu
videos.overview: Pushpa confronts Anu about her love for Aryavardhan, but Simran’s words silence her. After seeing Aryavardhan broken, Jhende devises a plan, while Gayatri asks him to get an important paper home.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Summons Gopal to His Office
videos.overview: Jhende assures Gayatri that he will reunite Anu and Aryavardhan. At a meeting, a remark about Aryavardhan’s age sparks a push‑up challenge. Soon after, he summons Gopal to his office.

videos.title: Pushpa Overhears Anu and Gayatri
videos.overview: As Gayatri confronts Anu about her feelings for Aryavardhan, Pushpa overhears and learns the truth. Meanwhile, Aryavardhan shares his dilemma and asks Gopal whether he should attend Anu’s wedding.

videos.title: Anu’s Mehndi and a Sign Of Destiny
videos.overview: Anu and Dr Mohit’s families unite for a pre‑wedding ritual, but Siddhi Mata reveals a sign hinting Anu and Aryavardhan’s destiny. Later, Jhende arrives at her mehndi with a gift that terrifies Gopal.

videos.title: Jhende and Simran Step Up For Their Friends
videos.overview: Anu, a kind 20-year-old, and Aryavardhan, a resolute 45-year-old businessman, defy societal norms and family resistance, overcoming struggles to demonstrate that love transcends age or boundaries.

videos.title: Jhende and Simran Set Their Bold Plan
videos.overview: Jhende plans Anu and Aryavardhan’s elopement with Simran and Bipin. On the day of Anu’s haldi, both are tricked into meeting each other, unaware that Meera has already revealed the truth to Gayatri.

videos.title: Pushpa’s Hope and Raghupati’s Claim
videos.overview: Aryavardhan brings Anu home, delighting Pushpa, who urges them to elope and marry. Meanwhile, Dr Mohit’s mother Sudha is shocked when Raghupati claims Anu has eloped on the day of their haldi.

videos.title: Anu Meets Aryavardhan Before Her Wedding Rituals
videos.overview: Anu reassures Pushpa as she feels guilty for forcing Anu into an unwanted marriage. Aryavardhan attends Dr Mohit and Anu’s wedding. Anu meets Aryavardhan before the rituals and apologises to him.

videos.title: Dr Mohit’s Decision Puts Aryavardhan on Edge
videos.overview: Aryavardhan and Anu share emotional goodbyes and promises, unaware that Dr Mohit has overheard them. During the wedding rituals, Mohit walks away, but Aryavardhan brings him back for Gopal’s sake.

videos.title: Pushpa Fights Gopal for Anu’s Future
videos.overview: Aryavardhan brings Dr Mohit back, but he still refuses to marry Anu. Rajni slaps Raghupati for mocking Anu’s family. The next day, Pushpa urges Gopal to wed Anu to Aryavardhan and firmly supports her.

videos.title: Pushpa Stands by Anu and Aryavardhan
videos.overview: Mansi and Harshvardhan question Aryavardhan over Anu’s cancelled wedding, but Gayatri stands by him. The next day, Pushpa reveals Gopal is fine and pledges her support to Aryavardhan and Anu.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Vows to Win Gopal Over in Seven Days
videos.overview: With Pushpa’s support, Aryavardhan begins his plan to win Gopal’s approval. Meera fumes, but Jhende stays hopeful. Hearing Gopal’s four conditions, Aryavardhan vows to win him over in seven days.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Brings Roses for Gopal
videos.overview: Gopal frets over stopping Aryavardhan, while Pushpa believes he’ll win him over. Wearing his twenty‑year‑old clothes, Aryavardhan tries to charm Gopal with roses as Mansi and Meera plot against him.

videos.title: Rajni Learns of Anu and Aryavardhan's Affair
videos.overview: Gopal grows annoyed by Aryavardhan’s constant attempts to win him over and finds him at an unexpected place again. Rajni learns of Anu and Aryavardhan's affair, and another truth soon hurts her.

videos.title: Gopal Struggles to Escape Arya
videos.overview: Gopal tries to hide from Aryavardhan by taking Anu and Pushpa to a temple, but he still finds them. A viral video gives Mansi and Meera a reason to question it, while Pushpa tries to pacify Rajni.

videos.title: Aryavardhan's Dinner Date With Gopal
videos.overview: Gopal visits Anu’s office to observe Aryavardhan’s behaviour with her, but with Anu and Pushpa’s help, Aryavardhan tricks him into a dinner date. Meanwhile, Pushpa notices Rajni being rude to Anu.

videos.title: Meera's Sudden Visit Shifts Gopal’s Perspective
videos.overview: When Pushpa reveals the cause of Rajni’s anger, Anu vows to win her back. While Meera’s unexpected visit intrigues Gopal, Jhende secretly meets Simran and Bipin to set Aryavardhan’s plan in motion.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Backs Gopal With Sports Day
videos.overview: Aryavardhan sets up a Sports Day in Chandni Chowk, framing it as Gopal’s initiative and hinting at a surprise reward. But Meera and Mansi quickly dismiss the plan, stirring fresh criticism.

videos.title: Meera's Plan to Spoil Aryavardhan's Sports Day
videos.overview: Gayatri learns of Meera’s love for Aryavardhan only after Mansi hints at a better match than Anu. Meanwhile, Meera brings a pro wrestler and Raghupati uses him against Aryavardhan at the sports day.

videos.title: Aryavardhan’s Fight Wins Him Gopal’s Trust
videos.overview: Aryavardhan agrees to fight the wrestler brought by Raghupati and Meera, earning Gopal’s love and trust. Meanwhile, Jhende lies to Gayatri about Meera’s feelings but later scolds Meera for her plots.

videos.title: Gopal Faces Questions on Aryavardhan
videos.overview: Gopal realises that Pushpa and Anu had helped Aryavardhan, even as gossip spreads that he is in love with Anu. A few women question Gopal, and Raghupati later vows to separate them on Holi.

videos.title: Holi Brings a Secret for Anu
videos.overview: Gayatri joins Anu's family for Holika Dahan, and Gopal welcomes her and introduces her to Vishwanath Kaka. The next day, Anu visits Aryavardhan for Holi and discovers something unexpected.

videos.title: Anu's Vow on Holi Worries Gopal
videos.overview: Aryavardhan stuns all by agreeing to celebrate Holi after 20 years but insists on winning Gopal over first. Later, in Chandni Chowk, Anu vows to stop celebrating if he fails, leaving Gopal anxious.

videos.title: Gopal's Decision Stuns Aryavardhan
videos.overview: Gopal flees to avoid Holi, only to be trapped by Raghupati's goons. Aryavardhan risks all to save him, but Gopal's decision regarding Anu’s marriage later leaves him reeling.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Plans a Surprise for Anu
videos.overview: Gayatri and Jhende rejoice over Aryavardhan convincing Gopal for his marriage with Anu. But Raghupati calls Meera to hatch a plan to stop the wedding, as Aryavardhan hints at a surprise for Anu.

videos.title: Anu’s Marriage Plans Upsets Mansi and Meera
videos.overview: Swayed by Raghupati, Rajni warns Pushpa of disgrace, but she stays firm. Mansi mistreats Gayatri, angering Aryavardhan. Later, Anu and Aryavardhan share a warm moment despite Meera’s jealousy.

videos.title: Aryavardhan and Anu’s Relationship Under Threat
videos.overview: Anu and Aryavardhan rejoice as their relationship is accepted, while Meera, Mansi and Raghupati plot to ruin their happiness. Unaware of their schemes, Gayatri works to finalise the wedding date.

videos.title: Rumours Spread About Anu and Aryavardhan
videos.overview: Anu and Aryavardhan’s photo goes viral, and rumours begin to spread about them. The news perturbs Gopal, and he states that Anu and Aryavardhan must get married soon.

videos.title: Raghupati Tries to Turn Chandni Chowk Against Anu
videos.overview: Gopal urges Aryavardhan to agree to a quick wedding to save Anu from the viral scandal. Later, Mansi’s blame triggers Harshvardhan’s panic, while in Chandni Chowk, Raghupati riles the neighbours.

videos.title: Anu Vows to Persuade Harshvardhan
videos.overview: After Raghupati insults Anu, Pushpa lashes out and Gopal stands by the match. Harshvardhan then forces Aryavardhan to refuse. Anu learns of a promise to Rajnandini and vows to win Harshvardhan over.

videos.title: Tumm Se Tumm Tak - March 14, 2026
videos.overview: Anu, a kind 20-year-old, and Aryavardhan, a resolute 45-year-old businessman, defy societal norms and family resistance, overcoming struggles to demonstrate that love transcends age or boundaries.

videos.title: Anu’s Chance to Win Harshvardhan Over
videos.overview: Pushpa takes Gopal’s help to placate Rajni, but she stays firm. Meanwhile, Harshvardhan hears Anu after long waiting and gives her a chance to convince him about marrying Aryavardhan.

videos.title: Harshvardhan’s Ultimatum for Anu
videos.overview: Guided by Meera, Harshvardhan lays down a stern condition to accept Anu for Aryavardhan. Jhende challenges Meera's move, but in vain. Later, Pushpa and Gopal figure out how Anu can meet it.

videos.title: Pushpa Hires Happy Singh to Train Anu
videos.overview: Anu tries to talk to Simran about Harshvardhan’s test. Later, Pushpa hires trainer Happy Singh to help Anu pass the test, as Aryavardhan secretly supports her.

videos.title: Anu’s High‑Society Hurdle
videos.overview: Pushpa and Gopal struggle to teach Anu high‑society etiquette as neighbours taunt her. Rajni begins doubting her decision to stay away, while Aryavardhan is kept from reaching Anu.

videos.title: Rajni Joins Anu’s Battle
videos.overview: Pushpa grows emotional when Rajni offers to help Anu learn high‑society etiquette. But when Meera calls Anu a liar and dishonest, Aryavardhan snaps back and reveals the truth about his offer to Anu.

videos.title: Will Anu Pass the Test?
videos.overview: On Anu’s test day, Meera manipulates Mansi to join the judges' panel but grows uneasy when Gayatri and Jhende join too. Later, Anu answers confidently, but a tricky bouncer leaves her baffled.

videos.title: Anu’s Struggle and Harshvardhan’s Fall
videos.overview: Anu struggles through etiquette tests and disappoints Harshvardhan, leaving her family worried. Later, she finds him collapsing in the street after an emotional breakdown and rushes to help him.

videos.title: Harshvardhan Finds Shelter in Anu’s Care
videos.overview: Anu brings Harshvardhan home when he refuses to contact his family after being cheated again. She secretly alerts Aryavardhan to calm him and then devises a way to help Harshvardhan.

videos.title: Anu and Pushpa Shape Harshvardhan’s New Path
videos.overview: Pushpa trains Harshvardhan in negotiation, and Anu sharpens his decisions, helping him launch a quilt project with the sarees collected after the scam, angering Mansi. Later, Anu spots a quilt theft.

videos.title: Meera and Raghupati’s Rising Threat
videos.overview: Anu chases a quilt thief and discovers Aryavardhan, who has come with good news. As Harshvardhan grows closer to her family, Meera plots against them, and Raghupati vows to crush the Sharmas’ efforts.

videos.title: Raghupati Tries to Burn the Quilts
videos.overview: Raghupati schemes with Meera and burns the quilt boxes to sabotage Harshvardhan and the Sharmas, but Anu outwits them, leading Harshvardhan to understand the value of money.

videos.title: Harshvardhan Approves the Match
videos.overview: On his way to Anu’s home, Aryavardhan is happy when Harshvardhan says she’s the match for him. The next day, both families meet to fix the wedding date as Pushpa plans to visit the ancestral temple.

videos.title: An Old Enemy Watches Anu Alone
videos.overview: Meera and Mansi are upset with the marriage talks, while Anu’s neighbours taunt Gopal and Pushpa. When both leave for the ancestral temple, Anu is left alone, unaware an old enemy is watching her.

videos.title: Gayatri Keeps Anu and Aryavardhan Apart
videos.overview: Anu reflects on her ring before meeting Aryavardhan, but Gayatri orders Jhende to keep them apart until Gopal and Pushpa return. Meanwhile, a stranger helps Gopal and Pushpa at the temple.

videos.title: Raghupati Begins His New Plot Against Anu
videos.overview: Aryavardhan tries to meet Anu with Jhende’s help, while Mansi’s resistance leaves Harshvardhan worried. Later, Raghupati plots against Anu and Aryavardhan as Gopal and Pushpa search for the stranger.

videos.title: The Stranger Who Cautions Anu’s Parents
videos.overview: The stranger’s warning that Aryavardhan isn’t who he appears to be leaves Gopal and Pushpa shaken. Later, Anu faces Raghupati’s ploys, and Aryavardhan reluctantly hands the wedding planning to Meera.

videos.title: Jalandhar Returns to Separate Anu and Aryavardhan
videos.overview: Meera takes charge of Anu and Aryavardhan’s wedding. Gopal and Pushpa warn Jhende about a stranger, who is soon revealed as Jalandhar, bent on ruining Aryavardhan’s life.

videos.title: Jalandhar’s Plot After the Night of Fear
videos.overview: Late at night, Aryavardhan hears a scream and rushes to his secret room. At her house, Anu wakes from a nightmare. The next day, Jalandhar plots against them using Raghupati.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Announces Marriage and a Key Decision
videos.overview: Aryavardhan gathers both families for a press conference to announce his marriage to Anu and a key decision. Meanwhile, provoked by Raghupati, her neighbours plot to stop the wedding.

videos.title: Jhende Finds Proof Jalandhar Is Alive
videos.overview: Mansi and Meera wait for Anu to fail, but her neighbours support her new business. Elsewhere, Jhende gets a video of Jalandhar punishing Raghupati and is shaken by the thought that Jalandhar is alive.

videos.title: Mansi Begins Her Probe Into Jalandhar
videos.overview: Jhende shows Aryavardhan a video hinting Jalandhar is alive, a truth Mansi overhears and vows to probe. As Anu faces mixed reactions pitching her bridal venture before Pushpa calls with 'roka' news.

videos.title: Mansi Probes Aryavardhan’s Past
videos.overview: Meera plans Anu and Aryavardhan’s pre-wedding ritual, concealing her desire to sabotage it. Mansi’s curiosity about Aryavardhan’s past sparks conflict. Meanwhile, Jalandhar’s plot deepens.

videos.title: Secret Plots Threaten Anu’s 'Roka'
videos.overview: Anu and Aryavardhan’s 'roka' begins warmly, but a secret message on Raghupati’s phone alarms Jhende and Simran. Meanwhile, Mansi confides in Meera about her plan to derail the special day.

videos.title: The Hidden Truth About Rajiv
videos.overview: After Anu and Aryavardhan’s 'roka', Mansi mocks Gopal, doubting how he will handle a huge guest list. Jhende falls into Raghupati and Jalandhar’s trap as Jalandhar urges Anu to uncover who Rajiv is.

videos.title: Anu Finds a Letter From Rajnandini’s Past
videos.overview: At Jalandhar’s behest, Anu visits Aryavardhan’s bungalow and gets an old letter related to Rajnandini. Gopal loses savings to fraud, while Mansi talks to Harshvardhan about the wedding.

videos.title: The Letter Linked to Rajnandini Disturbs Anu
videos.overview: The letter linked to Rajnandini’s past unsettles Anu. Pushpa, Meera and Jhende discuss the wedding menu with the planners. Later, Mansi purposely mentions Jalandhar to observe Anu’s reaction.

videos.title: Meera’s Wedding Ploy Backfires
videos.overview: Meera’s ploy backfires as Pushpa rejects her lavish wedding plan. Hiding fraud losses, Gopal seeks a loan from another bank. As Anu probes Rajiv’s past, Aryavardhan invites her to lunch.

videos.title: Rajni Steps in to Help Gopal and Pushpa
videos.overview: Gopal and Pushpa hide their financial troubles as Rajni steps in to help with the wedding. At work, Meera snaps at Anu over Pushpa’s behaviour, while Aryavardhan ignores his health for lunch with Anu.

videos.title: Jalandhar Rekindles the Secret About Rajiv
videos.overview: Amid a tyre burst, Jalandhar meets Anu and urges her to ask Aryavardhan about Rajiv. Meanwhile, Gopal and Pushpa struggle for wedding funds. Gayatri warns Anu that Aryavardhan skipped his medicines.

videos.title: Aryavardhan’s Chest Pain Shakes Everyone
videos.overview: Anu rushes Aryavardhan to hospital after his sudden chest pain. As Siddhi Mata’s warning leaves Gopal unsettled, Meera sets aside her enmity and embraces Anu, while the news shocks both families.

videos.title: Anu’s Vow to Save Aryavardhan
videos.overview: News of Aryavardhan’s heart attack sparks doubts about Anu marrying an older man. At the hospital, Anu and her family stand by Aryavardhan’s loved ones, as she vows to fast after meeting Siddhi Mata.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Undergoes a Successful Surgery
videos.overview: Aryavardhan’s surgery succeeds, and he is declared out of danger. Elsewhere, Anu consoles a distraught Meera. Later, Jhende questions Anu about the man driving the suspicious car.

videos.title: A Promise to Protect Aryavardhan
videos.overview: Shocked to learn that Jalandhar urged Anu to ask Aryavardhan about Rajiv, Jhende makes her promise never to do so. The neighbours’ comments about Aryavardhan’s health leave Pushpa worried for Anu.

videos.title: Aryavardhan's Condition Raises Wedding Doubts
videos.overview: At a press meet, Meera announces Aryavardhan’s recovery, but Jalandhar plots his next move. Jhende confronts Raghupati to uncover the ploy, while Pushpa worries about Anu’s marriage to Aryavardhan.

videos.title: Pushpa’s Doubts Deepen Over Aryavardhan
videos.overview: Anu senses Pushpa’s silence stems from fears around Aryavardhan. As Rajni deepens her doubts, Pushpa visits Gayatri. Soon, Jalandhar meets Raghupati, and Jhende plots to outsmart them.

videos.title: Pushpa’s Doubts Shake the Marriage Plans
videos.overview: Mansi is happy to hear Gayatri and Pushpa discuss cancelling Anu and Aryavardhan’s marriage. Jhende learns of Pushpa’s doubts while Anu and Meera prepare for Aryavardhan’s discharge.

videos.title: Anu Goes Against Pushpa's Decision
videos.overview: Anu cares for Aryavardhan despite objections, but Pushpa reveals her plan to cancel the alliance, fearing for Anu’s future. Anu refuses to leave Aryavardhan as he calls her, unaware of the truth.

videos.title: Aryavardhan's Plan to Convince Pushpa
videos.overview: Aryavardhan learns Pushpa wants to end his alliance with Anu. Determined to win her over, he joins Anu to convince her, while Rajni continues to fuel Pushpa’s doubts.

videos.title: Pushpa Consents for Aryavandhan and Anu's Marriage
videos.overview: Aryavardhan wins Pushpa’s approval by proving that his health won’t affect his and Anu’s married life. The celebration fades when Anu receives a cryptic message about his link to Rajeev Bhatia.

videos.title: Anu Confronts Simran About Neel
videos.overview: Anu spots Simran secretly meeting Neel and later confronts her. Meanwhile, fearing that Anu may uncover the truth, Aryavardhan subtly tries to probe her worries.

videos.title: Tumm Se Tumm Tak - April 26, 2026
videos.overview: Anu, a kind 20-year-old, and Aryavardhan, a resolute 45-year-old businessman, defy societal norms and family resistance, overcoming struggles to demonstrate that love transcends age or boundaries.

videos.title: Rajni Blames Anu for Simran and Neel's Affair
videos.overview: A beggar’s words about Rajiv disturbs Anu. Simran reconciles with Neel, but Rajni lashes out and blames Anu. Meanwhile, Pushpa and her neighbours attempt to expose an LPG scam.

videos.title: Anu Goes to Meet the Cryptic Caller
videos.overview: Rajni forbids Simran and Neel from meeting and blames Anu. Aryavardhan battles his secret as Anu is summoned by a cryptic caller to talk about Rajiv, while Rajni insults Pushpa.

videos.title: Will Aryavardhan Confess the Truth About Rajiv?
videos.overview: Rajni blames Anu for Simran’s affair, while Anu seeks the truth about Rajiv. Aryavardhan meets Anu at the temple to tell her about Rajiv, making her feel guilty for going behind his back.

videos.title: The Secret of Rajiv Bhatia
videos.overview: Anu grows anxious seeing Aryavardhan’s condition and begs him not to reveal anything. Still, he tells her the truth about Rajiv Bhatia. Soon, Gayatri arrives with Jhende to add to his revelation.

videos.title: Anu Is Shaken by Aryavardhan's Truth
videos.overview: Gayatri reveals a truth about Aryavardhan and Rajnandini that leaves Anu shaken. Meera confronts Jhende for answers the next day. Meanwhile, Bholi helps Gopal and Pushpa dodge the gas delivery agent.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Backs Simran and Neel
videos.overview: Pushpa and Gopal escape arrest for stealing gas cylinders, only to expose the scam and earn praise. Soon after, Aryavardhan boldly supports Simran and Neel’s marriage, despite Rajni’s firm opposition.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Exposes Rajni’s Past
