videos.overview: Neel breaks down when Rajni refuses to accept his and Simran’s relationship. Later, Meera asks Jhende about Jalandhar, while Aryavardhan stops Neel and Simran from eloping and exposes Rajni’s past.

videos.title: Rajni Consents for Simran and Neel’s Wedding
videos.overview: Rajni apologises for hiding her past and agrees for Simran and Neel’s wedding. Aryavardhan promises to organise the wedding the next day, but his decision doesn’t go down well with Mansi.

videos.title: Jalandhar and Raghupati’s Plot Against Aryavardhan
videos.overview: Jalandhar and Raghupati plot to destroy Aryavardhan’s life. Unaware of the conspiracy, Anu and Aryavardhan engage in a fun challenge, while Meera reproaches Aryavardhan for organising Neel’s wedding.

tt37737315.description: A quirky 29-year-old named Sathya embarks on an unexpected journey of laughter, unlikely friendships, and self-discovery. Through hilarious misadventures and chance encounters, he slowly sees life's bigger picture - its surprises, joys, and second chances.

tt40184918.name: Resort
tt40184918.description: A debt-ridden room service boy rises to challenge a ruthless kitchen at a luxurious beachside haven.

videos.title: (S1 E101) Behind the Scenes of Resort
videos.overview: The cast and crew talk about their experiences and the challenges they faced while working through the season.

videos.title: Hell's Kitchen
videos.overview: Vetri is a village boy burdened by his family responsibilities. His journey begins at RR Resort, where he comes face-to-face with Nedumaran, the resort kitchen's dictator.

videos.title: Unwitting Actions
videos.overview: Pandi guides Vetri through the resort to familiarise him with how things work there. Later, Aishu is harshly punished by Nedumaran because of Vetri's careless mistake.

videos.title: The Lid is Lifted
videos.overview: Vetri gets an opportunity to earn a living with his cooking. He comes across Nedumaran's signature soup. Meanwhile, an influencer couple raises a ruckus in the resort.

videos.title: Doomed
videos.overview: Nedumaran is enraged when Rajan speaks about cost-cutting. Vetri further aggravates his mood by selling his soup recipe from a street cart. Will Vetri survive Nedumaran's wrath?

videos.title: Be Irreplaceable
videos.overview: Nedumaran fumes as an inexperienced Vetri cracks his signature dish recipe. His plea to join the kitchen team is denied. Joji enjoys Vetri's Rasam rice. A prank on Aishu backfires.

videos.title: Behind the Mask
videos.overview: Joji tells Vetri that his Rasam rice reminded him of his college love. Aishu tries to sabotage Vetri's service by changing the dishes. Vetri finds out about Aishu's secret life.

videos.title: Wave of Nostalgia
videos.overview: Vetri plays cupid for Joji. Vetri's effort to make peace with Aishu fails. Aishu panics when she learns that Vetri is aware of her masked secret. Riya tries to patch up with Aishu.

videos.title: Ghost from the Past
videos.overview: Vetri helps Aishu and Veni with his cooking skills. Furious at first, Nedumaran is surprised when he tastes Vetri's dish. Later, he is shocked to learn who Vetri's father is.

videos.title: Frozen in Fear
videos.overview: Foreign guests like Vetri's dish, and he gets considered for the kitchen team. However, this opportunity rattles others in the kitchen.

videos.title: Opportunity or Adversity?
videos.overview: Nedumaran's decision about Vetri's entry into the kitchen shocks everyone. Will Vetri be up for the challenge?

videos.title: Gearing Up
videos.overview: Riya checks into the resort to comfort herself. Meanwhile, among gifts and sleeplessness, Vetri eagerly anticipates his big day in the kitchen.

videos.title: Lifeblood of the Kitchen
videos.overview: All prepared, Vetri delegates the day's menu to the kitchen staff. However, the new chef faces many struggles, the worst being the interruption of gas supply.

videos.title: Sense of Schadenfreude
videos.overview: Vetri rises to the challenge by using firewood stove and wins praises for the lunch menu. Seeing the kitchen's condition, Nedumaran throws Vetri out and is happy about his failure.

videos.title: Fresh Ally
videos.overview: Vetri's special Biryani request from the guests is rejected. Aishu stands up for Vetri when Vicky mocks him. She makes an appeal when Vetri and Pandi visit the bar where she sings.

videos.title: Comeuppance
videos.overview: The room service team gets targeted by the kitchen team after Vetri's failure. While Nedumaran announces Aishu as the new Sous Chef, he punishes Vicky for his reckless behaviour.

videos.title: Covetous Desire
videos.overview: Veni confronts Aishu for going against Vicky. Nedumaran feigns joy when Ragupathi informs him about handing over the resort to Riya. Deepak's announcement at the party shocks Riya.

videos.title: The Good Girl Syndrome
videos.overview: Ragupathi watches Riya being tortured by Deepak. Vetri and Aishu cook a special dish for Joji's date with his lady love. Aishu tries to tell her dad about her passion for singing.

videos.title: Emotional Armour
videos.overview: Ragupathi assures Riya of his support. Veni feels bad for Vicky who is frustrated with his room service job. Joji and Padma's date is ruined by Padma's daughter.

videos.title: Seething Anger
videos.overview: Nedumaran is angry as Ragupathi's request was actually Vetri's recipe. Joji bids adieu to Padma with a heavy heart. Vetri attends Nedumaran's call for Aishu by mistake.

videos.title: Face from the Past
videos.overview: Riya decides to continue staying at the resort. Rajan sorts an issue when John tries to blow it up. Nedumaran pretends not to recall Chidambaram when an old friend asks about him.

videos.title: Close Confidante
videos.overview: Aishu spots Veni and Vicky having an argument and feels betrayed. Though Rajan warns Riya, she tries to talk to Nedumaran about the food expenditure.

videos.title: Secret Kitchen
videos.overview: Vetri and Pandi hunt for a place and an investor to start their new business. Aishu tries talking to Vicky about Veni, which ends in disaster.

videos.title: Drifting Apart
videos.overview: Uthaman intervenes when Vetri and Vicky get into an intense argument. At Siva's birthday party, Veni sees Srinidhi and Vicky together, and she gets upset and drunk.

videos.title: Where is Chika?
videos.overview: Riya talks to Rajan about the resort's major problem: food. Vetri's dish from his secret kitchen gets mistakenly delivered to the wrong guest. Will Vetri get caught?

videos.title: Lovelorn Veni
videos.overview: Nedumaran ruins Riya's attempt to change things in the resort. Back in the kitchen team, Vicky breaks up with Veni. Vetri and Aishu save Veni when she tries to end her life.

videos.title: Delving into the Past
videos.overview: Leo's words remind Ragupathi of Chika and he decides to locate him. Nedumaran humiliates Aishu after seeing her with Vetri. Aishu learns about Vetri’s father and his family's past.

videos.title: The Supercilious Chef
videos.overview: When Vicky questions Nedumaran for making Aishu the Sous Chef, a cooking challenge is held between them. Ragupathi’s decision to find the truth about Chidambaram upsets Nedumaran.

videos.title: Resurfacing of Memories
videos.overview: Aishu takes Vetri's mom and sister to her house for a day and is shocked to see Nedumaran back early from his travel. What happens when he learns the truth about their background?

videos.title: New Ideas
videos.overview: Vetri gives his mom a tour of the resort. Riya shares her business plan with Ragupathi. While Vetri helps Aishu with the sous chef test, Nedumaran warns her to stay away from him.

videos.title: Dinner or Date?
videos.overview: Aishu tells Vetri that her father knows about the guests. She invites Vetri out for dinner. Nedumaran is not happy when Ragupathi tells him about Riya's new business plan.

videos.title: Chefs' Cook-Off
videos.overview: Nedumaran announces three rounds of the sous chef cook-off. While he demands that Aishu win the challenge, Vicky tries to distract her. Later, Nedumaran accepts the business idea.

videos.title: The Clock Is Ticking
videos.overview: Vetri boosts Aishu when Vicky mocks her for losing. Aishu wins the next round. She recalls Vetri’s words as she panics in the third round. Ragupathi gets a call about Chidambaram.

videos.title: The Shindig
videos.overview: Nedumaran resents Aishu's friendship with Vetri. Ragupathy leaves to find Chidambaram. Joji is miffed when no one remembers his birthday, but Vetri has a solution.

videos.title: The Apologetic Attacker
videos.overview: John tries to target Vetri to appease Nedumaran by messing up a guest's order. Vicky attends his friend's bachelor party and finds Vetri taking their 'special' food order.

videos.title: Native Charm
videos.overview: Vetri is tasked with handling an inspection officer, who comes over to thoroughly check the resort. Vicky and Srinidhi decide to investigate what Vetri and Pandi are up to.

videos.title: Busted
videos.overview: After Nedumaran warns him, Vetri avoids Aishu, leaving her upset and confused. When Aishu discovers Vetri in his secret kitchen, she leaves without listening to his explanation.

videos.title: Smoking Gun
videos.overview: Vetri is caught red-handed and faces Nedumaran’s wrath after Vicky shares video evidence of his secret kitchen. Vicky lies that Aishu took the video. Ragupathi visits Vetri's mom.

videos.title: Disillusioned
videos.overview: Aishu confronts Vicky for his heinous move. Defying a furious Nedumaran, Ragupathi handles the situation and Vetri is released from the station. Aishu tries to speak to Vetri.

videos.title: Penitent Vetri
videos.overview: Vetri's suspension surprises everyone. While Ragupathi accepts Vetri's heartfelt apology, his decision upsets Nedumaran. Vetri is glad to see Bhavani’s food cart back in business.

videos.title: Stonewalling
videos.overview: Riya launches RR Resort Masala Products. Nedumaran is shocked that Ragupathi knows Vetri's father and is looking for him. Aishu is hurt as Vetri decides to stay away from her.

videos.title: Dissolved in Tears
videos.overview: Aishu feels guilty about Vetri. Joji advices Vetri to save his friendship. Rajan shares vital news with Ragupathi about Chidambaram. Aishu has a heartfelt talk with Nedumaran.

videos.title: Mea Culpa
videos.overview: Ragupathi learns that Chidambaram is innocent. Meanwhile, Vicky's mother makes an unexpected visit to the resort and advises him to value his friendships.

videos.title: Food Fest'26
videos.overview: Vetri helps Ramya at her college food festival and is shocked by the chief guest. Vicky apologises to Aishu and tries to fix things with Veni, but things do not go as planned.

videos.title: Languishing in Prison!
videos.overview: Vetri rejoins his duty at the resort and promises Ragupathi to be loyal always. While Ragupathi is desperately looking for Chidambaram, what big secret is Nedumaran hiding?

videos.title: Flopped Business
videos.overview: Riya is upset as her business plan fails. Nedumaran rebukes Riya and Rajan when they inform him about the food’s quality at the resort. Vetri decides to talk to Shibu for Aishu.

videos.title: Nudging Friends
videos.overview: Ragupathi asks Riya to take up the pantry project with Vetri to help her. Nedumaran praises Aishu for running the kitchen smoothly. Vetri makes Shibu listen to Aishu’s rendition.

videos.title: Renewed Opportunity
videos.overview: Nedumaran gets angry that Vetri is to manage the pantry and questions Ragupathi. Shibu promises an opportunity for Aishu to Vetri. After Vicky apologises, Veni reconciles with him.

videos.title: Renaissance
videos.overview: Vetri sets up the pantry and is happy to know of a salary hike. While Aishu is ready to sacrifice her dreams for her father's happiness, Nedumaran learns about her secret identity.

videos.title: Filial Betrayal
videos.overview: Things take a turn when Nedumaran discovers Aishu's hidden identity. Tensions escalate within the Pantry team as they face new challenges and conflicts.

videos.title: Immolating Dreams
videos.overview: Aishu rejects Shibu's offer and assures Nedumaran she won't betray him like her sister. Priya hints at a plan to her brother, who warns her to be cautious.

videos.title: Culinary Stage
videos.overview: Ramya joins Nedumaran's kitchen as a trainee. Vetri's pantry sale picks up, but Riya rebukes him for not following the assigned menu. Vetri scolds Ramya for confronting Aishu.

videos.title: Entrapped
videos.overview: After Rajan advices Riya, she asks Vetri to make some dishes for the pantry. While Bhavani waits for Ramya to return, Priya traps her in a dangerous situation. Will Ramya survive?

videos.title: Frantic Search
videos.overview: Vetri and Pandi scour the resort in search of Ramya. Priya worriedly calls her brother and tells him about her mistake. Once the rescue is dealt with, Vetri goes on a field trip.

videos.title: A Daughter's Atonement
videos.overview: Aishu upsets everyone with her tyrannical behaviour. Veni spots Priya snooping around and gets suspicious. Vetri has a new menu. Will he successfully implement it?

videos.title: Contrasting Sisters
videos.overview: Divya asks for Riya's support at her wedding. Aishu tells Divya that she will not let their father down. Aishu warns Vicky for mocking Ramya. Vetri is sad as the pantry sales drop.

videos.title: Bitter Encounters
videos.overview: Vetri's new menu struggles to attract customers. Ramya tells Vetri about how Vicky bullies her, which angers him. Divya finally comes face to face with Nedumaran at the resort.

videos.title: Aishu's Complaint
videos.overview: After a complaint from Aishu reaches Rajan, Vetri faces an uncomfortable meeting. Feeling dejected, he finds support from Ramya and Pandi, who motivate him to focus on the pantry.

videos.title: Suspicions Sparked
videos.overview: Nedumaran brushes aside Aishu's wedding-related concerns, while Vetri finds inspiration for new pantry dishes. Veni grows suspicious of Priya's actions and shares it with Vicky.

videos.title: Yearning Daughters
videos.overview: Vetri works tirelessly to manage both the pantry and room service while launching fresh ideas. Meanwhile, Nedumaran's anger flares when he learns of Divya's wedding menu plans.

videos.title: Booming Pantry Sales
videos.overview: Ragupathi shares his concern about Chidambaram with Nedumaran. Vetri makes a sweet for Divya. Vetri's strategy with kids works well for the pantry business, making Nedumaran angry.

videos.title: Showered by Appreciation
videos.overview: Nedumaran fumes as the pantry food is liked by the guests. While Riya congratulates Vetri, Ragupathi praises her for the pantry's success. Nedumaran recalls his talk with Chika.

videos.title: Spurned Invitation
videos.overview: Nedumaran lashes at Divya for inviting him to her wedding. John announces the Star Chef competition. Priya plans her revenge by tarnishing Nedumaran's name at Divya's wedding.

videos.title: Wrecking the Wedding
videos.overview: Nedumaran's new signature dish becomes an instant hit. He ignores Karthik who tries to convince him to attend the wedding. Priya executes her plan amidst the wedding preparations.

videos.title: Blood is Thicker than Water
videos.overview: Priya's plan fails as Nedumaran handles the situation. Divya is elated to see her father at her wedding as Aishu gives him an earful. Nedumaran rages when Aishu shows him a photo.

videos.title: A Bride's Farewell
videos.overview: Nedumaran has a private word with Karthik before bidding the newlyweds goodbye. Uthaman introduces the new members to the room service team. Meanwhile, Vetri falls sick.

videos.title: The Hidden Truth
videos.overview: When Vicky and Veni share a private moment, Nedumaran conducts an inspection, alarming Vetri. Aishu asks about the untoward kitchen incidents and the picture from Nedumaran's desk.

videos.title: Ravaged Kitchen
videos.overview: Riya finds out the reason behind Deepak's return and confronts him. Ragupathi asks everyone to prepare for a minister's visit, but Priya has another plan up her sleeve.

videos.title: Against All Odds
videos.overview: The kitchen's destruction upsets the chefs. Nedumaran proposes that his team move into the pantry temporarily, but Riya opposes it vehemently. What will Ragupathi decide?

videos.title: Rajan's Avowal
videos.overview: Nedumaran is angry by the minister’s mother’s words. While Riya assures her dad she is happy, Rajan admits to Aishu that he loves Riya. Vetri helps Aishu with a last-minute order.

videos.title: Nedumaran's Notoriety
videos.overview: Nedumaran is shocked to see a viral video stating the fire in the kitchen was due to his neglect, but Veni has doubts. He fumes as the minister and his family enjoy pantry food.

videos.title: Minister's Misattribution
videos.overview: Ragupathi is moved by Aishu’s suggestion to get Riya and Rajan married. Priya celebrates with her brother. The minister applauds Nedumaran for the amazing dishes in the pantry.

videos.title: Nedumaran's Unpleasant Encounter
videos.overview: Nedumaran is upset by a call and the profit margin between the kitchen and pantry. Veni learns that Priya is constantly following Nedumaran. Martin visits Nedumaran at RR resort.

videos.title: All about Chika
videos.overview: Nedumaran meets Chidambaram aka Chika, who wins hearts with his cooking. Ragupathi nominates him for a Star Chef competition. Upset, Nedumaran decides to cook for a hunting party.

videos.title: Web of Deceptions
videos.overview: Nedumaran reports illegal hunting and leaves Chika alone in the forest. Chika gets arrested. At the resort, Nedumaran spins a tale about Chika’s missing, all for a Star Chef award.

videos.title: Hidden Feelings
videos.overview: Vetri is heartbroken to see Aishu’s ex-boyfriend. A complaint about a pantry dish has Nedumaran fuming. Rajan admits his feelings to Riya. Vetri is thrilled as Aishu lifts the ban.

videos.title: Old Flame
videos.overview: Nedumaran complains to Ragupathi about the pantry. Aishu and Selvin catch up after ages. Veni spies on Priya. Ramya confides in Aishu about Vetri while Ragupathi collapses in pain.

videos.title: Stricken Ragupathi
videos.overview: Priya becomes cautious when Veni and Vetri visit her house. Ragupathi is hospitalised and Nedumaran assumes that he will be taking over the resort in his absence.

videos.title: Who is the Alpha?
videos.overview: Nedumaran stops Rajan's staff meeting and lets everyone know who the boss is. Aishu is selected for the Star Chef event. Vetri is shocked as Nedumaran replaces the pantry staff.

videos.title: Rebuffed
videos.overview: Veni scolds Vicky for being rude to Vetri. Nedumaran insults Vetri for questioning about the pantry. Ragupathi tells Rajan to take charge of the resort. Ramya proposes to Vetri.

videos.title: The Next CEO!
videos.overview: Nedumaran takes complete control of the resort, and everyone worries as word spreads that he'll be the next CEO. Ragupathi recovers and immediately calls for an investor's meeting.

videos.title: Bittersweet Departure
videos.overview: RR Resort is in chaos after Nedumaran walks out with his team. Rajan handles the situation calmly. Aishu bids farewell to Vetri. Nedumaran leaves the Kitchen with bitter emotion.

videos.title: Seizing the Day
videos.overview: Vicky exploits the situation at the resort. Vetri asks Riya to help him join the Kitchen team. While admitted in the hospital, Vetri’s mother reveals the truth about his father.

videos.title: Strengthening Ties
videos.overview: Rajan confidently meets the resort's investors and explains his future plans. Since Vicky struggles to run the Kitchen with reduced staff, Riya and Rajan offer him a solution.

videos.title: Nedumaran's Minion
videos.overview: Vetri asks for help from Veni and others for the Star Chef competition and goes in search of a former winner. As Nedumaran trains Aishu, he brews a sinister plan for the resort.

videos.title: Durai, the Savior ?
videos.overview: Rajan entrusts Vicky with arranging dinner for the investors. Nedumaran plots to take over RR Resort with Luther's help. Vetri waits desperately for Durai, but will he help him?

videos.title: Persistant Chef
videos.overview: Nedumaran trains Aishu for the competition at home. A stressed Aishu meets Selvin, but she cannot get Vetri out of her mind. Hearing his struggles, Durai agrees to help Vetri.

videos.title: The Trial
videos.overview: Durai sets to train Vetri if he passes three tests. Vicky informs Nedumaran about Vetri’s move. He tells Vetri he will run the kitchen during the training. Vetri clears two tests.

videos.title: The Dead Kitchen
videos.overview: Vetri clears Durai's tough task with ease, and he promises to train him. Ragupathi, Riya and Rajan feel betrayed as Vicky executes his plan and shows his colours to the investors.

videos.title: Ragupathi's Reassurance
videos.overview: The situation at the resort worsens when board members pull back. When the employees begin to fear for their jobs, Ragupathi calls for a staff meeting.

videos.title: Dark Grief
videos.overview: Durai sees Chidambaram in Vetri and tells him about how he knew his father and his tragic past. When Veni calls Aishu to vent her frustration, the latter learns a startling truth.

videos.title: Good Luck
videos.overview: Just when Vetri completes his training, he gets a call from his sister that his mother is hospitalised. On the day of the competition, Nedumaran warns the organiser about Vetri.

videos.title: The Champion Returns
videos.overview: When Vetri goes to register for the competition, they question the legitimacy of Durai's signature. However, all hope is not lost.

videos.title: Chef's Culinary Clash Begins
videos.overview: Durai wishes Vetri and leaves. Aishu confronts Selvin for hiding about partaking in the competition. Nedumaran briefs Aishu. Meanwhile, will Vetri be able to handle the rounds?

videos.title: Memory of a Father
videos.overview: Vetri freezes before the first round. Later, he recalls his childhood memories with his father and that inspires him to make his first dish of the competition.

videos.title: The Sous Chefs
videos.overview: In the new round, Veni becomes Vetri's sous chef and Vicky becomes Aishu's. Veni's presence distracts Vicky, who misses her a lot.

videos.title: A Friend in Need
videos.overview: Selvin wins an advantage and chooses a toughest ingredient to break his opponents. Durai's training helps Vetri, but he uses his time to help Aishu. Selvin’s query confuses Vetri.

videos.title: A Helpless Son
videos.overview: Aishu asks Nedumaran why he's so hell-bent on her winning the competition. Just before the finals, Vetri receives a devastating call from his sister about his mother's condition.

videos.title: The Final Dish
videos.overview: While Vetri stands still, feeling helpless, a timely help from a benefactor saves the day. However, when Vetri presents his final dish, the judges get upset with his presentation.

videos.title: The Star Chef Rises
videos.overview: The judges and viewers are moved after Vetri shares the concept behind his dish. Once the competition ends, Aishu tells her father her wish.

videos.title: Unfinished Business
videos.overview: Everyone awaits the arrival of their new CEO at RR Resort, but their identity shocks them. Vetri settles his debts and returns to the resort, but his choice surprises Ragupathi.

tt41110859.name: Aakhri Sawal
tt41110859.description: Brilliant but erratic scholar Vicky publicly accuses his esteemed mentor, Professor Gopal Nadkarni, of institutional bias, igniting national controversy. Their academic dispute escalates into a televised debate fueled by media and...

tt33347879.name: The Traitors
tt33347879.description: A group of contestants arrive with hopes of winning a large cash prize of ₹1 crore that is built up through missions. The players are referred to as the "Innocents", but among them are the "Traitors" — a group of contestants secretly selected by the host. If the Innocents eliminate all the Traitors, they will share the prize fund. However, if any Traitors manage to make it to the end, eliminating the Innocents, they win the entire prize money.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Twenty players enter the palace with one chilling warning: trust no one. Who among them will become the deceitful Traitors? The game begins…

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: As the traitors commit their first murder, the players truly understand what they have signed up for. Can the innocents strike back?

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Players take on a gruelling mission to secure the coveted shield - the only protection against murder. A blast from the past heightens suspicions leaving the players with an “identity crisis”.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: The Traitors receive a daring secret mission to be executed in plain sight. Will it blow their cover?

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: One Player must make the ultimate choice, while chaos erupts at the Circle of Shakk and suspicions run wild and alliances unravel.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Four players wake up with a target on their back, fated to be murdered by the end of the day! The players can save only one, who will it be?

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Party time in the mansion brings out people's true colours as the Traitors pull off a secret mission.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: A shocking annoucement forces players to retrace last night's party. Later, they must embarks on a long march with death for one player waiting at the end of the road.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: The Players journey comes full circle with a mission that poses the same question they faced at the very beginning- TRUST!

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: In a gripping season finale, the players face their ultimate challenge in the unforgiving desert dunes. With the prize within reach, the Innocents must race to unmask the Traitors before its too late?

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: The Traitors India is back. Twenty-one new players arrive eager to begin the ultimate game of trust and betrayal, only to be stopped in their tracks by a shocking roadblock before they even set foot inside the palace.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: As the Traitors commit their first murder, the players get a terrifying taste of danger at breakfast. With Shields up for grabs in the mission and the first Circle of Shaq looming, can the Innocents strike back?

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: The Traitors are playing the Innocents like a piano, but can the Innocents change the tune? A ruthless mission built on betrayal and dhoka pushes fragile alliances to breaking point and leaves relationships hanging by a thread.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: The Traitors embark on their first secret mission, setting in motion an unpredictable high-stakes game where one wrong move could mean Death.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: This mission brings back more than just money. The Traitors and Innocents trade heavy blows in a never seen before Circle of Shaq. Will this explosive new twist shatter trust for good?

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: The Innocents find themselves armed with clues that could unravel the Traitors' carefully crafted deception. With the game at a turning point, can the Traitors evade detection and maintain control of the palace?

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: The Traitors deliver their most devastating blow of the game, eliminating a prized Innocent and leaving the palace shaken. As anger replaces grief, will the Innocents be able to exact their revenge?

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: The players step out draped in gold, but beneath the glitter lies a deadly secret. One of them has been cursed by the Traitors and marked for destruction. But for the first time ever, the Innocents are given an extraordinary power: a chance to break the curse and thwart the Traitors' plan.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: One step away from the Finale, the game takes a dangerous turn. A powerful new advantage gives the players the chance to uncover a hidden identity. With stakes at an all-time high, whose cover is about to be blown?

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Trust is dead, and everyone is a suspect. As the game reaches its explosive end, will the Traitors pull off one final act of deception and steal the prize, or will the Innocents finally expose them and claim victory yet again?

videos.title: Reunion
videos.overview: The game is over, but the reckoning begins. The entire cast joins Karan Johar for an explosive reunion, looking their betrayers in the eye to settle old scores, expose hidden lies, and confront the brutal truth behind the season's most ruthless moves.

tt38772234.name: Aashaan
tt38772234.description: Aashaan dreams of cinema until a 150-member film crew enters his life, bringing movie magic within reach. Chasing his big break, he confronts the industry's harsh realities.

tt39989131.name: Thadayam
tt39989131.description: In 1999, a string of brutal midnight murders terrifies tamil nadu's border villages but when a sharp new officer arrives, he uncovers a chilling pattern.

videos.title: The First Case
videos.overview: Adhiyaman, a police officer on the waitlist for VRS, investigates a case of theft. Later, when a different village reports a similar incident, SI Adhiyaman observes a startling pattern.

videos.title: The Border
videos.overview: Unable to find leads in the investigation, Adhiyaman meets the victims of the theft case. Just as he is about to update the inspector about the case, he finds a clue about the culprit’s whereabouts.

videos.title: Truth Meets Devil
videos.overview: Adhiyaman and his team reach Andhra Pradesh and are shocked to discover a series of murders that follow the same pattern. As they visit the murder locations, more shocking twists await them.

videos.title: The Warning
videos.overview: The officers receive news about another murder while investigating in Andhra Pradesh. While the team splits up to follow different leads and includes villagers in the search, another life is lost.

videos.title: Find The Devil
videos.overview: Statements from the survivors confirm Adhiyaman’s theory about the culprit. Meanwhile, the police finds crucial evidence in the last crime scene that helps in their search across the states.

videos.title: The Conclusion
videos.overview: The evidence leads them to the criminal's last location. As they find more clues of multiple offenders, the police devise a plan to separate the culprits and arrest them. Will Adhiyaman’s plan succeed?

tt39371572.name: Vikalpa
tt39371572.description: Vikalpa follows a successful corporate CEO whose life spirals out of control as immense pressure triggers terrifying hallucinations and deep childhood traumas. Trapped in his own psychological breakdowns, he struggles desperately to separate dark illusions from reality.

tt28091134.name: Sarvgunn Sampann
tt28091134.description: Follows a young woman whose striking resemblance to an internationally renowned adult film star leads society to judge her, complicating her prospects of marriage and acceptance.

tt34547719.name: Sing Geetham
tt34547719.description: In an isolated village, young Prathap seeks opportunity but enters a world of deception. Drawn into uncontrollable forces, he's caught between progress and preservation, testing his beliefs and purpose.

tt16359400.name: Arthanari
tt16359400.description: A cop and her lover are on the hunt for the kingpin of a racket that exploits hapless kids and their parents for different reasons.

tt39139925.name: Dhurandhar: The Revenge
tt39139925.description: Jaskirat Singh Rangi descends deeper into his alias as Hamza Ali Mazari, rising through Karachi's criminal hierarchy to claim the feared title "Sher-e-Baloch" while balancing loyalty, betrayal, and survival in a ruthless underworld.

tt30447822.name: Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai
tt30447822.description: When Jass leaves his marriage over conflicting priorities, a new romance abroad is upended by shocking revelations, forcing him to confront love, loyalty, and the true meaning of commitment.

tt32333001.name: Kamen Rider Gavv
tt32333001.description: Granutes are intelligent lifeforms that operate secretly in the human world. They kidnap people for the sake of "Black Market Sweets." As people are attacked one after another by the Granutes, Shoma, a young man from another world, rises up to save the people. Together with the Gochizo, small monsters born from eating sweets, he transforms into Kamen Rider Gavv with a mouth-like belt!

videos.title: A Snack Kamen Rider?!
videos.overview: Shoma, who comes from a different world, is saved by a boy named Hajime when he collapses from hunger. Shoma excitedly eats the snacks that Hajime gave him, but as soon as he does, Gochizo are born one after another. Meanwhile, freelance writer Hanto is gathering information on the appearance of "monsters" while doing research.

videos.title: Happiness Crunchy Chips
videos.overview: Shoma, who has collapsed from hunger again, is helped by Sachika, who runs an anything-and-everything general store, and treats him to lunch and snacks. Meanwhile, Hanto discovers information about Gavv on social media and starts interviewing witnesses...

videos.title: Soda Punch is a Guilty Pleasure
videos.overview: After leaving Sachika's house, Shoma encounters Sujimoto. Upon seeing Shoma's strength he offers him a job. Meanwhile, Hanto asks Sachika to look into sightings of Gavv and the Granutes.

videos.title: More Marshmallows Please!
videos.overview: After accidentally trying to eat a vegetable in their garden out of hunger, Shoma is invited into Ryoji and Mutsuko's house. Hanto goes to Suga's laboratory in order to learn more about the Granutes.

videos.title: The Memories Are Painful
videos.overview: Shoma collapsed from hunger and was saved by a mysterious monster. Is it a new Granute? Shoma wakes up and transforms into Gavv, but his movement was halted by an unexpected reaction: "The surgery was a success!" Who is this monster?

videos.title: Transformation Is Bitter Chocolate
videos.overview: Shoma starts a new life at Sachika's "Happipare". Meanwhile, Suga has succeeded in developing an item that can transform a person into a Kamen Rider, and asks Hanto to try it out.

videos.title: What Does It Taste Like Under the Mask?
An Extra Large Serving! Candy Artillery!
The Secret Bittersweet Flavor of Pudding
Break In! To the Dark Snacks Factory!
The Truth Is Sweet and Bitter
A Spoonful of Revival Ice Cream
Virtual Happiness, The Taste of Nectar
Sour and Sweet to the Point of Burning
At the End of Broken Feelings
What Does the Human World Taste Like?
Dazzling Moments That Will Never Come Back
I Won't Let Anyone Take Them Away Anymore
Aim for It! A Delicious Future!

tt35518410.name: Dridam
tt35518410.description: A police officer arrives at a seemingly peaceful station but faces pressure when human remains are discovered. Given one week to solve the murder, he must navigate demands from his department and an anxious public seeking swift ju...

tt35992024.name: Ugly Story
tt35992024.description: Follows a man who becomes obsessively attached to a girl in love with someone else, descending into a dark psychological state as he struggles with rejection, leading to dangerous consequences.

tt33412884.name: Patriot
tt33412884.description: A spy thriller following covert operatives as they uncover a surveillance conspiracy that escalates into a national security emergency, racing against time to dismantle the network before it silences opposition.

tt29377719.name: Kolaiseval
tt29377719.description: A village located in the Thiruvannamalai district has followed a belief for over 200 years. If a woman in the village becomes pregnant, it is customary to cook Pongal and sacrifice a goat to their family deity, which is located in the middle of a large forest nearby.  Now the heroine of the story is nine months pregnant. As per the tradition, the family travels to the temple. However, the forest area surrounding the temple is known for many anti-social activities.  What happens to the family that goes to this mysterious place? Why is the temple located deep inside the forest?

tt43349994.name: Moolyam
tt43349994.description: Gopal, a voluntary teacher, faces a strange form of discrimination at his new posting but chooses to resist and assert his rights.

tt0126871.description: A singer (Rishi Kapoor) marries his biggest fan, but his uncle (Amrish Puri) plans to kill him in order to gain his money.
tt0126871.name: Deewana

tt42890305.name: Bhojpuri Bawaal
tt42890305.description: Welcome to the lively world of Bhojpuri entertainment and culture, featuring some of its biggest names, where the heart is as big as the drama.

videos.title: Ab Hui Bawaal!
videos.overview: Pawan Singh, Nirahua, Aamrapali Dubey, Kajal Raghwani and Tej Pratap Yadav embark on an unscripted journey. What happens when such contrasting worlds collide?

tt26258714.name: Mr. X
tt26258714.description: Centers on secret intelligence agency cases involving five major national threats that were thwarted through covert operations.

tt27191250.name: Mechanic Rocky
tt27191250.description: A mechanic uncovers a sinister plot during a feud with local gangsters over ownership of his father's garage in this twisty Telugu-language action drama.

tt21186282.name: Playground
tt21186282.description: As the world's first gaming entertainment show, Playground is all set to begin, its finally time to meet our super entertaining contestants in Playground Tryouts. Here all our 20 contestants will get a chance to interact with 4 mentors and impress one or all 4 to pick him/her.

videos.title: Playground Episode 1
videos.overview: In Playground episode 1, our contestants finally get to know their mentor and teammates. As they get to know this, they make their entry to the real Playground and start this amazing journey with some crazy fun with their mentors CarryMinati, Triggered Insaan, Mortal and Scout. What’s better to end this crazy day with a great party?

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: In Playground episode 2, as our contestants start their journey to win Playground trophy, in no time they are set to take other teams down. Catch them fighting with the crew and not just this, to find out who is the real player, watch match day 1.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: In Playground episode 3, our contestants share their problems with the production team. As we start, Triggered insaaan takes a moment to interact with his team and quickly guide them for upcoming week.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: In Playground episode 4, as contestants get to speak to their mentors, they make new strategies for gameplay. As no contestant wishes to be benched, contestants try their best to be safe.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: As contestants' first week at house is about to end they put their best in their gameplay to make their mark in the world's first gaming entertainment show, Playground. With their first physical task in the game, they bring the best out of them. So join me, and let's see what happens next!

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: In Playground episode 6, contestants finally get to know the results of the votes and will see who among all 20 is the winner for this week. Moreover mentors connect with their teams to discuss new game strategies.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: In Playground episode 7, the game gets intense as the deadly 4 comes to life and Sakshi Sood replaces Varnikaa. AAA werewolves tops the chart and Adit Minocha becomes hero of the week.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: With Playground episode 8, contestants start their new week at the arcade of Playground. With new captains comes new strategies so let's see what this week holds for us in the world of gaming + entertainment but one thing we are sure of that it will be full power for you.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: In Playground episode 9, we will see how CarryMinati gives a surprise virtual visit to our players and how he motivates his team, Dare Dragons with the lowest Paods. Also, RJ Mahvash drops a big bomb of transfer window on our contestants.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: In Playground episode 10, 8bit Thug makes his entry to Playground arcade and make contestants do some major rethinking on their decisions as a team. Leaving all the teams behind, Power Phoenexies win LIVE gameplay 7 of world war z aftermath.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: In Playground episode 11, mentors finally make the use of transfer window. Carry in his team, replaces Foram with 8bit Rebel. With this new change, we see a positive ray for Dare Dragons.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: In Playground episode 12, contestants fear 8bit rebel's skills and plan to vote him out together. With physical day, teams expect to look at a major change in the team leadership board.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: In Playground episode 13, watch how Power Phoenixes fall apart and what is Sakshi Keswani's reaction after being benched by her team. Also watch how OP Unicorns finally reach #1 on leadership board.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: As new week is all set to start at the Playground arcade, watch how contestants plan benching and captaincy for this week. Also, as week 3 starts, stay tuned to know what new turns the story takes at the Playground arcade.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: In Playground Episode 15, watch contestants selecting their captains for week 3. Also, watch Scout and Mortal together at Playground live gameplay together for the first time.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: In this episode, watch how contestants perform in MAAC's Reel Challenge and ultimately who won this challenge. Also, find out what will be our team's strategies for Championship Day 5.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: In Playground episode 17, watch how best performing contestants get a chance to win 2M PAODS and turn the tables around for contestant ranking. Also watch how India's one of the biggest gamers, Mythpat take over Playground Arcade for a day.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: In Playground episode 18, watch how black ball turns the table around at Playground arcade. Also watch how Anjali finally takes a stand for herself and saves herself from being benched.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: In Playground episode 19, it is the Physical day today. Watch how all the teams compete with their best to win 1M PAODS.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: In Playground episode 20, watch how Dare Dragons give a best birthday gift to their leader, CarryMinati. Also watch, how new stories start to build with Harshita and Udit's new friendship.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: In Playground episode 21, watch how Siddhi Mahajankatti makes her comeback from Deadly four and replaces Jay Khatri from Power Phoenixes. Also watch, how things get more heated as transfer window happens for the finale week.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: In episode 22, watch how Desi Gamers gets all the secrets out of the Playground Arcade for you. Also watch, how medical conditions came in the way for Ruchir Kumar and why he had to step out of the arcade.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: In episode 23, contestants get another chance to change their PAODs on the finale week leadership board by taking situation based reel challenge. Watch who performed the best and won 2M PAODs lead.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: In episode 24, watch how tables turn at Playground arcade with mid week relegation. Also watch what happens when Dare Dragons and AAA Werewolves use their 2x Power card for the game, but only 1 can be the winner.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: In episode 25, watch Karunesh Talwar makes his entry to Playground Arcade and do not miss a single moment to roast our contestants.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: In episode 26, it's the physical task day for our contestants and this time they have played Human Foosball. Watch the episode to find which team had best coordination and which team had the worst.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: In Playground episode 27, watch Tanmay Bhat being himself at the Playground arcade. Also watch, who is going to win when it is Triggered vs Tanmay at the arcade.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: In Playground Season 1 grand finale, watch how this exciting journey of our contestants and mentors come to an end. To make this evening even more special watch how all the mentors and 7 bantaiz join the Playground Arcade.

videos.title: Auction Special
videos.overview: With all the strategies, mentors are finally ready with their champions. Watch how our contestants make the entry to the arcade and what happens when they are told to choose captains on the first night.

videos.title: Dance Challenge With Sanam
videos.overview: This arcade is not just gaming! Watch how our contestants fight their best to impress our judge, Sanam Johar for dance challenge at arcade. Also, who won arcade's first game. Let's find out.

videos.title: Mahira Ne Kiya Stun
videos.overview: Would you swipe left or swipe right for our amazing contestants? Checkout episode 4 and find out who has a crush on who in our Playground arcade?

videos.title: The Naughty Boys
videos.overview: Is it right to bench your ace on the day where you need him or her the most. Watch what happens when OP Unicorns bench their best player Joe. Also, what's cooking between Tanya and Eli. Watch now in episode 5.

videos.title: Tanya Anirudh Ka Puppy Love
videos.overview: Everyday at the arcade is a new challenge with lots of twists. Find out what happens when first time in Playground no one is benched. But what about elimination? Find out more in this episode.

videos.title: The Elimination Day
videos.overview: It's arcade's first elimination and a last chance to comeback for our first week's players in the Kill Zone. Watch Playground 2 episode 7 and find out our very first eliminated players.

videos.title: Ghar Mein Jhagda
videos.overview: It's second black ball at arcade and guess what, unfortunately it's the dare dragons who will shed their rumbles this time but how and why? Find out in episode 8.

videos.title: Romance Hua Bloom
videos.overview: There's a very thin line between being cringe, doormat, prick and cocky. And you have to be very careful to not skip that line. Find what our contestants think of each other about this.

videos.title: Undeserving Kaun?
videos.overview: Who is the most undeserving player to be in Playground's arcade? Is it truly Mahira or somebody else? Watch this new episode and find out what the arcade feels about this.

videos.title: Naye Friends Ki Entry
videos.overview: You asked for entertainment and drama? And we bring you that. Watch what happens when 5 new players enter the arcade and how other players react to this.

videos.title: Monu Is Back
videos.overview: It's the first day at the arcade for our new players and it seems like Monu is already on the top of entertainment! How? Find out in episode 12.

videos.title: Wildcards Fight Back
videos.overview: Every human has two sides, good or bad. And so does our contestants. But the twist is who is successful in keeping this poker face in the arcade. Watch episode 13 and find out now.

videos.title: Shocking Elimination
videos.overview: Today is arcade's second elimination day and all the players are extremely nervous. But whatever and whoever you are, you cannot escape elimination. Watch this episode and catch up with second elimination of Playground Arcade.

videos.title: Love Ya Locha
videos.overview: It's the valentine's day and love is at bloom in the arcade. Our boys are all in to win the heart of our pretty female players. Watch ahead this valentine's day special episode.

videos.title: Tanya Ka Love Triangle
videos.overview: Finally the love time at arcade is over and being so close to finale week, everyone is giving their best shot. Watch what happens when Adit finally gets chance to give black ball back.

videos.title: Eupho Under Pressure
videos.overview: It's not just gaming that can help our players earn Rumbles. Watch how all the players fight to spot win hidden Rumbles.

videos.title: Uorfi Javed Ke Jalwe
videos.overview: New day and new chance to win Rumbles. It is the fashion day in Playground House and none other than new age fashion queen Uorfi Javed enters arcade as a judge. Watch and find out who is the biggest fashionista in Playground for her.

videos.title: Abdu Bana Love Guru
videos.overview: As week 3 ends in Playground arcade, watch what more challenges this journey holds for our players. Also watch what happens when Abdu Rozik finally enters the arcade to meet these lovely players.

videos.title: Elimination Day Drama
videos.overview: It's the end of the 3rd week and a new elimination day. Watch episode 21 and find out which contestants are finally taking Saturday night flight to their home.

videos.title: Dare Dragons Under Pressure
videos.overview: It's Playground's finale week and things can turn upside down anytime here. Watch what happened in the arcade that changed things for Dare Dragons the most? Are they in pressure? Let's find out.

videos.title: Phoenix Rising From The Ashes
videos.overview: One meme can change your life, well, this is super true for social media users these days. But what if these memes can change our players life in the arcade? Watch episode 23 and find out the story behind memes.

videos.title: Harsh Gujral Ne Kia Sabko Roast
videos.overview: One thing that our players never leave a chance for is to roast each other and what if they get rumbles for that? Watch when Harsh Gujral makes entry in the arcade and things change for entertainers.

videos.title: MC Stan - Playground Ka Hasti
videos.overview: It's MC Stan's day in the house. Watch how the vibe in the arcade takes a shift when MC Stan is here to judge our players rapping skills and find out who is the show stopper.

videos.title: Shocking Challenge!
videos.overview: It's the finale week and why to end things on a bad note? So we give contestants a chance to make it or break it. Let's see who has what to confess and for who.

videos.title: Emotional Hua Arcade
videos.overview: Only a day to the grand finale! A lot has happened with our contestants over past 27 days. Let's see what kept them going and who is going to miss who?

videos.title: Grand Finale
videos.overview: It's the last day at the arcade for our players and D-Day is finally here. Watch episode 28 now and find out what roller coaster ride it has been for our players and who the championship trophy.

videos.title: Tryouts Begin
videos.overview: Playground is back with its Season 03 where we are looking for India’s ultimate gaming entertainer. Contestants try their fate in front of a new mentor panel in the tryouts. Will sisters Ishu and Nishu, Chirag and Sway manage to impress the mentors and convince them to take them in their teams?

videos.title: Ready For Chill Gamer?
videos.overview: From Himanshu-Janvi’s tiff to the mentors trying yoga moves with Tanu, the tryouts have been pretty action-packed with gamers and entertainers so far. But, here comes Chill Gamer whose antics take the mentors by surprise.

videos.title: Final Team Selection
videos.overview: The final tryout episode is here and it’s time for the mentors to lock their teams. Will Ishu, Sway and other budding gamers get selected by the mentors?

videos.title: Mentors Takeover Playground Arcade!
videos.overview: As team mentors Elvish, Carry, Mortal, and Techno step into the Playground arcade sparking drama among contestants, watch how things go next level. Tune in to day 1’s drama as contestants embarks their journey for legendary status.

videos.title: Emotional Fallout of Players
videos.overview: Players evaluate team's top performers and under-performers, sparking rivalries within the group. Mentors intervene to steer them towards their goal.

videos.title: Karan and Sway: Something Special?
videos.overview: As Karan Kundrra steps into the Playground arcade to unravel his 'Love Adhura', sparks fly among the contestants. Find out what boys think of girls contestants.

videos.title: Techno's Wake Up Call To His Team
videos.overview: After failing to secure any victories in their debut esports match, Techno issues a stern warning to his team. Find out the cause of Raging Centaurs' lack of unity.

videos.title: Chill Changes The Game
videos.overview: Following the resurgence of the Raging Centaurs on the leader-board, it's now imperative for other teams to step up their game. Brace yourselves for the week's most anticipated twist: the Pink Ball. Discover how it proves to be a stroke of luck for Ahmed.

videos.title: Arcade's Biggest Roast Battle
videos.overview: As Abhishek Kumar steps into the arcade, contestants brace themselves for a fresh challenge. It's no walk in the park, but it promises to be entertaining to the fullest.

videos.title: Reality Check With Mentors
videos.overview: As we near the end of this week, it's crucial for our contestants to receive a reality check, and who better to deliver it than their mentors? Join us as mentors provide a much-needed dose of reality, alongside special guest Rhea Chakraborty.

videos.title: Elimination and new legends
videos.overview: Witness the showdown as gaming legends Techno Gamerz and Mortal go head-to-head. But that's not all - today is the first elimination day at the arcade, and where new legends will rise. Brace yourself for an episode filled with intense drama!

videos.title: Himanshu And Aditya's Clash
videos.overview: As unfiltered zone is now open for contestants, the stage is set for drama to unfold. Witness the escalation of Himanshu and Aditya's clash as it reaches new heights, ultimately leading to the loss of their powers.

videos.title: Elvish In The Arcade
videos.overview: Discover the aftermath of Aditya and Himanshu's clash with mentor Elvish Yadav. Explore the repercussions of their actions and unravel the consequences they face. Additionally, uncover the top arcade duos as they tackle their latest challenge in the dating realm.

videos.title: Elvish Brings In Wild Cards
videos.overview: The dynamics at the Playground arcade have shifted dramatically with the arrival of none other than Elvish Yadav, accompanied by his unpredictable allies Arohi and BT Android.

videos.title: Reel It With Mouni!
videos.overview: Prepare yourself for another electrifying Friday episode filled with celebrities, featuring none other than the beloved icon of Indian television, Mouni Roy, stepping into the Playground arcade.

videos.title: Chill Breaks Down!
videos.overview: Mentors return to the arcade, poised to deliver a reality check to contestants. What's disrupting unity between teams DD and OP Unicorns? Let's uncover the truth.

videos.title: Elimination Twist In The Arcade
videos.overview: In the arcade, under mentor's rule, drama escalates. Watch as twists emerge with mentors introducing the black ball to contestants leading to elimination, changing the arcade's dynamics.

videos.title: Players Ki Battleship!
videos.overview: This season's wildcards bring unpredictable twists. Experience Ahmed stirring emotions in Lekha, and watch the KO Krakens excel with 3M rumbles in the battleship challenge.

videos.title: Surprise Elimination!
videos.overview: As contestants absorb the wildcard entry, a sudden mid-week elimination shakes the house. Who will leave? How will this affect connections? Stay tuned for the suspenseful fallout!

videos.title: Valence Sway Ka Jhagda
videos.overview: Witness Valence as he pours out his emotions regarding Sway and reveals the depth of his hurt caused by her actions. Experience an unfiltered conversation between Valence and Sway today as they openly discuss their feelings.

videos.title: Emotional Day With Family
videos.overview: Today is a deeply emotional day for our arcade players as they receive love and support from their families! Let's observe how this affects our players and influences their performance in the game.

videos.title: Diss Rap Battle With Ikka!
videos.overview: Ikka, the celebrated rapper, joins the house for a rap battle and fun tasks. Contestants compete to win both the task and Ikka's admiration as it is star power Friday. Tune in for the exciting showdown!

videos.title: Elvish & Scout's Warning To Players!
videos.overview: Mentor Elvish returns to the arcade, accompanied by Season 1's victorious team mentor, Scout OP. Together, they confront players about their sportsmanship, emphasizing the importance of fair play and integrity.

videos.title: AAA Is Back With Fukra Insaan
videos.overview: Exciting news for some, but not so great for others? Brace yourselves, as our favorite insaan, Fukra Insaan, returns with his squad, AAA Werewolves. But wait, there's more! Stay tuned to see who bids farewell from the arcade on Elimination day.

videos.title: Teams Build and Defend!
videos.overview: As the drama unfolds, contestants dive into a thrilling game. Witness Lekha's efforts fuel team bonding while Himanshu's standout performance becomes the talk of the house. Don't miss this adrenaline-pumping adventure!

videos.title: AAA Werewolves Enter The Arcade
videos.overview: Dynamics in arcade shake as wild card team AAA Werewolves makes their entry. Watch what happens when AAA team, Khyati, Ayush and Amogh pick their enemies and lovers.

videos.title: Chill Vs AAA Werewolves
videos.overview: As the wild card team AAA Werewolves seizes their opportunity to showcase their extreme side, Ayush throws down the gauntlet to Chill, challenging him to wrestle and triumph in their arcade rumbles! Discover who emerges as the superior wrestler - Chill or Ayush?

videos.title: Chill’s Confession About Arohi
videos.overview: Get ready for an exciting AMA session featuring our players, where they have the chance to share their true feelings. Stay tuned as we delve into what happens when Chill is asked about his emotions for Arohi!

videos.title: Mannara Romances Pingu
videos.overview: Join us for a day at the arcade with our boss girl, Mannara! Witness the thrill as contestants light up with excitement at the chance to connect with Mannara, and see how she effortlessly brings out Pingu's romantic side.

videos.title: Fukra <3 Elvish
videos.overview: As all our mentors gather in the arcade for a reality check, observe the dynamics unfold when Chill makes concerning remarks about AAA Werewolves, and Fukra Insaan stands by his team.

videos.title: Team Elimination
videos.overview: Along with reality check, mentors are here this weekend to bring the biggest change in the game i.e. team elimination. Find out how Pingu and Abhinav will decide the future of their teams in the arcade.

videos.title: Arcade Bana Fight Club
videos.overview: As finale week is getting closer, becoming a legend is getting more important. Watch how dynamics change in the arcade as contestants fight their best to get legend title and save themselves from kill zone.

videos.title: Players Get Bowled
videos.overview: Today marks our player's physical challenge, reminiscent of their arcade adventures. In this round, they'll engage in human bowling. Witness their strategic maneuvers as they aim for maximum points and reverse the odds in their favor.

videos.title: Khyati Confesses Her Feelings
videos.overview: As contestants step into the unfiltered zone to express themselves freely, Khyati reveals her feelings for Himanshu. Tune in to hear the reactions of other contestants as they learn about this heartfelt confession.

videos.title: Masti With Manisha Rani
videos.overview: It's time for some fun as the star, Manisha Rani, steps into the Playground arcade. Witness how our boys pull out all the stops to charm not only Manisha Rani but also other girls in the arcade.

videos.title: Players Ko Pada Thappad!
videos.overview: As mentors Elvish and Fukra Insaan enters arcade yet one more time for reality check, players fear of new twists and turns. Find out what happens when our mentors will give players a smack of reality check!

videos.title: Who Will Go Into Finale Week?
videos.overview: As we gear up for the climactic finale week of Playground 3, join mentors Fukra Insaan and Elvish Yadav as they unveil the identities of the four contestants who will bid farewell to the arcade just shy of the grand finale.

videos.title: Who Will Win Ticket To Finale?
videos.overview: Finale week at Playground 3 begins, every moment a chance for contestants to shine and secure a finals spot. Watch them compete in thrilling activities to become the first finalist.

videos.title: Team Chill VS Team Pingu
videos.overview: As the excitement of finale week electrifies our contestants, Playground 3's arcade gears up for its ultimate physical challenge - Human Foos Fall.

videos.title: Abba Aa Gaye
videos.overview: The Playground's path has truly been a rollercoaster for our contestants, filled with highs and lows. But imagine finding your greatest source of support right in the arcade, boosting you up during the final week. Witness the emotional moment when Chill reunites with his father after a month apart!

videos.title: Finalist or Eliminated?
videos.overview: Just 48 hours left until the epic conclusion of Playground 3! Brace yourself as host Rohit shocks everyone with a sudden elimination bombshell. Whose journey will hit a roadblock, and who will secure a spot in the coveted top 6? Tune in to uncover the thrilling twists!

videos.title: Mushaira Mehfil With Zakir Khan
videos.overview: Last Star Power Friday at the arcade before the grand finale tomorrow! And who better to spice it up than the amazing Zakir Khan? Join us for a fun-filled mushaira with Zakir and our contestants today!

videos.title: Finale
videos.overview: Join us for the grand finale of Playground's epic journey! Witness the thrilling conclusion of gaming and entertainment as we unveil the ultimate legend of Playground 3.

videos.title: Mentors Impressed By Desi Girl
videos.overview: India's largest gaming entertainment show is back with Season 4! Our new mentors are ready to discover the new age star. Who will manage to impress the mentors and secure a slot in the team, Will it be Gauri’s desi charm, Armaan’s legendary gaming skills, Vipul’s stud attitude, Diya’s dance moves, or the fierce rivalry between Shobhika and Khyati?

videos.title: Bharat Rocked, Munawar Shocked!
videos.overview: From Khyati and Shobhika's heat off to Bharat's Shayari, this episode of tryouts is full of energetic gamers and charismatic entertainers. Vaibhav leaves an impression on the mentors whereas Winter manages to dance on a romantic song with Munawar.

videos.title: Elvish Ka Hua Systum Hang!
videos.overview: From Shivam’s intense tryouts to Farhan’s electrifying performance, Mohit steps in and impresses all the mentors with his skills. Taking over Elvish’s mentor seat, the tension rises as we eagerly await Elvish’s reaction. Don’t miss out on this dramatic twist!

videos.title: And The Journey Begins
videos.overview: The mentors make a grand entrance as they explore the Playground house. The contestants soon arrive with enthusiasm, sharing a lively ice-breaking moment. The new mentors, full of energy, lead their teams to victory in the first gaming battle, earning Rumbles and making their mark.

videos.title: Khyati Changes The Game
videos.overview: The teams engage in a heated discussion to identify under-performers and divide Rumbles. Rivalries intensify, with Khyati becoming the target of widespread animosity, leading to fractured alliances and high stakes.

videos.title: Arcade Mein Hua Haadsa
videos.overview: As the legends turn up the heat in the arcade, things take an unexpected twist when a playful banter turns into a shocking accident! Bharat and Frahan's friendly competition spirals out of control, leading to Bharat breaking his hand. Watch the episode to find out how it all went down!

videos.title: Kaun Banega Diya Ka Piya?
videos.overview: Playground arcade hosts a romantic challenge where contestants pitch their ideal connection. Aryaansh, Vaibhav, and Mohit make their case for Diya, but who she chooses remains a mystery. Who will win her heart?

videos.title: Ginni Ne Kiya Khulaasa
videos.overview: The contestants rush to spill gossip to Carry Bot, but Ginni steals the spotlight. As the competition heats up, she takes center stage, delivering the hottest, juiciest tea. What did Ginni reveal? Stay tuned!

videos.title: The PG Roast Ft. Ashish Solanki
videos.overview: Get ready for 'Star Power Friday', where roast master Ashish Solanki takes the stage! Contestants unleash their funniest roasts, but it's Shobhika who steals the spotlight, hilariously roasting Mohit and Armaan! Don’t miss the laughs!

videos.title: Reality Check With Mentors: Vaibhav vs Pankhu
videos.overview: Mentors return to the house, shocked by gossip about constant fighting, especially between Vaibhav and Pankhu. During an intense game, their argument escalates, forcing mentors to intervene

videos.title: Arcade Ka Pehla Elimination
videos.overview: After a power-packed week, Ko Krakens and Raging Centaurs find themselves in the kill zone, along with Pragya from OP Unicorns. Who will face elimination in Playground 4? Stay tuned to find out!

videos.title: Jhaapad Maarke Show Se Niklunga
videos.overview: In the second week of Playground, Vaibhav and Pankhu from Raging Centaurs face off in the third Legends Task. A fierce battle ensues, leading to a heated argument. Who will claim the title of legend? Stay tuned!

videos.title: Luv Kataria Ka Wild Card Surprise
videos.overview: Luv Kataria brings electrifying energy to the house! But that’s not all, he comes with a surprise - wild card contestants Unnati and Nitin. They're ready to take the competition up a notch!

videos.title: Naye Dushman, Khyati vs Unnati
videos.overview: As the wild card Unnati enters the house, sparks fly as she immediately clashes with Khyati. Their rivalry grows fast, and it’s clear these two are bound to bring intense drama to the competition!

videos.title: Armaan Aur Winter Ki Date
videos.overview: After a thrilling day of intense invrse cricket at Playground, the arcade transforms into a romantic setup for Winter and Arman’s date. But just when things get cozy, Mohit steps in. Watch to find out!

videos.title: Entertainment Unlimited With Highway Love
videos.overview: Join us for the 2nd Star Power Friday with Highway Love cast Ritvik and Gayatri! Watch the contestants dazzle with Bollywood dance, steamy performances, and more! Stay tuned!

videos.title: Dussehra Pe Dhamaka Harsh Ke Saath
videos.overview: Celebrate this Dussehra with Playground! Harsh Beniwal joins the mentors for a special Reality Check and a thrilling challenge for Wild Cards. Stay tuned to see who rises to the occasion!

videos.title: Himanshu Ki Wild Card Entry
videos.overview: This Sunday will be thrilling with wild card Himanshu's entry! His history with Khyati and chemistry with Shobhika brings drama, setting the stage for next-level gameplay!

videos.title: Himanshu Hua Expose?
videos.overview: Khyati reveals Himanshu's secrets shocking everyone in the house. Shobhika is left heartbroken and feeling betrayed, causing rising tensions that impact their relationship.

videos.title: Arcade Mai Hui Hathapai
videos.overview: Himanshu's wild card entry sparks drama as he and Vaibhav engage in an intense physical fight. Watch to discover the reason behind it!

videos.title: Nikki Ke Saamne Khule KhyatiKe Letters
videos.overview: Nikki enters Playground, raising the energy with intense tasks. Khyati is pushed to reveal Himanshu's letter. What secrets lie within?

videos.overview: Uorfi Javed makes a dramatic entrance as the wild card mentor. Get ready for some next-level excitement as Uorfi brings her bold and unapologetic style to the gaming arena.

videos.overview: Uorfi Javed connects with her team and is upset with their performance, especially Himanshu and Shobhika. Will they step up or crumble?

videos.title: Power Phoenixes Khatre Mein?
videos.overview: Elimination Week is do-or-die for Power Phoenixes. At the bottom of the leader-board, they must give it their all or risk elimination. Stay tuned!

videos.overview: Pankhu and Unnati’s heated argument escalates when Pankhu sarcastically calls himself a 'bad human', fueling Unnati’s fury even more!

videos.overview: Luv and Vishal bring unmatched energy to Star Power Friday, elevating the fun with their lively banter and chemistry. Don’t miss the excitement!
